Open_Problems: Long-term durability and AD-progression impact of magic-based cognitive training

Method_Architecture: Interventional RCT (digital cognitive training; adaptive algorithm)
Best_Metric: not reported (protocol; no results)
Dataset: Community-dwelling MCI cohort, Erlangen/Nuernberg, Germany (planned n=100)
Key_Novelty: First trial of MAKSCog, an individualised adaptive CCT purpose-built for MCI, in a fully virtual double-blind RCT
Primary_Limitation: Protocol only; technology-access selection bias; no outcome data yet
Open_Problems: Does adaptive individualised CCT beat basic CCT and slow cognitive decline?

Method_Architecture: Retrospective case-control statistical analysis (A8-type)
Best_Metric: Association p-values (gender p=0.006, depression p=0.004); PD comorbidity 9.7%
Dataset: Amrita Institute, Kochi, Kerala, India: 93 MCI vs 97 controls (2015-2020)
Key_Novelty: First Kerala/South-India-specific neuropathological comorbidity and risk-factor profile of MCI in elderly
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective design; MMSE-only MCI ascertainment; single centre
Open_Problems: Prospective confirmation of modifiable risk factors in South Indian elderly
Journal: Journal of Family Medicine and Primary Care 11(4):1268-1274 (2022)

Method_Architecture: Methodological cohort analysis with Cox regression (A8-type)
Best_Metric: Dementia HR doubled with PE adjustment; reversion reduced 28.8%; 72.2% false-reverter biomarker positivity
Dataset: ADNI: 329 MCI participants (baseline), CSF biomarkers
Key_Novelty: First explicit quantification of practice-effect-adjusted MCI classification: PE adjustment cuts reversion 28.8% and doubles dementia HR
Primary_Limitation: ADNI-specific; matching-based PE estimation; single-year follow-up
Open_Problems: Best clinical implementation of PE adjustment in diagnostic classification and trials

Modality: Molecular/Fluid: gut microbiota (probiotic intervention) + MRI atrophy
Method_Architecture: Interventional RCT with longitudinal imaging (A8-type)
Best_Metric: VSRAD atrophy-progression suppression; ADAS-Jcog orientation improvement (p<0.05)
Dataset: Juntendo Tokyo Koto Geriatric Medical Center, Japan: 115 FAS (probiotic 55, placebo 60)
Key_Novelty: First RCT showing B. breve MCC1274 suppresses MRI brain-atrophy progression (VSRAD) in suspected MCI alongside cognitive subscale gains
Primary_Limitation: Cognitive gains only on subscales; no gut-microbiota mediation; 24 weeks
Open_Problems: Mechanism of probiotic benefit; durability after cessation; microbiota mediation

Method_Architecture: Cox regression risk score (A8-type)
Best_Metric: c-index 0.72 (ADNI external); 0.69 internal; 0.61 PROMPT
Dataset: NACC-UDS (6222), PROMPT (452), ADNI (598)
Key_Novelty: First externally validated pragmatic 3-year dementia risk score for MCI using only routine-clinical-care variables
Primary_Limitation: Moderate discrimination (PROMPT c 0.61); routine-data quality limits
Open_Problems: Whether MMSE/MoCA add prognostic value beyond the score; recalibration per setting

Method_Architecture: Longitudinal imaging + Cox/ROC (A8-type)
Best_Metric: Baseline amyloid HR 10.0 (1.15-85.39); ROC 65.2% longitudinal vs 59.6% baseline
Dataset: Chosun University Hospital, Gwangju, South Korea: 75 MCI (17 converters)
Key_Novelty: Head-to-head proof that baseline amyloid PET alone suffices - longitudinal amyloid change adds no significant predictive value for MCI-to-AD
Primary_Limitation: Small sample with wide CIs; single centre; ~24-month follow-up
Open_Problems: Whether amyloid change predicts in longer horizons or specific MCI subgroups

Method_Architecture: Longitudinal cohort survival analysis (A8-type)
Best_Metric: Annual conversion 18.6% LMCI vs 4.33% EMCI; MMSE annual change -1.035 vs -0.299
Dataset: Taipei Veterans General Hospital memory clinic, Taiwan: 161 EMCI, 258 LMCI, 146 NC
Key_Novelty: First detailed EMCI-vs-LMCI longitudinal comparison of reversion, conversion, and domain-specific decline in a single memory-clinic cohort
Primary_Limitation: Single centre; ADNI2 staging; no biomarker stratification
Open_Problems: Biomarker-correlated EMCI outcomes; staging-based follow-up intensity

Method_Architecture: Wearable sensor + logistic regression (A8-type)
Best_Metric: Accuracy 76.5%, sensitivity 0.8095, specificity 0.8571
Dataset: Join Dementia Research (UK): 21 MCI, 21 healthy controls
Key_Novelty: First demonstration that commercial wearable PPG HRV (SDNN/RMSSD) distinguishes MCI from healthy controls at 76.5% accuracy
Primary_Limitation: Small pilot sample; resting only; single wearable device; no external validation
Open_Problems: Specificity of HRV (CVD/medication confounds); generalisability across devices
Journal: IEEE Journal of Translational Engineering in Health and Medicine 10:2700206 (2022)

Method_Architecture: Global evidence synthesis / policy report (A8-type)
Best_Metric: Diagnostic coverage 40-50% HIC / 5-10% LMIC; cost US$818B; 47M prevalence
Dataset: Global (ADI, WHO/G7 sources): 47M dementia prevalence, 131M by 2050, US$818B cost
Key_Novelty: Canonical global assessment of dementia healthcare coverage, quality and costs - quantifies the 40-50%/5-10% diagnosis gap
Primary_Limitation: Synthesis of heterogeneous national data; sparse LMIC primary data
Open_Problems: Closing the diagnosis gap in LMIC; care-model cost-effectiveness
Journal: Alzheimer's Disease International, London (World Alzheimer Report 2016)

Modality: Clinical/Population: memory-clinic prognostic modelling (demographics, MRI visual ratings, CSF biomarkers)
Method_Architecture: Multivariable Cox regression prediction models (with/without biomarkers)
Best_Metric: Harrell's C 0.81 (institutionalization, SCD/MCI, with biomarkers; 0.76 without); 0.79 mortality
Dataset: Amsterdam Dementia Cohort (development); Memento cohort, France (external validation)
Key_Novelty: First institutionalization/mortality prediction models spanning SCD-MCI-dementia with biomarker-added-value analysis
Primary_Limitation: Moderate dementia-stage discrimination (C 0.65-0.68); country-specific institutionalization definitions limit transportability
Open_Problems: Quantitative imaging and plasma biomarkers; dynamic updating with repeated measures; validation in other healthcare systems

Modality: Clinical/Population: primary-care MCI pathway consensus recommendations
Method_Architecture: Expert-symposium consensus (62 recommendations, majority voting)
Best_Metric: 62 recommendations; cited MCI prevalence 6.7%-24.2% (ages 60-84), incidence 22.5-60.1/1000 person-years (75+)
Dataset: Expert symposium (74 practitioners + 2 consumer advocates) plus cited epidemiological reviews
Key_Novelty: First nationally informed 62-item Australian primary-care recommendation set specific to MCI detection through long-term care
Primary_Limitation: Expert-consensus editorial with industry funding (Nutricia) and no systematic evidence grading
Open_Problems: GRADE evidence grading; implementation trials; LMIC-adapted versions; disease-modifying-era update

Modality: Clinical/Population: PD-MCI narrative mini-review (neuropsychological criteria and cohorts)
Method_Architecture: Narrative review of criteria, prevalence, subtypes, progression
Best_Metric: PD-MCI prevalence ~40% (95% CI 36-44, Baiano 2020 meta-analysis, 41 studies/7053 patients); 28% reversion
Dataset: Synthesised PD cohorts (Baiano 2020: 41 studies/7053 PD; Saredakis 2019: 39 articles/4011 PD; Yarnall 2014)
Key_Novelty: Organises PD-MCI criterion-dependence and heterogeneity, documenting 28% reversion and dual-syndrome subtypes
Primary_Limitation: Narrative (non-systematic) review with heterogeneous primary studies and no quantitative synthesis of its own
Open_Problems: Systematic criterion-comparison meta-analysis; alpha-synuclein biomarker integration; standardised reversion reporting

Modality: Clinical/Population: community-cohort risk-score modelling (demographics, lifestyle, vascular history, cognition)
Method_Architecture: Logistic-regression risk scores (RS1/RS2 cross-sectional; RS3 longitudinal)
Best_Metric: AUC 0.785 (RS model 3, incident-MCI prediction); RS1/RS2 0.64-0.70
Dataset: BABRI Beijing community cohort (5921 baseline; 921 longitudinal sub-cohort)
Key_Novelty: First MCI-specific risk-score system, longitudinally confirmed (AUC 0.785) in a large community cohort
Primary_Limitation: Moderate AUC and small incident-event count (72/849) without external validation
Open_Problems: External validation in other cohorts; vascular/metabolic biomarkers; score-guided intervention testing

Modality: Clinical/Population: cardiovascular-risk-score models from routine clinical variables
Method_Architecture: Logistic risk models (six TCVR variants, AuROC + Hosmer-Lemeshow)
Best_Metric: AuROC 0.69 (anthropometric model, older age group); 0.58-0.61 across all six models
Dataset: Maharaj Nakorn Chiang Mai Hospital metabolic-risk cohort (Thailand, secondary data)
Key_Novelty: First Thai MCI risk-model evaluation using only routine cardiovascular variables in a metabolic-risk population
Primary_Limitation: Modest discrimination (0.58-0.61) and highly skewed case mix (82.7% MCI) in a cross-sectional single-hospital sample
Open_Problems: Prospective community sampling with balanced case mix; cognitive/complaint variables; longitudinal incident-MCI validation

Modality: Behavioural/Digital: masticatory function tests (mixing ability index, bite force, dental status)
Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional association analysis (multivariable logistic regression)
Best_Metric: MAI (mixing ability index) uniquely associated with MCI after adjustment; teeth, bite force, subjective ability, posterior support not significant
Dataset: Yonsei University Dental Hospital elderly cohort (South Korea)
Key_Novelty: Identifies dynamic masticatory performance (MAI), not tooth count or bite force, as the oral parameter associated with MCI
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional dental-clinic design with screening-based MCI proxy (K-MMSE <= 23) and modest sample
Open_Problems: Longitudinal MAI-to-conversion/reversion designs; clinical MCI diagnosis with neuropsychological batteries; community samples

Modality: Multimodal: ADNI MRI volumes + plasma NfL/P-tau181 + cognitive tests + comorbidities (sex-stratified clustering)
Method_Architecture: Sex-separated mixed-data clustering with Kaplan-Meier-anchored subtypes
Best_Metric: Female-PP vs male-PP APOE e4 converter proportion 78.57% vs 49.12%; subtype survival separation p<0.001
Dataset: ADNI (ADNI-1 and ADNI-2/GO MCI subjects)
Key_Novelty: Sex-separated multi-modal MCI subtyping revealing e4-carrier conversion disparity hidden in pooled analysis
Primary_Limitation: Single-cohort subtyping with modest per-subtype samples and no external or amyloid-anchored validation
Open_Problems: External replication (NACC/AddNeuroMed); amyloid-PET subtype anchoring; clustering stability bootstrap

Modality: Clinical/Population: guideline-update editorial with biomarker-characterised case reviews
Method_Architecture: Case-based guideline critique (AAN 2018 vs KDA 2021)
Best_Metric: not reported (3/3 cases amyloid-PET positive; no aggregate metric)
Dataset: Three Ajou University Hospital MCI cases; AAN 2018 and KDA 2021 guideline documents
Key_Novelty: Case-anchored argument that MCI guidelines lag the permitted biomarker era, with adherence-monitoring as an unmet care need
Primary_Limitation: Three-case editorial basis without systematic evidence synthesis
Open_Problems: Structured review of anti-amyloid trials in MCI; adherence-monitoring system pilots; cost-effectiveness analysis

Modality: Clinical/Population: community-cohort reversion analysis under two diagnostic criteria
Method_Architecture: Poisson regression (reversion factors) + Cox model (dementia risk, time-varying reversion)
Best_Metric: Reversion 43.4% (Petersen, n=744) vs 48.3% (NP criteria, n=375); reverters dementia HR 0.34/0.17
Dataset: Good Aging in Skane (GAS/SNAC), Sweden (5804 examined)
Key_Novelty: Head-to-head community reversion rates for Petersen vs NP criteria with factor analysis, showing 43-48% reversion regardless of definition
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective classification without biomarker adjudication of reverters
Open_Problems: Biomarker-anchored reversion (amyloid/tau); memory-clinic replication; longer follow-up

Modality: Behavioural/Digital: tablet puzzle-game app intervention (TECH) with group facilitation
Method_Architecture: Pre-post experimental feasibility study (MoCA + WebNeuro batteries)
Best_Metric: MoCA Cohen's d = 0.52 (MCI group); memory recall improvement p = 0.006
Dataset: Community-dwelling older adults, Tel Aviv (parent trials NCT02955277, NCT02955303)
Key_Novelty: Feasibility and pre-post gains of daily home-based tablet puzzle-gaming across MCI and pre-MCI with device-logged compliance
Primary_Limitation: Uncontrolled pre-post design with small samples and no follow-up or practice-effect quantification
Open_Problems: RCT with active control and practice-effect adjustment; conversion/reversion endpoints; dose-response modelling
Journal: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health

Modality: Behavioural/Digital: eye tracking (fixation duration, saccade amplitude) during visual short-term memory binding task (ViewMind)
Method_Architecture: Linear mixed models + ROC-based prospective prediction from task-embedded oculomotor behaviour
Best_Metric: 94% of baseline-predicted ADS Progressing patients developed dementia at 40 months vs 0% of non-ADS Progressing
Dataset: AXIS Neurociencias cohort, Bahia Blanca, Argentina
Key_Novelty: First prospective task-embedded eye-movement digital biomarker predicting MCI-to-ADS conversion with 40-month near-complete separation
Primary_Limitation: Single-site modest cohort with clinically adjudicated outcomes and no head-to-head comparison against standard cognitive screens
Open_Problems: Biomarker cross-validation against amyloid/tau; multisite replication; head-to-head with MMSE/ACE-R baselines; calibration reporting
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia: Diagnosis, Assessment & Disease Monitoring

Modality: Clinical/Neuropsychiatric: NPI-Q-derived MBI domains (behavioural phenotype) with 3T MRI cortical thickness subset
Method_Architecture: Two-step cluster analysis + Cox proportional hazards with cortical thickness comparison
Best_Metric: Complex-MBI vs asymptomatic AD progression HR 2.541 [1.904-3.392], p<0.001
Dataset: SMG-SNU Boramae / Dongjak-Gu Dementia Center cohort, Seoul, Korea (2012-2020)
Key_Novelty: First domain co-occurrence clustering of MBI in amnestic MCI linking multi-domain profiles to doubled AD hazard and frontoparietal thinning
Primary_Limitation: MBI approximated from NPI-Q rather than the MBI Checklist with clinical-only progression adjudication in a single-centre cohort
Open_Problems: MBI-C validation; biomarker-adjudicated progression; external replication; subcortical/longitudinal MRI; APOE-vascular interaction

Modality: Clinical/Population: lifestyle exposure (vigorous regular exercise) in biomarker-confirmed amnestic MCI/AD
Method_Architecture: Longitudinal case-series observation with multimodal biomarker confirmation (no classifier)
Best_Metric: MMSE annual decline 0.3 and 0.125 points vs ~2-point literature norm over 16/8 years
Dataset: NYU Langone Barlow Center / Columbia VALAD trial records (2 cases)
Key_Novelty: Biomarker-positive case evidence that decades-scale vigorous regular exercise may slow AD progression beyond moderate-intensity trial doses
Primary_Limitation: Uncontrolled two-case design with retrospective exercise ascertainment unable to isolate exercise from reserve and selection effects
Open_Problems: Prospective vigorous-exercise trial with wearable dose tracking; biomarker-stratified randomisation; intensity-gradient reporting

Modality: Behavioural/Digital: paper-and-pencil visuo-constructional screening (VVT 3.0) vs MMSE and clock drawing
Method_Architecture: ROC curves + multinomial logistic regression across four-stage continuum
Best_Metric: VVT 3.0 AD-vs-rest sensitivity 62.1% / specificity 83.1%
Dataset: Medical University of Vienna memory-clinic cohort, Austria
Sample_N_Approx: N= 622 (33 HC + 68 SCD + 301 MCI + 220 AD); follow-up n=117
Key_Novelty: Four-stage head-to-head benchmark of a short language-independent visuo-constructional screen against MMSE and CDT including progression prediction
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective single-centre design with unbalanced diagnostic groups and inadequate progression-prediction performance across all three tests
Open_Problems: Prospective balanced validation; multi-test composite models; biomarker-confirmed staging; cross-cultural testing

Modality: Clinical/Population: coronary heart disease cohort with MoCA, coronary angiography, metabolomic and lifestyle predictors
Method_Architecture: Registered study protocol; planned logistic regression risk model (not yet built)
Best_Metric: not reported (protocol; no model metrics)
Dataset: Xiyuan Hospital CHD cohort (planned), Beijing, China; ChiCTR2200063255
Key_Novelty: First registered risk-prediction protocol for MCI in coronary heart disease combining coronary-anatomy, vascular-function and intestinal-metabolite predictors
Primary_Limitation: Protocol-stage evidence with no model results; cross-sectional single-site design limits causal and generalisable inference
Open_Problems: Longitudinal incident-MCI extension; external validation across cardiac centres; head-to-head with generic vascular risk models

Modality: Neuroimaging: T1 structural MRI grey-matter covariance networks (default, frontoparietal, hippocampal) via seed-based PLS
Method_Architecture: Seed-based PLS feature extraction + random forest classification with cross-validated ROC
Best_Metric: Reversion (M-t-N) prediction AUC 0.701-0.809 across three networks; progression (N-t-M) AUC 0.692-0.792
Dataset: BABRI (n=155) + ADNI (n=286) longitudinal cohorts
Key_Novelty: First grey-matter covariance-network evidence that distributed structural coherence predicts both MCI development and reversion, with hippocampus as the reversion hub
Primary_Limitation: Baseline-snapshot covariance with clinically defined reversion and no held-out external-site validation
Open_Problems: Serial MRI covariance; amyloid/tau-stratified reversion; site-level external validation; reserve/vascular covariate integration

Modality: Clinical/Population: physical function predictors (handgrip dynamometry, self-rated squat ability) in a community survey
Method_Architecture: Multivariable logistic regression with 7:3 development/validation split and NRI/IDI reclassification
Best_Metric: AUC 0.732 (combined model); NRI 0.3279 vs handgrip-only model
Dataset: Anhui Province Healthy Longevity Survey (AHLS), China (2019)
Key_Novelty: Combined upper- and lower-limb physical function adds reclassification value for essentially equipment-free MCI screening in low-resource communities
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional design with education-adjusted MMSE-only MCI ascertainment and subjective squat self-rating
Open_Problems: Longitudinal incident-MCI follow-up; neuropsychological adjudication; external validation; device-based lower-limb measures; cost-effectiveness
Journal: Inquiry: The Journal of Health Care Organization, Provision, and Financing

Modality: Clinical/Population: affective temperament (TEMPS) in MCI/SCD trial screening
Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional group comparison with chi-square/Fisher exact testing (no classifier)
Best_Metric: Irritable temperament positively predicts pharmacological-trial participation; anxious temperament negatively (no effect sizes reported)
Dataset: Santa Chiara University Hospital screening pool, Pisa, Italy
Key_Novelty: First evidence that stable affective temperaments (irritable pro-, anxious con-) modulate pharmacological-trial participation in MCI/SCD
Primary_Limitation: Small single-centre cross-sectional screening sample without multivariable confounder control or retention follow-up
Open_Problems: Multicentre multivariable replication; retention/dropout linkage; caregiver attitudes; trial-phase stratification

Modality: Neuroimaging + Fluid: 3T FLAIR periventricular WMH volumetry combined with plasma homocysteine in Parkinson disease
Method_Architecture: Multivariate logistic regression + ROC combination model with Z-test AUC comparison
Best_Metric: Combined PWMH + Hcy AUC 0.879 [0.844-0.915] vs 0.701/0.688 individually (Z-test P<0.001)
Dataset: Chongqing University Jiangjin Hospital de novo PD cohort, China (2019-2021)
Key_Novelty: Periventricular WMH volumetry plus plasma Hcy as a validated two-marker combination for PD-MCI prediction (AUC 0.879)
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional single-centre design without longitudinal PDD conversion or external validation
Open_Problems: Longitudinal PDD-conversion follow-up; external validation; plasma amyloid/tau/NfL addition; Hcy-lowering interaction analysis

Modality: Clinical/Population: neuropsychiatric symptoms (depression, anxiety, apathy, psychosis, ICDs) with longitudinal neuropsychological batteries in PPMI
Method_Architecture: Linear mixed-effects models + generalised estimating equations (no ML classifier)
Best_Metric: Depression and anxiety associated with progressive decline across all four cognitive domains; NPS (except ICDs) increased MCI occurrence
Dataset: Parkinson Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI), 33 international sites, 2011-2017
Key_Novelty: Domain-resolved five-year evidence that specific early-PD NPS profiles predict domain-specific cognitive decline rates and MCI occurrence
Primary_Limitation: Observational cohort with questionnaire-based NPS, 26% attrition and no biomarker adjudication of decline etiology
Open_Problems: Joint NPS-cognition trajectory modelling; biomarker-stratified analyses; causal designs; longer follow-up

Method_Architecture: Multivariable logistic regression and ROC analysis
Best_Metric: AUC 0.764; sensitivity 70.9%; specificity 69.5%
Dataset: Tehran Geriatric Eye Study, Iran
Key_Novelty: Objective NPC associated with MMSE-defined MCI in population-based geriatric sample
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional MMSE-only ascertainment with selected visual eligibility and no longitudinal validation
Open_Problems: Validate NPC threshold longitudinally with multi-domain cognitive adjudication and external cohorts

Modality: Claims-based antihypertensive and metabolic medication exposure
Method_Architecture: Cox proportional-hazards and medication-interaction modelling
Best_Metric: aHR 0.89-0.94 for selected antihypertensive-metformin/statin combinations
Dataset: Optum Clinformatics Data Mart claims, US
Key_Novelty: Large claims analysis of antihypertensive classes and interactions after MCI diagnosis
Primary_Limitation: Observational claims design with residual confounding and imperfect exposure/adherence measurement
Open_Problems: Target-trial emulation, independent validation and prospective testing of nominated combinations

Method_Architecture: Mixed-model repeated-measures observational analysis
Best_Metric: MMSE/CFI decline and monthly societal costs; no classification metric
Dataset: GERAS-US multicentre cohort
Sample_N_Approx: MCI and mild-AD cohorts; exact denominator not reported in reviewed extract
Key_Novelty: Three-year linkage of cognitive-functional decline with economic and caregiver burden
Primary_Limitation: Observational follow-up affected by pandemic disruption, dropout and self-reported resource use
Open_Problems: Joint clinical-economic trajectory modelling and service intervention evaluation
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia: Translational Research & Clinical Interventions

Method_Architecture: Multimarker CSF observational biomarker analysis
Best_Metric: NfL/p-NfH ratio higher in PD-MCI; p-tau, NfL and sTREM2 higher in worseners
Dataset: University of Perugia clinical CSF cohort, Italy
Key_Novelty: Broad CSF profile linked to two-year PD-MCI cognitive worsening
Primary_Limitation: Small retrospective single-centre study with incomplete follow-up and no pathological verification
Open_Problems: Larger multicentre longitudinal biomarker and neuropathological validation

Method_Architecture: Observational treatment-effect estimation with bootstrap confidence intervals
Best_Metric: ATE -0.1128 citalopram; -0.0560 escitalopram; -0.0140 rosuvastatin; -0.0201 omeprazole
Dataset: OMOP EHR, major urban academic medical centre, New York, USA
Key_Novelty: Common EHR framework comparing four drug classes after MCI diagnosis
Primary_Limitation: Single-centre observational EHR with residual confounding and uncertain medication exposure
Open_Problems: Target-trial emulation, negative controls, external replication and randomised testing

Method_Architecture: Prospective behavioural group comparison with repeated MMSE
Best_Metric: CMAI 62.79 converters vs 43.78 stable MCI; no AUC
Dataset: Mental Health Clinic outpatient cohort, northern Poland
Key_Novelty: Seven-year association between aggression/impulsivity and MCI prognosis
Primary_Limitation: Severe attrition and MMSE-only follow-up in a single outpatient clinic
Open_Problems: Multicentre cohorts with comprehensive cognition, repeated NPS and biomarker adjudication

Method_Architecture: Standardised regression-based practice-effect analysis
Best_Metric: Practice effects associated with cognition, depression and daily function; no AUC
Dataset: Community/clinic older-adult cohort, USA
Sample_N_Approx: 166 (69 intact; 52 amnestic MCI; 45 probable mild AD)
Key_Novelty: Broad clinical determinants of short-term neuropsychological practice effects
Primary_Limitation: One-week retest and selected highly educated sample limit generalisability
Open_Problems: Calibrate practice-effect correction across populations, intervals and alternate forms

Modality: Atrial fibrillation and longitudinal cognitive transitions
Method_Architecture: Logistic regression and age-scale Cox survival interaction modelling
Best_Metric: Women with AF: OR 3.43 MCI; HR 1.28 normal-to-MCI; HR 2.49 MCI-to-vascular-dementia
Dataset: National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center Uniform Data Set
Sample_N_Approx: 43630 source cohort; AF subset 1690 vs 11993 non-AF
Key_Novelty: Sex modifies AF-associated cognitive progression, with higher risk in women
Primary_Limitation: Observational multisite case series with centre-varying diagnosis and treatment confounding
Open_Problems: Population-based replication and sex-stratified causal treatment analyses

Method_Architecture: Eye-movement feature extraction with logistic regression and ML classification
Best_Metric: AUROC 0.840 combined demographics, MMSE and eye movement
Dataset: GARD cohort, South Korea
Key_Novelty: Two eye-movement paradigms improve MCI classification beyond demographics and MMSE
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional single-centre classifier without external or prospective validation
Open_Problems: External/prospective validation across devices, languages and disease stages

Modality: Qualitative social participation and digital literacy
Method_Architecture: Focus groups, semi-structured interviews and framework analysis
Best_Metric: Not applicable; qualitative themes, no classification metric
Dataset: Chinese community and care-centre participant groups
Key_Novelty: Integrated personal, environmental and digital barriers to MCI social participation
Primary_Limitation: Context-dependent qualitative findings with incomplete denominator and no prospective intervention evaluation
Open_Problems: Diverse-region co-design and prospective evaluation of participation supports

Modality: Longitudinal clinical signs/symptoms (Predictors battery) for progression modelling
Method_Architecture: Latent-subtype L-GoM transition-matrix survival modelling
Best_Metric: R-squared 0.194-0.241 predicted-vs-observed survival/FTC fit (C = 0.610)
Dataset: Predictors 3 Study community-based multiethnic cohort (Columbia University centres)
Key_Novelty: First community-based multiethnic validation of the L-GoM AD progression model, extended to MCI
Primary_Limitation: Modest predictive fit and 32 reverting AD diagnoses expose clinical-diagnosis instability in community cohorts
Open_Problems: Biomarker-confirmed staging, explicit reversion modelling, cross-system transportability tests

Modality: Structured psychosocial questionnaires in patient-carer dyads incl. Zarit Burden Scale
Method_Architecture: Quantitative survey with descriptive and correlational analysis
Best_Metric: 47% of carers at least mild Zarit burden; 21% of patients used the term MCI
Dataset: St James's Hospital Memory Clinic MCI patient-carer dyad cohort (Dublin, Ireland)
Key_Novelty: Quantifies limited MCI-diagnosis awareness and dyadic illness perception with carer burden
Primary_Limitation: Single-centre cross-sectional design with survivorship bias from excluding converted patients
Open_Problems: Longitudinal dyad follow-up and standardised disclosure protocols

Modality: 11C-PIB amyloid PET/CT with MMSE/MoCA neuropsychological scales (reviewed evidence)
Method_Architecture: Narrative literature review synthesis
Best_Metric: Not applicable; narrative synthesis of PET/CT and neuropsychological diagnostic evidence
Dataset: Published literature on 11C-PIB-PET/CT and neuropsychological testing in MCI/AD
Sample_N_Approx: Not reported in source (narrative review corpus)
Key_Novelty: Combines 11C-PIB PET/CT amyloid imaging with common neuropsychological scales for early diagnosis
Primary_Limitation: Narrative review without systematic search protocol, study count or quantitative synthesis
Open_Problems: Register-based systematic review with meta-analysis of PET/CT diagnostic accuracy

Modality: Baseline neuropsychological battery (MMSE, long-term memory, category fluency, fluency discrepancy)
Method_Architecture: Longitudinal group-comparison prognostic statistics
Best_Metric: Stable-vs-converter separation on MMSE, CFT and phonological-semantic discrepancy across timepoints
Dataset: Fondazione Policlinico Gemelli IRCCS Memory Clinic MCI cohort (Rome, Italy)
Key_Novelty: Shows semantic-memory and fluency-discrepancy markers flag conversion years before episodic decline
Primary_Limitation: Single-centre cohort without external validation and no adjusted effect sizes in the extract
Open_Problems: External validation, survival modelling with adjusted hazard ratios, biomarker combination

Modality: Pre-diagnosis prescription records (ATC-regrouped therapeutic indicators) from EMR
Method_Architecture: Latent class analysis with binomial logistic regression
Best_Metric: Mixed and cardio-metabolic profiles protective vs low-prescription profile (OR 0.421 / OR 0.278)
Dataset: Hospital Universitario Puerta del Mar MCI outpatient EMR cohort (Cadiz, Spain)
Key_Novelty: LCA phenotyping of pre-MCI prescriptions links cardio-metabolic profiles to lower conversion risk
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective single-centre records with indication confounding and unmeasured prescribing drivers
Open_Problems: Multi-centre replication with pharmacy-verified dispensing and time-varying exposure modelling

Modality: Wearable nine-axis postural-sway sensing during BBS/TUG ecological balance tasks
Method_Architecture: Sensor-feature ROC diagnostic-accuracy analysis
Best_Metric: Fall-discrimination accuracy 0.53-0.81 (sensitivity 0.82-0.99, specificity 0.69-0.90)
Dataset: Community rehabilitation centre cohort with MCI and young controls (Yonsei University, Wonju, Republic of Korea)
Sample_N_Approx: 40 - 20 young adults / 20 older adults with MCI at high fall risk
Key_Novelty: Portable nine-axis postural-sway sensing discriminates falls in high-risk MCI in ecological tasks
Primary_Limitation: Small convenience sample mixing young controls with MCI; no prospective fall outcomes
Open_Problems: Prospective fall follow-up, larger MCI-only samples, home-based validation

Modality: CSF amyloid-beta/p-tau plus structural MRI hippocampal volume ratio with NPI-Q severity
Method_Architecture: Severity-stratified biomarker regression modelling
Best_Metric: Severe-NPS vs no-NPS hippocampal ratio difference (coefficient 0.18, p=0.050; sign glyph lost in source extraction)
Dataset: Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) MCI and control cohorts
Key_Novelty: Severity-stratified NPS biomarker analysis isolates hippocampal atrophy as the severe-NPS correlate
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional ADNI secondary analysis with a borderline-significant sole finding
Open_Problems: Longitudinal conversion confirmation and non-ADNI replication

Modality: Japanese medical and long-term care claims records (LIFE Study, 17 municipalities)
Method_Architecture: Retrospective claims cohort with Kaplan-Meier analysis
Best_Metric: 30.9% of new-onset MCI progressed to AD within three years; first-year MCI cost $13,035
Dataset: LIFE Study Japanese medical and long-term care claims, 17 municipalities (2014-2021)
Key_Novelty: First Japanese claims-based burden and progression estimates for new-onset MCI including LTC costs
Primary_Limitation: Claims-based MCI ascertainment may over-represent consulted severe cases; expenditure estimates had overlapping intervals
Open_Problems: Claims phenotype validation against cognitive testing and competing-risk progression modelling

Modality: Routine clinic sociodemographic, vascular and neuropsychological variables (16) incl. MMSE
Method_Architecture: RoboMate machine learning classification model
Best_Metric: Accuracy 86% (sensitivity 72%, specificity 91%) on the 60-patient test set
Dataset: IRCCS Centro Neurolesi Bonino Pulejo dementia outpatient clinic dataset (Messina, Italy)
Key_Novelty: Big-data routine-variable MLM gives second-opinion MCI/AD discrimination using clinic MMSE data
Primary_Limitation: Same-clinic test set, unspecified algorithm internals and no external or prospective validation
Open_Problems: External multi-centre validation and transparent feature attribution

Modality: Specialist practice-pattern survey items (psychiatrists, PCPs, geriatricians, neurologists)
Method_Architecture: Quantitative cross-sectional physician survey with descriptive statistics
Best_Metric: 67% psychiatrist personal diagnosis share; 46% self-identified care coordinators
Dataset: US online physician survey panel (February-March 2021)
Key_Novelty: Quantifies the psychiatrist's diagnostic role and coordination gap in US MCI/mild-AD care

Primary_Limitation: Post-hoc observational modelling (not observed treatment); high attrition; pharma-funded; MMSE-based progression
Open_Problems: Observed-treatment-effect linkage; longer horizons; broader HRQoL; independent replication

Method_Architecture: Registry-based cohort; retrospective MCI-criteria application (Winblad vs Jak/Bondi); age-adjusted incidence-rate-ratio analysis
Best_Metric: Age-adjusted dementia incidence rate ratio 3.7 (95% CI 1.5-9.3) for SCDJak/Bondi
Dataset: Essex Memory Clinic routine healthcare database (1999-2023), UK
Key_Novelty: Shows MCI-rule used to exclude MCI in SCD changes dementia incidence 3.7-fold (Winblad vs Jak/Bondi)
Primary_Limitation: Single-memory-clinic registry with small SCD samples and a long retrospective window
Open_Problems: Multi-centre replication; harmonised SCD criteria; competing-risk outcomes

Method_Architecture: Longitudinal dispersion analysis; across- and within-domain indices; linear regression with SRB reliable-change outcomes
Best_Metric: Across-domain dispersion predicts subtle cognitive decline (SRB z-scores); none predicted diagnostic conversion
Dataset: Cognitive disorders clinic (Oregon Health & Science; Utah), US
Key_Novelty: Across-domain (not within-domain) dispersion is stable and predicts subtle MCI decline
Primary_Limitation: Single-clinic sample; results depend on battery composition; no biomarker linkage
Open_Problems: Harmonised dispersion methods; multi-site replication; longer follow-up; biomarker endpoints

Method_Architecture: Single-case longitudinal intra-nasal-insulin treatment; imaging (GMV, abeta) + cognitive + socio-pragmatic assessment
Best_Metric: Qualitative: 9-month INI increased GMV, lowered beta-amyloid, improved MCI/FAS and pragmatic scores (n=1)
Dataset: Single patient (EJ) case report, Ohio State University
Key_Novelty: Case: extended intra-nasal insulin improved GMV, abeta, cognition and pragmatics in IR MCI
Primary_Limitation: Single-case uncontrolled report; no blinding/statistics; cannot establish efficacy
Open_Problems: Controlled INI RCT in IR-MCI; standardised imaging/communicative endpoints

Modality: Neuroimaging (automated structural MRI volumetry - hippocampus, whole brain volume)
Method_Architecture: NeuroQuant automated MRI volumetry; logistic (conversion) + linear (CDR-SB) regression with MMSE/APOE adjustment
Best_Metric: Hippocampus + WBV associated with annual CDR-SB change; hippocampus (not WBV) with conversion (attenuated after MMSE adjustment)
Dataset: Oslo University Hospital memory clinic (SCD/MCI cohort, Norway)
Key_Novelty: NQ volumetry: hippocampus/WBV predict CDR-SB progression; conversion signal attenuates after MMSE
Primary_Limitation: Single-centre n=156; no external validation; conversion association not robust to MMSE adjustment
Open_Problems: Multi-centre validation; comparison to manual/subfield volumetry; longer follow-up

Modality: Clinical/Population (non-pharmaceutical multimodal group intervention; cognitive/physical/HR-QoL outcomes)
Method_Architecture: Group multimodal intervention (exercise + cognitive stimulation + health education); pre-post + external propensity-score/semi-Bayes control comparison
Best_Metric: Less MMSE decline vs external control (mean difference 2.25; PS-adjusted 2.26); CFI and 5Cog attention/reasoning improvement
Dataset: MCI patients, Kobe University Hospital memory clinic (Japan)
Key_Novelty: Group-delivered multimodal non-drug intervention slowed MMSE decline vs external control in MCI
Primary_Limitation: Single-arm, non-randomised external control, small sample; limited within-group cognitive change.
Open_Problems: RCT comparison; scale-up to community groups; longer-term durability and cost-effectiveness.

Modality: Clinical/Population (MCI-risk nomogram in SCD during physical examinations)
Method_Architecture: LASSO feature selection + multivariable logistic regression nomogram; C-index/calibration/DCA
Best_Metric: C-index 0.755 (0.681-0.830); good calibration (HL p=0.824) and DCA net benefit
Dataset: First Hospital of Jilin University medical center, China (physical-examination cohort)
Key_Novelty: Simple physical-examination nomogram (CR, age, family hypertension) predicts MCI in Chinese SCD patients
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional single-centre design; internal-only validation; moderate, imprecise discrimination.
Open_Problems: External multi-centre and longitudinal validation; biomarker augmentation; generalisability.

Method_Architecture: Machine learning on longitudinal wearable (Fitbit) physical-activity/heart-rate/sleep features
Best_Metric: AUC = 1.0 (perfect separation; pilot, likely overfit)
Dataset: UTHSC Houston pilot cohort (12 MCI, 8 controls), US
Key_Novelty: Fitness-tracker longitudinal HR/sleep/activity features perfectly separate MCI vs controls (n=20 pilot)
Primary_Limitation: Tiny pilot with AUC=1.0 (overfitting risk); no external validation; single device.
Open_Problems: Large-sample and longitudinal-conversion validation of wearable digital biomarkers for MCI.

Method_Architecture: FreeSurfer/FSL-FIRST + Iglesias nuclei parcellation; MANOVA + stepwise discriminant-function/ROC conversion prediction
Best_Metric: Nucleus reuniens predicts conversion with sensitivity 0.73, specificity 0.69
Dataset: ADNI-3 (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
Key_Novelty: Nucleus reuniens (thalamic) atrophy marks MCI-to-AD converters distinct from stable MCI
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional ADNI-3 data, small MCI subgroups, moderate discrimination, no external validation.
Open_Problems: Larger cohorts; external validation; longitudinal volumetry; multimodality (tau/amyloid) integration.
Journal: The Journal of Prevention of Alzheimer's Disease 2024;11(4):1030-1040

Method_Architecture: Longitudinal HRS cohort; Cox regression of MCI reversion to normal cognition vs progression to dementia, covariate-adjusted
Best_Metric: Lower neuroticism + higher openness/conscientiousness -> higher MCI reversion and lower dementia risk (Cox hazard associations)
Dataset: Health and Retirement Study (HRS), US national cohort
Sample_N_Approx: 1608 older adults with MCI at baseline
Key_Novelty: Personality traits (low N, high O/C, agreeableness) predict MCI reversion to normal vs progression to dementia
Primary_Limitation: Observational, single national cohort, algorithmic cognitive-status definition; residual confounding.
Open_Problems: Causal mediation of personality effects; biomarker integration; replication in diverse cohorts.
Journal: Journal of the American Medical Directors Association 2024;25(10):105175

Method_Architecture: Resting-state fMRI seed-based mPFC-ACC connectivity; group comparison + mediation analysis on semantic fluency
Best_Metric: mPFC-ACC rs-FC mediates MCI effect on semantic fluency (significant mediation)
Dataset: Far Eastern Memorial Hospital / Yuan Ze University cohort, Taiwan
Key_Novelty: mPFC-ACC resting connectivity mediates the MCI-semantic-fluency relationship (plausible causal pathway)
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional association/mediation; moderate sample; no external validation; single network.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal and causal designs; network-level mediators; validation in larger cohorts.

Method_Architecture: Consonant-vowel dichotic listening under attentional conditions; group comparison (control/MCI/dementia) + neuropsychological correlation
Best_Metric: Absence of right-ear advantage (symmetry) in MCI; forced-condition performance graded control > MCI > dementia
Dataset: UK older-adult cohort (Sheffield/Manchester centres)
Key_Novelty: Loss of dichotic right-ear asymmetry is a candidate MCI marker; forced-attention performance tracks progression
Primary_Limitation: Small pilot, cross-sectional, small subgroups, no longitudinal prediction; peripheral hearing confounds.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal prediction of dementia onset; larger samples; disentangling peripheral vs central hearing.

Method_Architecture: PALS prospective cohort; linear mixed models of motor (H&Y/UPDRS/PIGD), non-motor (NMSS), and cognitive domains; FDR correction
Best_Metric: PD-MCI faster progression in H&Y (0.11 vs 0.06), MDS-UPDRS-III (3.11 vs 1.90), PIGD, NMSS-perceptual, and cognitive-visuospatial domains
Dataset: Early Parkinson's Disease Longitudinal Singapore (PALS) cohort, Singapore
Key_Novelty: Comprehensive 5-year PD-MCI profile: faster motor, visuo-perceptual, and visuospatial decline than PD-NC
Primary_Limitation: Single-region cohort, 5-year attrition, observational; no biomarker stratification.
Open_Problems: Predicting PDD conversion; biomarker integration; modifiable-progression intervention testing.

Modality: Clinical/Population (multi-state Markov modeling of MCI-AD-mortality and medication risk factors)
Method_Architecture: Three-state Multi-state Markov model; hazard-ratio estimation for diabetes/hypertension/hypercholesterolemia medications
Best_Metric: Multi-state Markov transition probabilities and medication hazard ratios across MCI/AD/mortality
Dataset: National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center (NACC), US
Key_Novelty: NACC Markov model quantifies MCI-AD-mortality transitions and medications as modifiable risk factors
Primary_Limitation: Referral-cohort generalisability; observational medication effects; Markov model assumptions.
Open_Problems: Population-representative validation; causal medication estimates; time-varying modeling.

Method_Architecture: eZIS SPECT severity/extent/ratio; regression + ROC with optimal cutoff for 3-year MCI-to-dementia conversion
Best_Metric: eZIS severity predicts conversion with AUC 0.719, cutoff 1.22
Dataset: National Cheng Kung University Hospital (NCKUH) memory clinic, Taiwan
Key_Novelty: eZIS SPECT severity (AD-pattern hypoperfusion) predicts 3-year MCI-to-dementia conversion (AUC 0.719)
Primary_Limitation: Single-centre retrospective n=86; moderate AUC; no amyloid/tau confirmation.
Open_Problems: Multicentre validation; amyloid-verified subgroups; comparison with MRI/FDG markers.

Method_Architecture: Backward-stepwise logistic-regression MCI risk calculator (CGMCI-Risk) with bootstrap + temporal validation
Best_Metric: AUROC 0.781 (internal) / 0.782 (external temporal)
Dataset: Chinese Longitudinal Healthy Longevity Survey (CLHLS) 2008-2011 / 2011-2014
Key_Novelty: Validated, no-biomarker community MCI risk calculator (CGMCI-Risk) with temporal external validation (AUROC 0.782)
Primary_Limitation: Single-country cohort; community-only; excludes imaging/lab/gene predictors; unproven cross-cultural generalisability.
Open_Problems: External multi-centre validation; cross-validation with objective/wearable data; predictive utility for conversion/dementia endpoints.

Method_Architecture: Weibull survival analysis of PT- and SP-ECog-12 for CDR-SB progression and diagnostic conversion
Best_Metric: SP ECog-12: CDR-SB worsening HR 9.61 (CU); CU->MCI HR 6.24; MCI->dementia HR 3.07
Dataset: Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) GO/2/3
Sample_N_Approx: ~1320 ADNI (CU 537, MCI 611, dementia 174; conversion 510 CU/602 MCI)
Key_Novelty: 12-item ECog (PT/SP) predicts CDR-SB progression and conversion across AD spectrum; SP ratings more prognostic
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective baseline-only ECog; ADNI ethnocultural/educational homogeneity limits generalisability.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal ECog validation; diverse-population replication (ADNI4); integration with objective function measures.

Method_Architecture: Adjusted Cox proportional-hazards with sex x motor-sign interactions (NACC UDS)
Best_Metric: Masked facies HR 4.21, resting tremor HR 4.71, bradykinesia HR 3.43 (exclusive DLB)
Dataset: National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center Uniform Data Set (NACC UDS)
Key_Novelty: Individual motor signs (masked facies/resting tremor/bradykinesia) exclusively predict incident DLB in MCI, with sex-specific effects
Primary_Limitation: Low DLB event count; motor-ADL overlap across dementias; sex interactions partly non-significant.
Open_Problems: Larger DLB-conversion cohorts; sex-specific replication; combined motor-sign signatures.

Modality: Clinical/Population (delirium assessment, cognitive, and AI modeling longitudinal cohort)
Method_Architecture: Prospective longitudinal MDD Cohort (delirium vs non-delirium) with survival/Cox analyses and AI MCI-to-dementia prediction (protocol)
Best_Metric: not reported (protocol)
Dataset: Korean long-term care MDDCohort (delirium vs non-delirium)
Key_Novelty: Prospective multicentre MDDCohort linking delirium onset to MCI-to-dementia conversion with an AI predictor (protocol)
Primary_Limitation: Protocol study with no reported results; Korea long-term-care setting.
Open_Problems: Dementia conversion after delirium in MCI; AI prediction algorithm performance.

Method_Architecture: OMOP-CDM distributed network; propensity-matched Cox meta-analysis of choline alfoscerate on MCI-to-dementia conversion
Best_Metric: HR 0.93 (0.59-1.26) all-cause dementia; 1.05 (0.51-1.59) ADD (null)
Dataset: Three Korean hospital databases (OMOP Common Data Model)
Key_Novelty: Distributed OMOP-CDM real-world evidence of no CA effect on MCI-to-dementia or ADD conversion (HR 0.93/1.05, null)
Primary_Limitation: Observational single-country CDM; residual confounding; outcome-definition heterogeneity.
Open_Problems: RCT/longer follow-up replication; time-varying exposure; multi-country CDM validation.

Method_Architecture: NACC trajectory comparison of NC-AD vs NC-MCI-AD groups (longitudinal visits)
Best_Metric: Group differences in cognitive/functional scores and yearly decline rates at diagnosis and during AD stage
Dataset: National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center (NACC) UDS
Key_Novelty: Direct vs MCI-intermediate NC-to-AD conversion trajectories compared; NC-AD faster post-onset functional decline
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective NACC data; small trajectory sample; no biomarker (amyloid/tau) confirmation.
Open_Problems: Biomarker validation; larger trajectory cohorts; mechanism/risk-factor distinctions.

Method_Architecture: Latent Class Analysis of multimorbidity patterns (vascular/metabolic)
Best_Metric: 3-class LCA model best fit; shared hypertension/diabetes prevalence between Dementia and MCI classes
Dataset: Instituto de Neurociencias, Junta de Beneficencia de Guayaquil, Ecuador
Key_Novelty: LCA-identified multimorbidity classes in MCI/dementia in an ageing Ecuadorian population; shared vascular-metabolic risk
Primary_Limitation: Single-centre retrospective; self-reported history; moderate subsample; no longitudinal outcomes.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal cohort validation; multi-centre cohorts; objective comorbidity/biomarker data.

Modality: Clinical/Population (comprehensive geriatric cohort - neuropsych, health, lab)
Method_Architecture: Population-based prospective aging cohort (KLoSHA) with normative/epidemiologic outputs
Best_Metric: Prevalence/risk-factor estimates and normative neuropsychological data
Dataset: Korean Longitudinal Study on Health and Aging (KLoSHA), Seongnam
Key_Novelty: Population-based Korean aging cohort (KLoSHA) with comprehensive baseline epidemiology and normative data
Primary_Limitation: Cohort overview with limited reported results; single-city Seongnam sampling.
Open_Problems: Full disease-incidence/progression outputs; expansion beyond one city.

Method_Architecture: Longitudinal cohort of SCI/aMCI groups; incidence of stroke/AMI and dementia progression
Best_Metric: 2-yr MVE 7.4%/12.17%/8.57% (SCI/aMCI-SD/aMCI-MD); aMCI-MD 37% dementia progression
Dataset: IRCCS Casa Sollievo della Sofferenza geriatrics cohort (Italy)
Key_Novelty: MCI/SCI as alert for major vascular events; higher stroke/AMI incidence and 37% aMCI-MD dementia progression
Primary_Limitation: Small single-centre sample; short early event window; observational.
Open_Problems: Larger cohorts; longer follow-up; vascular imaging/biomarker confirmation.

Method_Architecture: Secondary analysis of IHCNP; longitudinal MMSE/MoCA/RAVLT tracking over 18 months
Best_Metric: End-of-study decline MMSE -8.7%, MoCA -10.0%, RAVLT -29.5% (p<0.0001)
Dataset: IHCNP study (Romania) post-ischemic-stroke MCI
Key_Novelty: Quantifies 18-month post-stroke MCI cognitive decline (MMSE -8.7%/MoCA -10.0%/RAVLT -29.5%)
Primary_Limitation: Secondary analysis; single-country n=100; no dementia-conversion endpoint.
Open_Problems: Conversion outcomes; multicentre replication; imaging/biomarker correlates.

Modality: Clinical/Population (demographic + dietary questionnaire + routine serological markers)
Method_Architecture: Logistic-regression nomogram predictive model for MCI (MoCA <26 cut-off); 7:3 train/test; ROC/calibration/DAC
Dataset: Wuxi People's Hospital of Nanjing Medical University memory-clinic cohort (China)
Key_Novelty: Clinic-ready nomogram fusing diet and routine serum (RBC, NLR, LDL/HDL) for elderly MCI prediction
Primary_Limitation: Single-centre, MoCA-only grouping, no external validation.
Open_Problems: External validation; biomarker and immune-marker incorporation; prospective confirmation.

Modality: Clinical/Population epidemiology (sociodemographic + vascular risk factors with plasma AD biomarkers)
Method_Architecture: Multinomial logistic regression + propensity score matching + linear mixed effects; biomarker correlations
Best_Metric: Shared risk factors age/female/rural/low education/stroke; progression via age/education/HTN/epilepsy; NfL/GFAP/Abeta40/Abeta42-40 correlations
Dataset: Chongqing community-based multistage stratified cluster sample (China)
Key_Novelty: Largest community cohort linking MCI/dementia/progression risk factors to AD blood biomarkers
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional design; cannot confirm causal mediation of biomarkers.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal validation; causal mediation; replication across regions.

Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional MoCA-based prevalence study; two-way ANOVA + Pearson correlation
Best_Metric: MCI prevalence 42.86% (male) / 40.54% (female); education-MoCA r=0.608 (p=0.0001); 65.38% of 40-49y group
Dataset: Amamoma, Cape Coast North Metropolis community sample (Ghana)
Key_Novelty: First MCI-prevalence and education-MoCA profiling for the Cape Coast Metropolis, Ghana
Primary_Limitation: Small pilot convenience sample; locally unvalidated MoCA cutoff.
Open_Problems: Larger representative samples; local MoCA validation; longitudinal progression.

Modality: Neuroimaging (structural MRI entorhinal-cortex subfield volumetry) + plasma biomarkers
Method_Architecture: Randomized placebo-controlled 78-week trial; ASHS hippocampal-subfield MRI segmentation; plasma biomarker correlation
Best_Metric: Left ERC atrophy significantly reduced vs placebo; correlated with less CDR-SB decline and lower plasma NfL
Dataset: HOPE4MCI (NCT03486938) multicentre (US/Canada, 29 sites)
Key_Novelty: AGB101 slows entorhinal-cortex atrophy tied to CDR-SB/NfL in APOE e4 non-carriers
Primary_Limitation: Exploratory post-hoc e4 non-carrier subgroup (n=44); parent primary endpoint non-significant.
Open_Problems: Confirmatory e4 non-carrier trial; longer-term neuropathological/clinical outcomes; mechanism of APOE-e4 modulation.
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia: Translational Research & Clinical Interventions 2024;10:e70004

Modality: Clinical/Population (sociodemographic, clinical, psychological and transplant-related risk factors)
Method_Architecture: Logistic-regression risk-prediction model for post-HSCT MCI with external validation; ROC/calibration
Best_Metric: AUC 0.897 (training) / 0.789 (external validation); good calibration both sets
Dataset: Malignant-haematological-disease patients post-HSCT (development cohort 282; external 2022-2023)
Key_Novelty: First externally-validated MCI risk-prediction model for post-HSCT malignant-haematology patients
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective; scale-based cognitive outcome; limited external cohort.
Open_Problems: Prospective multicentre validation; biomarker augmentation; modifiable-risk-target studies.

Method_Architecture: Phenomenological qualitative design; semi-structured interviews; thematic analysis
Best_Metric: Themes: inappropriate MCI perceptions, elder self-neglect, and lack of information/support services
Dataset: Community-dwelling MCI older adults in Hubei, Jiangsu, Henan, Anhui provinces (China)
Key_Novelty: Patient-perspective typology of Chinese community-dwelling MCI self-management barriers
Primary_Limitation: Small purposive qualitative sample; limited transferability.
Open_Problems: Mixed-methods quantification; intervention effectiveness on barriers.

Method_Architecture: Longitudinal cohort; logistic regression + Random Forest classifier for MCI-to-dementia conversion
Best_Metric: Random Forest AUC 0.7347 (MCI-C vs MCI-NC); converters female/older/more impaired; physical activity protective
Dataset: Italian Interceptor multicentre CDCD cohort (500 enrolled/356 analysed)
Key_Novelty: Nation-wide Italian MCI converter profile with Random Forest AUC and physical-activity protection
Primary_Limitation: Moderate AUC; no external validation; observational.
Open_Problems: Biomarker-integrated and externally validated conversion models.

Method_Architecture: PPMI longitudinal cohort; multilevel (group x time) trajectory models with normative classification
Best_Metric: Superagers better 10-year global cognition + less depression/anxiety + favourable motor trajectories (group x time)
Dataset: Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI), newly diagnosed PD
Key_Novelty: First identification of cognitive super-agers in PD with favourable 10-year trajectories
Primary_Limitation: Superager definition arbitrary; observational; enriched cohort.
Open_Problems: Consensus criteria; biological substrate; trial-enrichment validation.

Modality: Behavioural/Digital (functional upper-limb motor task timing + cognitive/functional scales)
Method_Architecture: Longitudinal; functional upper-limb motor task; regression-based change (ZSRB) prediction
Best_Metric: Motor-task variability predicted MMSE/QDRS one-year change, eta2 = 0.04-0.05 (FDR-corrected)
Dataset: Local Utah cohort (ADNI classification battery)
Key_Novelty: Brief upper-limb motor task predicts one-year MMSE/QDRS decline via performance variability
Primary_Limitation: Modest homogeneous sample; small effect sizes; one-year horizon.
Open_Problems: Larger/diverse validation; multi-year follow-up; mechanism of variability signal.

Method_Architecture: Systematic review & meta-analysis (random-effects; meta-regression); PRISMA
Best_Metric: Conversion risk 41.5% (clinical) / 27.0% (population); stability ~49% both; reversion 8.7% / 28.2%
Dataset: 89 cohort studies (clinical + population-based), mean follow-up 5.2 y
Key_Novelty: Updated multi-setting meta-analytic benchmark of MCI conversion, stability and reversion
Primary_Limitation: High between-study heterogeneity; setting-dependent; limited LMIC data.
Open_Problems: Standardized criteria; long-term population cohorts; LMIC representation.
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia: Diagnosis, Assessment & Disease Monitoring 2025;17:e70074

Method_Architecture: Multivariate Cox proportional hazard (FreeSurfer+GRETNA feature fusion); nomogram
Best_Metric: C-index 0.951 (train) / 0.880 (validation) morphology-network-clinical model
Dataset: ADNI
Key_Novelty: GRETNA network + morphology-clinical Cox model; MCI-to-AD C-index 0.88 external split
Primary_Limitation: ADNI-only internal split; T1WI-only; no external cohort validation.
Open_Problems: External multi-centre validation; additional sequences/biomarkers; deep-learning feature comparison.

Method_Architecture: Systematic review + random-effects meta-analysis (Cohen d)
Best_Metric: Cohen d emotion 0.69 / ToM 0.70 (MCI vs AD); FTD 2.09/1.49
Dataset: 28 pooled cross-sectional studies (systematic review)
Key_Novelty: First meta-analysis of MCI vs AD/FTD gaps in emotion recognition, ToM, empathy
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional studies only; heterogeneous measures; sparse empathy data.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal social-cognition tracking; harmonised measures; AD vs FTD diagnostic role.

Modality: Olfactory (Sniffin' Sticks) + sMRI VBM gray-matter volume
Method_Architecture: ROC + voxel-based morphometry correlation (olfaction+volume)
Best_Metric: DT AUC 0.8 (HC vs MCI); cMCI-sMCI DT 0.7 / IT 0.6
Dataset: Single-centre cohort (27 MCI + 35 HC)
Key_Novelty: Combines olfaction (DT/IT) with olfactory-cortex VBM atrophy to flag MCI converters pre-AD
Primary_Limitation: Small single-centre sample (27 MCI); modest cMCI AUC; cross-sectional structure.
Open_Problems: Multi-centre validation; longitudinal VBM; combined CSF/PET biomarkers.

Method_Architecture: PRISMA-ScR scoping review (descriptive synthesis)
Best_Metric: Qualitative: combined exercise improves global cognition; resistance promising
Dataset: 10 pooled international RCTs (scoping review)
Key_Novelty: Scoping review of exercise modalities with cognitive outcomes that slow MCI decline in older adults
Primary_Limitation: Scoping (non-meta-analytic) design; only 10 studies; no sex or dose-response analysis.
Open_Problems: Dedicated US RCTs; meta-analytic pooling; sex-stratified dose-response.

Method_Architecture: Cox proportional-hazard regression (IADL+MCI combination)
Best_Metric: HR 2.88 (1.65-5.03) MCI+IADL vs unimpaired without limitation
Dataset: National Center for Geriatrics population cohort (Japan)
Key_Novelty: Technology-updated NCGG-ADL IADL scale; quantifies combined MCI+IADL dementia risk (HR 2.88)
Primary_Limitation: Self-reported IADL; single-country Japan; 5-year follow-up.
Open_Problems: Objective IADL measures; external multi-country validation; subtype stratification.

Method_Architecture: Cox proportional-hazard + linear mixed-effect longitudinal modelling
Best_Metric: AD-dementia HR 0.104 (0.033-0.335) reverters vs stable MCI
Dataset: ADNI (ADNI-1, ADNI-GO, ADNI-2, ADNI-3)
Sample_N_Approx: 796 non-demented (109 reverters / 334 stable MCI / 353 stable NC)
Key_Novelty: ADNI MCI reverters have AD-dementia hazard (HR 0.104) matching stable NC across four domains
Primary_Limitation: Reversion defined by 2-year diagnosis change; ADNI-derived; possible diagnostic instability.
Open_Problems: Community validation; standardised reversion criteria; biomarker-informed reversion.

Modality: Prescription digital therapeutic simulation (modifiable risk factors)
Method_Architecture: Monte Carlo simulation with multiplicative risk adjustments
Best_Metric: 25% progression to MCI over 5y vs 41% expected (RRR-modelled)
Dataset: 10,000 simulated SCD virtual cohort (2024 Lancet Commission params)
Key_Novelty: Monte Carlo model of PDT + all 14 Lancet risk factors in SCD (25% vs 41% 5-yr MCI)
Primary_Limitation: Simulation only; risk factors assumed independent; static adherence/dropout.
Open_Problems: Real-world pilot/pragmatic trial; conditional-probability models; longitudinal adherence.

Method_Architecture: Functional multistate model (MVFPCA/MLFPCA transition probabilities)
Best_Metric: Reversion probability up to 8% (yr 10); post-rev progression-to-MCI 35.71% (yr 10)
Dataset: ADNI-sourced retrospective cohort 2005-Dec 2022
Key_Novelty: Multistate model quantifying MCI reversion (2-8%) and post-reversion re-progression (~36%)
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective ADNI-sourced cohort; visit-driven diagnosis; measurement-error transitions.
Open_Problems: Prospective external cohorts; standardised reversion criteria; CSF/PET markers.

Method_Architecture: Survival analysis of Conventional (Petersen/Winblad) vs Neuropsychological (Jak/Bondi) criteria
Best_Metric: Comparable dementia risk across criteria; Neuropsychological consistency 63.2% vs 43.2%
Dataset: InveCe.Ab population-based cohort (Italy)
Key_Novelty: 12-yr MCI criteria comparison: comparable dementia risk, differing stability (63.2% vs 43.2%)
Primary_Limitation: Single Italian non-clinical cohort; retrospective criteria application.
Open_Problems: Multi-centre replication; harmonised batteries; biomarker-informed criteria.

Method_Architecture: Propensity-matched cohort; healthcare cost + AD-dementia incidence analysis
Best_Metric: AD-dementia 5-yr incidence rate ratio 7.2 (3.3-15.7); inpatient +7.6% / primary care +9.1%
Dataset: UK Biobank matched cohort (linked health records)
Key_Novelty: Matched UK Biobank cohort quantifying MCI healthcare cost (+7.6%) and 7.2x AD-dementia incidence
Primary_Limitation: UK Biobank healthy-volunteer selection; cognitive-score-based MCI; cost-coding detail.
Open_Problems: Clinical MCI definitions; granular cost categories; social/informal care costs.
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia: Diagnosis, Assessment & Disease Monitoring

Method_Architecture: Time-varying linear mixed models (ACE-R change) + multi-state Markov model for core-feature accumulation
Best_Metric: ACE-R decline -2.9 pts/yr overall; -1.1 pts/yr per additional DLB feature (p<0.001); 1-yr new-feature probability 25.5%
Dataset: Two prospective Newcastle MCI-LB cohorts (NE England; not public)
Key_Novelty: Time-varying DLB clinical-feature accumulation predicts faster MCI-LB cognitive decline
Primary_Limitation: Baseline-only DLB features do not predict long-term decline; annual assessment may misalign feature emergence with decline timing; single-region cohort.
Open_Problems: More intensive longitudinal cognition; repeated biomarker imaging; post-dementia cognitive outcomes; ACE-R alternatives sensitive to MCI-LB.

Method_Architecture: Bibliometric analysis (CiteSpace + VOSviewer networks, keyword/reference burst and timeline analyses)
Best_Metric: Publication counts/trends (R2=0.9593 growth); 132 papers 2021, 109 in 2023; US 392 (32.05%)
Dataset: Web of Science Core Collection 2005-2024
Key_Novelty: First 20-year bibliometric map of gait-in-MCI research hotspots
Primary_Limitation: Single database (WoS) inclusion; bibliometric metrics proxy activity, not study quality; small heterogeneous primary studies.
Open_Problems: Protocol standardisation; multi-centre collaboration; gait-derived digital biomarkers as actionable MCI tools.

Method_Architecture: Cox-IC and RF-I (interval-censored random forest, weighted Kaplan-Meier); forward feature selection; MCCV; external NACC-v3
Best_Metric: IC Brier score RF-I 0.095 (AD); LB RF-I 72% vs RF-R 56% correct prediction
Dataset: National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center (NACC v1v2 train, v3 validate)
Key_Novelty: Interval-censored ML survival (RF-I) with pathology-specific AD vs LB conversion predictors
Primary_Limitation: Very small LB cohort (n=37, 9 stable); external AD-conversion prediction near chance; mixed AD+LB pathology attribution.
Open_Problems: Larger LB external cohorts; emerging biomarkers; better mixed-pathology resolution.

Method_Architecture: Florey Fusion Model: MCI classifier + separate cognition predictors; SVM/GB/RF; nested stratified 3-fold CV; web simulation + missing-data trials
Best_Metric: mAUC-ROC 0.91 MCI-to-AD; mMAE 1.32 CDR-SB / 1.51 MMSE (3-yr)
Dataset: AIBL (development 238; validation 30)
Key_Novelty: Non-invasive web-based fusion model jointly predicting MCI-to-AD conversion
Primary_Limitation: AIBL-specific homogeneous cohort (highly educated, low comorbidity); no imaging/CSF predictors; classifier-dependent accuracy.
Open_Problems: Diverse external validation; brain-imaging predictors; amyloid-beta outcome redevelopment.

Method_Architecture: Longitudinal k-means (kml) GDS trajectory clustering; sex-stratified linear mixed models; Cox proportional hazards
Best_Metric: HR 2.69 (rapidly-increasing men); MMSE decline -0.873/yr (Cluster C men); null in women
Dataset: Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI)
Key_Novelty: First sex-stratified longitudinal depressive-trajectory modelling of MCI decline/conversion (effect in men only)
Primary_Limitation: ADNI sample with no clinical depression at baseline; observational; sex-specific mechanisms unexamined.
Open_Problems: Cohorts incl. clinical depression; capture of treatment; longer follow-up; mechanism studies.

Method_Architecture: ML survival analysis: Cox, Rpart, RSF, fast-RSF, CVGlmnet, DeepSurv, DeepHit, CoxTime over four feature sets; bootstrapping; PDP
Best_Metric: C-index 0.84 (fast-RSF/DeepSurv); bootstrapped 0.8607; external AIBL 0.73-0.77
Dataset: ADNI (development) + AIBL (external validation)
Key_Novelty: Baseline comorbidity features improve CN-to-MCI prediction (C-index 0.84)
Primary_Limitation: Comorbidity associations are non-causal; modest conversion events; cross-cohort feature alignment requires imputation.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal features; biomarkers; larger diverse cohorts.

Modality: Dementia risk-score comparison for MCI prediction (ARIC/Whitehall-II/PATH)
Method_Architecture: Logistic regression AUC with four risk scores (CogDrisk, ANU-ADRI, CAIDE, LIBRA); sensitivity + multiple-imputation analyses
Best_Metric: NA
Dataset: ARIC, Whitehall II, PATH Through Life cohorts
Key_Novelty: First multi-tool, multi-dataset comparison of dementia risk scores for MCI prediction
Primary_Limitation: Risk scores designed for dementia, not MCI; heterogeneous MCI definitions across cohorts; modest overall AUCs.
Open_Problems: Risk-tool recalibration; harmonised MCI definitions; prospective validation; biomarker combination.
Journal: The Journal of Prevention of Alzheimer's Disease

Modality: Health-economic microsimulation of CI/ADRD/MCI burden (US adults)
Method_Architecture: Future Elderly Model microsimulation on HRS 2000-2016; QALY valuation $150k/yr; subgroup burden decomposition
Best_Metric: Per-capita CI burden $124K; aggregate $627B (41% MCI); EO-CI $376K
Dataset: Health and Retirement Study (HRS) + Future Elderly Model simulation
Key_Novelty: Quantifies inclusive CI (ADRD+MCI) and early-onset burden; MCI = 41% of total
Primary_Limitation: Model-based microsimulation assumptions; $150K/QALY valuation choice; projection rather than measured outcomes.
Open_Problems: Real intervention cost-effectiveness; granular MCI screening; validation against CI definitions.

Method_Architecture: MRF (glasso/qgraph) network analysis; TIB premorbid intelligence; logistic + multiple regression for MCI progression
Best_Metric: OR 4.06 (APOE4) / 0.88 (TIB) for progression; 76% correct classification; R2 32.9%
Dataset: CRIDEM, Careggi Hospital Florence (PREVIEW cohort)
Key_Novelty: Female CR disadvantage in SCD not socio-culturally mediated; CR (not gender) predicts progression
Primary_Limitation: No biomarker data; generation as a simplistic socio-cultural proxy; single-centre predominantly white Italian cohort.
Open_Problems: Biomarker-informed studies; direct occupation/education/leisure measures; diverse cohorts.
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia: Diagnosis, Assessment & Disease Monitoring

Modality: Bayesian joint longitudinal (MMSE/CDR-SB) + survival AD prediction
Method_Architecture: MFMM joint longitudinal-survival modelling with FPCA and six association structures; BMA (stacking, pseudo-BMA+); Stan MCMC
Best_Metric: C-index 0.777 (stacking ADNI) / 0.743 (NACC); pseudo-BMA+ 0.771/0.738
Dataset: ADNI (training) + NACC (external validation)
Key_Novelty: Bayesian model averaging over multivariate functional mixed association structures generalises AD-dementia prediction
Primary_Limitation: Relies on MMSE/CDR-SB only; accuracy accrues with repeated assessments; no neuroimaging/biomarker integration.
Open_Problems: Multimodal (neuroimaging/biomarker) predictors; cognitively normal population; real-world implementation.

Method_Architecture: NA
Best_Metric: NA (no empirical metric)
Dataset: NA (global policy report; no dataset)
Key_Novelty: Global post-diagnosis care report: staging + treatment/care/support across cultures
Primary_Limitation: Consensus/advocacy document without primary data or methodology; usable for context only, not analysis.
Open_Problems: Equitable scalable post-diagnostic support; country-specific staged-care implementation.
Journal: World Alzheimer Report 2022; Alzheimer's Disease International

Method_Architecture: Narrative review synthesising published SCD/MCI sMRI and dMRI studies
Best_Metric: not reported (narrative synthesis; no pooled metric)
Dataset: Synthesised SCD/MCI sMRI and dMRI cohorts (multiple; no single dataset)
Sample_N_Approx: Not reported - narrative review across multiple cohorts
Key_Novelty: Structured synthesis of sMRI + dMRI markers for SCD-MCI; subfield/basal-forebrain/temporoparietal
Primary_Limitation: Narrative, non-meta-analytic synthesis; no pooled quantification; heterogeneous included cohorts.
Open_Problems: Harmonised imaging protocols; meta-analysis pooling; biomarker-informed validation.

Modality: C5 Clinical/Population (comorbidities, APOE genotype, MCI-to-AD conversion)
Method_Architecture: Doubly-robust Cox regression with propensity-score weighting and comorbidity x APOE interaction
Best_Metric: HR 7.6 (e4/4 + diabetes and hypertension) for MCI-to-AD; HR 1.17/1.20 for combined conditions
Dataset: NACC (National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center)
Key_Novelty: Combined-comorbidity + APOE-e4 synergy on MCI-to-AD: e4/4 + diabetes-hypertension HR 7.6
Primary_Limitation: Observational cohort with potentially selective enrollment and self-selected APOE testing.
Open_Problems: Prospective replication; APOE-stratified comorbidity impact on progression.

Modality: Clinical/Population (cardiometabolic conditions and dementia subtype progression; EHR)
Method_Architecture: Kaplan-Meier + Cox regression with propensity-score matching on federated EHR
Best_Metric: HR 1.33 (T2 diabetes, vascular dementia); HR 1.21 (hyperlipidemia, AD dementia)
Dataset: TriNetX Analytics federated US EHR network
Key_Novelty: Condition-specific MCI-to-dementia HRs in matched EHR; diabetes to vascular, hyperlipidemia to AD
Primary_Limitation: Single TriNetX network with residual confounding from heterogeneous EHR coding.
Open_Problems: External cohort replication; subtype-specific intervention evaluation.

Modality: Clinical/Population (T2DM clinical + laboratory features; MCI prediction)
Method_Architecture: Extra Trees ensemble with recursive feature elimination and SHAP interpretation
Best_Metric: Extra Trees AUC 0.9667 (Acc 0.9310, F1 0.9333)
Dataset: Cheikh Khalifa Ibn Zaid hospital prospective T2DM cohort (Casablanca, Morocco)
Key_Novelty: Diabetic retinopathy primary ML predictor of MCI in T2DM (Extra Trees AUC 0.967; SHAP)
Primary_Limitation: Single-site prospective T2DM cohort; modest sample; no external validation.
Open_Problems: Larger multi-site T2DM cohorts; external and prospective validation.

Method_Architecture: CNN on FDG-PET producing an AD-dementia similarity score; Cox regression
Best_Metric: iAUC 0.787 vs 0.768 baseline (ADNI MCI; Delta 0.020); HR 3.45 DL output
Dataset: ADNI (development + MCI), J-ADNI (MCI), HABS (NC)
Key_Novelty: Repurposes FDG-PET AD-vs-NC deep learning for cross-stage pre-dementia prognosis; beats SUVR
Primary_Limitation: FDG-PET only; ethnicity imbalance only partially addressed by J-ADNI; small NC-progressor sets.
Open_Problems: Multi-modal (MRI/tau PET) integration; broader ethnic cohorts.

Modality: Neuroimaging (FDG-PET MetaROI metabolism; longitudinal pathway modeling)
Method_Architecture: Competing-risks (Fine-Gray) regression + multinomial logistic pathway prediction on ADNI
Best_Metric: Direct AD conversion AUC 0.994 (36-month); direct-conversion velocity 7.4x (17.12 vs 2.31 per 100 PY)
Dataset: ADNI (cognitively normal participants)
Key_Novelty: Models progression pathway selection via competing risks; FDG hypometabolism as pathway determinant
Primary_Limitation: ADNI-only single-cohort; pathway thresholds without external validation; sequential AUC only acceptable.
Open_Problems: External validation of pathway thresholds; prospective verification of FDG z-score cutpoints.

Modality: C4 Behavioural/Cognitive (MMSE + Clock Drawing Test, clinical routine data)
Method_Architecture: Multivariate binary logistic regression + nomogram (score 0-14)
Best_Metric: AUC 0.825 (0.74-0.91) for 3-year dementia prediction; OR hypercholesterolemia 3.9
Dataset: Center for Cognitive Disorders and Dementia, Dolo Hospital, Italy (single-centre)
Key_Novelty: Simple routine-data nomogram (hypercholesterolemia+MMSE+CDT); AUC 0.825 without biomarkers
Primary_Limitation: Small retrospective single-centre sample with no internal/external validation; excludes non-AD subtypes.
Open_Problems: Independent validation in larger prospective cohorts; add routine predictors.

Method_Architecture: Mixed-method focus groups with NVivo thematic analysis and readability/Likert assessment
Best_Metric: Materials usefulness rated 4.9 +/- 0.4 (1-5); Flesch-Kincaid grade 7.9
Dataset: Tennessee Alzheimer's Project (TAP) convenience cohort, Vanderbilt
Key_Novelty: First p-tau blood-biomarker risk-disclosure materials co-developed with patients/care partners
Primary_Limitation: Small single-site convenience sample; thematic saturation not fully confirmed.
Open_Problems: Larger diverse samples; clinical implementation and psychological-impact studies.
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia: Translational Research & Clinical Interventions

Modality: Clinical/Population (polypharmacy geriatric medication exposure; CDR-based progression)
Method_Architecture: Longitudinal cohort with Kaplan-Meier + Cox proportional hazards regression
Best_Metric: Adjusted HR 0.49 (95% CI 0.31-0.78) for dementia progression with polypharmacy
Dataset: Kaohsiung Veterans General Hospital + Veterans Homes cohort (Taiwan)
Key_Novelty: Polypharmacy (HR 0.49) lowers MCI-to-dementia progression; medication type, not count, drives it
Primary_Limitation: Observational with confounding by indication; single-country veterans-based cohort; annual CDR granularity.
Open_Problems: Validation in diverse cohorts; dose-response and longitudinal medication-change modeling.
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia: Translational Research & Clinical Interventions

Modality: Amyloid/tau PET + sMRI cortical thickness + SSRI medication records (ADNI)
Method_Architecture: IPTW + 1:1 propensity-score-matched Cox PH; Kaplan-Meier; linear mixed models; MICE; duration analysis
Best_Metric: Adjusted HR 1.64 (0.61-4.38) SSRI vs non-use for MCI-to-AD progression (null)
Dataset: ADNI (primary) + Singapore memory-clinic validation cohort
Key_Novelty: First A-beta/tau-stratified SSRI test in aMCI: null on progression, cognition and amyloid
Primary_Limitation: Observational SSRI exposure; residual confounding by indication; small external validation (n=60); SSRI type non-specific.
Open_Problems: Randomised pathology-stratified trials; dose-response; plasma biomarker integration; depression-severity mediation.

Method_Architecture: Point-biserial correlation + hierarchical binary logistic regression
Best_Metric: OR 1.257 (1.107-1.428) per PSQI point; Nagelkerke R2 0.551
Dataset: Single-centre CHF cohort (First Affiliated Hospital of Guangxi Medical University, Nanning, China)
Key_Novelty: Sleep quality independently associated with MCI in CHF (58% MCI prevalence; OR 1.26/point)
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional; subjective PSQI only; single-centre Chinese cohort.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal sleep-MCI trajectories; actigraphy/PSG; interventional sleep trials in CHF.

Modality: sMRI region volumes + neuropsych/Ecog + A-beta/tau/CSF biomarkers (ADNI)
Method_Architecture: GLM; mixed-design ANOVA (Ecog); FDR-corrected partial correlations; multinomial logistic regression
Best_Metric: 78% three-class transition prediction accuracy (multinomial regression)
Dataset: ADNI
Key_Novelty: Three-class MCI transition model; education, hippocampal volume, function predict reversion
Primary_Limitation: Small rMCI group (n=52); volumetric-only imaging; 36-month follow-up; no aMCI/naMCI subtype split.
Open_Problems: Larger reverter samples; comprehensive imaging biomarkers; plasma markers; cross-cultural cohorts.

Modality: Neuropsych screening instruments (MMSE focus vs MoCA/ACE-III)
Method_Architecture: Narrative literature review; critical psychometric appraisal
Best_Metric: Qualitative: MMSE reduced sensitivity for MCI; executive/fluency domains undercaptured
Dataset: Narrative review literature corpus (MMSE/MCI screening studies)
Key_Novelty: Narrative review: MMSE insensitive for MCI; metacognition-aware screening proposed
Primary_Limitation: Narrative non-systematic methodology; subjective inclusion; no quantitative synthesis.
Open_Problems: Systematic pooled sensitivity; metacognition-integrated tools; digital screening.

Method_Architecture: Narrative appraisal of diagnostic systems, norms and cutoffs
Best_Metric: Qualitative: multi-test per domain at ~1 SD cutoffs; superior neuropathology validity
Dataset: Narrative review literature corpus (diagnostic systems and neuropsych norms)
Key_Novelty: Best-practice appraisal: >1 test/domain with ~1 SD cutoffs for MCI diagnosis
Primary_Limitation: Expert narrative, not systematic; no quantitative synthesis; single-author perspective.
Open_Problems: Systematic validation of multi-test criteria; culturally adapted norms; digital standardisation.

Modality: UFOV reaction time + head-mounted eye-tracking (VRAS paradigm)
Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional group comparison; ANCOVA; logistic regression; ROC analysis
Dataset: Single-site older-adult cohort (Kyoto care facilities, Japan)
Key_Novelty: UFOV reaction time detects MCI at AUC 0.841 with ms-level actionable cutoff
