Primary_Limitation: Small single-site sample (74); cross-sectional; no external validation; alertness confounds.
Open_Problems: Multi-site validation; longitudinal conversion prediction; digital biomarker integration.

Modality: Memory-clinic SCD neuropsych battery (MMSE, CERAD, TMT, fluency)
Method_Architecture: Retrospective cohort; Cox proportional hazards adjusted for age/sex/education
Best_Metric: HR 0.580 (0.464-0.726) per SD CERAD immediate recall trial 1
Dataset: Clinica Universidad de Navarra Memory Clinic cohort (Spain, 2001-2017)
Key_Novelty: CERAD verbal memory and TMT-B deficits predict SCD progression within normal global scores
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective records; variable follow-up; attrition; single Spanish memory clinic.
Open_Problems: Prospective multi-centre SCD cohorts; biomarker-anchored progression; harmonised norms.

Method_Architecture: Cox PH + joint modelling for informative attrition; reference vs cohort-specific weight sets
Best_Metric: HR 1.04-1.40 per LIBRA2 point for incident dementia (8 yr); MCI null
Dataset: MYHAT population-based cohort (Monongahela-Youghiogheny Healthy Aging Team, Pennsylvania, USA)
Key_Novelty: LIBRA2 predicts incident dementia but not MCI in low-SES US cohort (joint modelling)
Primary_Limitation: No diet data (LOCF imputation); late-life window; MCI endpoint null; CDR-based outcomes.
Open_Problems: Midlife recruitment; biomarker-anchored outcomes; cross-cohort weight transfer; MCI-specific indices.

Modality: Bibliometric analysis of MCI imaging-diagnosis literature
Method_Architecture: Bibliometrics (VOSviewer, CiteSpace, R-bibliometrix); co-authorship/keyword co-occurrence/burst analysis
Best_Metric: 7,568 articles mapped; 22.27% annual growth; four thematic clusters
Dataset: Web of Science Core Collection (1999-2024)
Key_Novelty: Bibliometric map: MCI imaging field pivots to AI and multimodal diagnostics
Primary_Limitation: WoSCC-only English records; bibliometric surrogates; citation-lag bias.
Open_Problems: Multi-database replication; clinical-impact linkage; AI-subcluster tracking.

Modality: Neuropsychiatric symptoms in MCI/early AD (clinical pattern review)
Method_Architecture: Structured narrative review (2012-2025; PubMed/MEDLINE/Scopus/PsycINFO/Google Scholar/CINAHL)
Best_Metric: NPS affect up to 80% of early AD/MCI; often precede cognitive decline
Dataset: Narrative review literature corpus (2012-2025, six databases)
Sample_N_Approx: Not reported in source (structured narrative review)
Key_Novelty: Reframes NPS as early biomarkers of MCI/AD trajectory preceding memory loss
Primary_Limitation: Narrative methodology; no systematic pooling; NPS instrument heterogeneity.
Open_Problems: Biomarker-driven NPS diagnostics; dual cognitive-NPS interventions; standardised instruments.

Method_Architecture: Empowerment-driven co-design with PFAB; WHO-ICF adapted conceptual framework mapping; 4-core architecture; 6-month multidomain curriculum; pre/post assessment battery (MoCA, motor, mood, QoL, caregiver burden)
Best_Metric: not reported (program design; no efficacy outcomes)
Dataset: CEP program design document (Emory University / Georgia Tech)
Sample_N_Approx: Not reported in source (program design; no outcome-analysis cohort)
Key_Novelty: Co-designed multidomain MCI lifestyle program (CEP) with four cores and lifestyle-biomarker sensing
Primary_Limitation: No outcome data yet - clinical efficacy and lifestyle-biomarker utility remain unvalidated.
Open_Problems: Multi-core longitudinal outcome evaluation; lifestyle-biomarker validation; scalability beyond single site; cost-effectiveness.

Modality: Clinical-trial registry landscape analysis (WHO ICTRP MCI trials)
Method_Architecture: WHO ICTRP systematic search; MeSH condition classification; visible+hidden dedup; dual-independence extraction with adjudication; descriptive statistics over design/phase/country/sponsor/intervention/outcome
Best_Metric: 2,609 trials mapped; 51.8% registered in past 5 years; 1,344 non-pharmacological vs 399 pharmacological intervention trials
Dataset: WHO ICTRP global clinical-trial registry (18 registries, 61 countries, 1999-2024)
Key_Novelty: Whole-ICTRP taxonomy of MCI trial designs and non-pharmacological/AI-VR intervention profiles
Primary_Limitation: Descriptive registry analysis; incomplete phase/result fields; only 8.28% of trials share results; no pooled efficacy synthesis.
Open_Problems: Improved results-sharing; standardised outcomes to enable pooling; larger late-phase and prevention trials; track AI/digital intervention growth.

Method_Architecture: Purposive/maximum-differentiated sampling; MTM-guided semi-structured interviews; MAXQDA 2022; deductive-inductive thematic analysis; member checking; COREQ
Best_Metric: 2 themes / 11 subthemes; thematic saturation at n=20
Dataset: Semi-structured interviews with MCI patients (Nanjing tertiary hospital + community screening, China)
Key_Novelty: MTM two-stage account of initiation vs maintenance barriers/drivers in multidomain MCI interventions
Primary_Limitation: Single-centre qualitative scope; purposive sample; self-report reliance; urban-China cultural specificity.
Open_Problems: Multi-site/cross-cultural qualitative work; integrase caregiver/clinician perspectives; tailored strategies for anosognosia/access/cost and short-term-outcome expectations.

Modality: Early HTA / health-economic modelling of MCI dementia-risk prediction (AI-Mind)
Method_Architecture: Decision-tree + lifetime Markov model; CHEERS 2022 & AdViSHE; interactive dashboard; base-case/headroom/scenario/deterministic sensitivity analyses; ICER vs EUR20,000/QALY; 3% discounting
Best_Metric: Base case not cost-effective (current practice dominant: 9.36 vs 9.32 QALYs; GB 115032 vs GB 115837)
Dataset: Decision-analytic health-economic model (literature/consensus inputs; AI-Mind tool; Dutch perspective)
Sample_N_Approx: Not reported in source (modelling/HTA; no primary cohort)
Key_Novelty: Early-HTA model: AI-Mind MCI risk prediction needs cheap wide-target treatment to be cost-effective
Primary_Limitation: Model-based with assumed (non-empirical) tool performance, treatment costs and effect-duration; no probabilistic sensitivity analysis.
Open_Problems: Probabilistic sensitivity analysis; empirical risk-disclosure disutilities; treatment duration/waning; aetiology-stratified dementia; validate once AI-Mind performance known.

Modality: Dietary (berry/polyphenol) cognition and obesity review - MCI prevention
Method_Architecture: PRISMA 2020 systematic review; Cochrane RoB 2 + Newcastle-Ottawa quality assessment; narrative synthesis of cognitive, metabolic and biomarker (TAU/A-beta) outcomes
Best_Metric: 12 eligible human studies; most consistent cognitive benefit in memory domains; mechanistic TAU/A-beta attenuation
Dataset: Systematic-review literature corpus (human berry-consumption trials ~2004-2024; 145 screened to 12 eligible)
Sample_N_Approx: 12 eligible studies (heterogeneous n; cohort-level data up to ~29,000)
Key_Novelty: Integrates berry diet evidence across cognitive, obesity-metabolic and TAU/A-beta biomarkers
Primary_Limitation: Few, heterogeneous and mostly some-concerns human trials; non-meta-analytic synthesis; mechanistic basis largely animal-derived.
Open_Problems: Larger, longer, standardised-dosing RCTs in MCI/at-risk populations; human biomarker validation (TAU, A-beta, NfL); pooled meta-analysis; protocol pre-registration.

Modality: Automated social-behaviour phenotyping in mice (NoSeMaze; oxytocin-KO)
Method_Architecture: NoSeMaze automated maze; DeepLabCut tracking; automated tube test; olfactory reversal learning
Best_Metric: Mutant-vs-wildtype group differences with normalisation (hierarchy p=0.04->0.83; thigmotaxis p<0.001)
Best_AUC: not reported (behavioural phenotyping; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: In-house NoSeMaze mouse colony (oxytocin-receptor KO + wildtype, group-housed, longitudinal)
Sample_N_Approx: 75 mice (24 mutants interspersed; groups of 8 wildtypes + 2 mutants)
Key_Novelty: Open-source NoSeMaze reveals transient oxytocin-KO social-hierarchy effects and compensation
Primary_Limitation: Dynamic cross-group parameters and single knock-out line limit trait attribution and generalisability.
Open_Problems: Longer observation windows, more genotypes/phenotypes, integration of molecular/neural readouts alongside behavioural tracking, and larger per-group mutant counts for statistical power.

Method_Architecture: Remote FUNSAT/CCT; discriminant analysis + ROC on baseline errors
Best_Metric: Discriminant analysis F=41.40 (p<.001), 94% correct classification; ROC AUC 0.83
Dataset: i-Function/FUNSAT remote computerized skills-training study (NC and MCI participants)
Key_Novelty: First-task baseline errors predict FUNSAT task non-mastery within 15 minutes (AUC 0.83)
Primary_Limitation: Abstract-level detail; single task battery; no external validation; remote-study generalisability constraints.
Open_Problems: External validation, prospective implementation studies, larger samples, and combining baseline errors with additional cognitive/functional predictors.

Method_Architecture: BenMAP-CE burden model; systematic-review pooling of concentration-response RRs
Best_Metric: Attributable burden: ~110,000 AD and ~1.6 million MCI excess cases in 2023 (per 10 μg/m3 RRs)
Best_AUC: not reported (burden modelling; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: China national/provincial O3 monitoring (343 cities, 2015–2023), GBD/census incidence and population, systematic-review RRs
Sample_N_Approx: Country-level modelling 195.83 million aged ≥65; 8 pooled epidemiological studies (n 704–95,690)
Key_Novelty: First China national+provincial health/economic burden of ozone-attributable AD and MCI
Primary_Limitation: Model-based with pooled heterogeneous RRs and imputed MCI incidence/cost; no causality or full PSA.
Open_Problems: Larger, China-representative exposure-response cohorts with standardised ozone metrics; primary China MCI incidence/cost data; probabilistic sensitivity analysis; finer spatial (county/city) resolution.

Method_Architecture: Narrative review of physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, ProTox-II safety and mechanistic evidence
Best_Metric: Qualitative evidence synthesis across preclinical models and small clinical studies
Best_AUC: not reported (review of interventions; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: Literature corpus of punicalagin preclinical/clinical MCI studies (narrative)
Sample_N_Approx: Not reported in source (review; individual clinical trials up to 36+ participants)
Key_Novelty: Consolidates physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, safety and mechanism evidence for punicalagin MCI
Primary_Limitation: Narrative review with largely animal-derived mechanistic evidence, sparse small human trials, and no pooled analysis.
Open_Problems: Large, rigorously designed RCTs in MCI/at-risk populations; standardised dosing/formulation; nanodeilvery and bioavailability strategies; nutrigenomic-stratified trials; confirmation of mechanistic pathways in humans.

Modality: Gut microbiome / SCFA analysis (mice, D-gal MCI model)
Method_Architecture: D-gal MCI mouse model; behavioural assays; 16S rDNA sequencing; GC SCFA; ELISA; Spearman
Best_Metric: MWM spatial-memory improvement + increased SCFA-producing microbiota
Dataset: In-house D-gal-induced ICR mouse MCI model
Key_Novelty: Links VC mitigation of D-gal MCI to gut microbiome SCFA pathways
Primary_Limitation: Correlational flora-SCFA-cognition links; single dose/sex; D-gal model translatability.
Open_Problems: Larger animal cohorts, multiple doses/times, causal experiments (faecal transfer/SCFA gavage), ageing and AD-transgenic models, and eventual human translation.

Method_Architecture: Aged-MCI mouse model; DPP-4 inhibitor vs metformin; microglia M1/M2 assays; MIP-1alpha KO
Best_Metric: Cognitive improvement with combination linagliptin+metformin; enhanced synaptic plasticity/neurogenesis
Dataset: In-house aged C57BL/6 and MIP-1α-/- mouse model
Sample_N_Approx: Main experiment ~44 mice (n=8–11/group) + MIP-1α-/- and wildtype controls
Key_Novelty: DPP-4 inhibition (linagliptin) rescues aged-MCI via M2 microglia polarization, partly through MIP-1α
Primary_Limitation: Mouse model translatability; single-sex; MIP-1α mechanism partly knockout-inferred; no human confirmation.
Open_Problems: Human studies in older adults with T2DM/insulin resistance; dose-response and long-term treatment; translation of the metformin+linagliptin combination; confirmation of microglial-polarization mechanism in human tissue.

Method_Architecture: BCAS-MCI rat model; 3 anesthetics; MWM + DTI; immunofluorescence/RT-qPCR/WB; Kap-beta2 AAV overexpression
Best_Metric: Anesthetic-specific PND severity and Kapβ2-mediated rescue (MWM, hnRNPA2/B1 tangles)
Dataset: In-house BCAS-MCI rat (Sprague-Dawley) surgical model
Sample_N_Approx: Main ~24 rats (N=6/group x4) + Kapβ2-overexpression ~24 rats (N=6/group x4; N=12 initial)
Key_Novelty: Kapβ2 resolves hnRNPA2/B1 tangles to attenuate anesthetic-specific PND in MCI rats
Primary_Limitation: Rat-model translatability; Kapβ2 mechanism not fully resolved; single doses; no human validation.
Open_Problems: In vitro recombination and time-resolved imaging to establish Kapβ2 mechanism; human cohort validation of peripheral hnRNPA2/B1 as a PND marker; anesthetic-regimen optimisation; longer functional follow-up.

Modality: Serum vitamin D / cholesterol / oxysterol biomarkers (MCI case-control)
Method_Architecture: Case-control EMCOA; electrochemiluminescence + UPLC-MS; logistic regression; correlations; ROC
Best_Metric: 25(OH)D odds ~3x for MCI in deficiency; AUC 0.72
Dataset: EMCOA cohort (Shanxi, China) case-control
Key_Novelty: Links vitamin D deficiency to disrupted cholesterol/oxysterol homeostasis and MCI cognition
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional causality limits; self-reported comorbidities; missing pathway factors; single cohort.
Open_Problems: Prospective/longitudinal studies; direct assessment of disease history/biomarkers; pathway factors (7-DHC, CYP27A1); intervention trials of vitamin D with cholesterol/oxysterol and cognition endpoints; multi-centre cohorts.
Journal: The Journal of Nutrition 2021;151(12):3865–3873 (Oxford University Press)

Method_Architecture: Narrative literature review of 17 articles on neuropsychological predictors
Best_Metric: NA
Dataset: PubMed literature review (17 articles post-2005)
Key_Novelty: Consolidates neuropsychological signatures distinguishing MCI progression to DLB vs AD
Primary_Limitation: Small, heterogeneous non-systematic review base; conflicting findings; cognitive scoring alone insufficient.
Open_Problems: Larger, harmonised longitudinal cohorts; multimodal combination (clinical + neuropsychology + neuroimaging + quantitative EEG); prospective validation of predictive signatures.
Journal: Journal of the Neurological Sciences 2021;429:118978 (conference abstract)

Method_Architecture: ADNI rs-fMRI; aDMN/pDMN voxelwise FC; multiple linear regression + WMH sensitivity
Best_Metric: Regression-adjusted aDMN-pDMN connectivity association with executive/language in MCI
Best_AUC: not reported (association study; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative) resting-state fMRI + composite cognitive scores
Key_Novelty: MCI-selective domain-specific (executive/language) DMN-connectivity-cognition associations
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional; SPM5 preprocessing only; no amyloid/tau PET; small AD subgroup.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal designs; integration with amyloid/tau PET; newer preprocessing/normalisation frameworks; larger AD samples; examination of network-level causal mechanisms.

Method_Architecture: KBASE cross-sectional; simultaneous FDG-PET+MR; SPM12 voxel-wise BDT-glucose correlation; covariate adjustment + cluster/FWE correction
Best_Metric: Voxel-wise correlation T-values of BDT with regional glucose metabolism (cluster p<0.001, k>1062)
Best_AUC: not reported (association study; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: KBASE (Korean Brain Aging Study) FDG-PET + neuropsychological
Key_Novelty: First voxel-wise FDG-PET map of BDT neural correlates across MCI/AD severity in Koreans
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional; single-centre; no cognitively normal comparison; unstandardised BDT z-scores.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal and multimodal validation; cross-cultural normative data; BDT-linked metabolic regions as functional biomarkers in MCI/AD.

Modality: Oxidative stress / apoptosis / mitochondrial markers + NOL behaviour (rat MI)
Method_Architecture: Rat LAD-ligation MI model (HFpEF/HFrEF); NOL/OFT; MDA/mitochondrial ROS; Western blot (Drp1/Mfn/OPA1, Iba-1/NF-kB/TNF-a/TLR4, caspases, MLKL, ACSL4, TrkB/AD proteins); spine density
Best_Metric: NOL preference-index group difference (p<0.05); cleaved caspase-3 and brain MDA elevation
Best_AUC: not reported (preclinical mechanistic; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: Own rat cohort (Chiang Mai University LAD-ligation MI model)
Key_Novelty: Dissociates oxidative/apoptotic from inflammatory/AD-protein drivers of early-remodeling MI-MCI
Primary_Limitation: Animal-only, single 5-week time point; mechanisms correlational.
Open_Problems: Early protective (antioxidant) targets; cardiac-brain signalling connecting MI to hippocampal stress; clinical translation to HF/MCI.

Modality: Plasma cytokines/CRP/SOD-MDA-GSH-Px (DLB vs AD vs aMCI)
Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional plasma immunoassay profiling (S-PLEX cytokines, CRP turbidimetry, SOD/MDA/GSH-Px); ANOVA/Kruskal-Wallis; correlation with clinical scales
Best_Metric: Group-level cytokine/oxidative-marker differences (e.g., IL-6, SOD, MDA) across DLB/AD/aMCI/HC
Best_AUC: not reported (association/fingerprint study; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: Xuanwu Hospital memory-clinic plasma cohort (China)
Key_Novelty: First DLB-vs-AD/aMCI peripheral immune and oxidative stress fingerprint (IL-6/MDA up, SOD down)
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional, single-centre; probable-DLB diagnosis; peripheral markers only.
Open_Problems: Robust DLB biomarker panel; central (CSF/imaging) correlation; specificity vs PD/mixed dementia; immune-oxidative therapeutic targeting.

Modality: SIRT3/MnSOD/OGG1 mitochondrial oxidative-DNA repair + behaviour (rat MCI)
Method_Architecture: Reserpine rat MCI model + H2O2 PC12 cells; MWM/OFT; HE/TEM; mitochondrial complex I-IV/ATP/JC-1; SIRT3/MnSOD/OGG1 WB; 8-OH-dG ELISA; BZYQD/GBE intervention
Best_Metric: MWM/NOL cognitive improvement; reduced mitochondrial 8-OH-dG; restored SIRT3/MnSOD/OGG1
Best_AUC: not reported (preclinical mechanistic; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: Own rat (Beijing Univ. of Chinese Medicine) + PC12 cell model
Key_Novelty: Maps BZYQD-to-MCI benefit onto the SIRT3/MnSOD/OGG1 mitochondrial DNA-repair axis
Primary_Limitation: Preclinical (rat + PC12); reserpine model; pathway necessity not genetically confirmed.
Open_Problems: Clinical translation of BZYQD for MCI; active-constituent ID; pathway causality confirmation; comparison with standard cognitive interventions.

Method_Architecture: PRISMA systematic review (13 databases); qualitative synthesis; CAMARADES/MacDermid risk-of-bias scoring; modality/intensity mapping
Best_Metric: Percent studies reducing pro-inflammatory (animal 70.8%, human 53.9%) and raising anti-inflammatory cytokines
Best_AUC: not reported (systematic review; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: 13 databases published studies (Web of Science, PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane, etc.)
Key_Novelty: First systematic modality-oriented synthesis of exercise anti-inflammatory effects across human/animal MCI/dementia
Primary_Limitation: Heterogeneous, small human evidence; qualitative non-meta-analytic synthesis.
Open_Problems: Standardised exercise-prescription trials; link cytokine reductions to cognitive endpoints; clarify mechanism; clinical programme integration.

Modality: Green oat cognitaven: CREB/BDNF/Nrf2/HO-1, NF-kB/MAPK (mouse + microglia)
Method_Architecture: LPS BV-2 microglia (NO, MTT, immunostaining); scopolamine C57BL/6J mouse model (MWM, Y-maze); western blot of CREB/BDNF, Nrf2/HO-1, NF-kB/MAPK
Best_Metric: Memory improvement (MWM/Y-maze); reduced NO/inflammation; elevated p-CREB/BDNF, Nrf2/HO-1
Best_AUC: not reported (preclinical mechanistic; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: Own mouse (C57BL/6J scopolamine) + BV-2 microglial model
Key_Novelty: Links green oat extract cognitaven to CREB/BDNF/Nrf2/HO-1 upregulation and NF-kB/MAPK suppression in MCI models
Primary_Limitation: Preclinical only; scopolamine model; short 14-day dosing.
Open_Problems: Human RCTs; AD-pathology model validation; active-constituent ID; long-term/dose studies; pathway necessity confirmation.

Modality: Clinical MADRS/safety (MCI-D single IV ketamine pilot)
Method_Architecture: Open-label single-arm pilot; single IV ketamine 0.5 mg/kg; safety/tolerability + MADRS change (baseline to 24h and 1 month)
Best_Metric: MADRS change from baseline to 24h (27.4 -> 5.7); 0 serious adverse events
Best_AUC: not reported (safety/pilot efficacy; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: Own open-label pilot (Mount Sinai), Nov 2023-Mar 2025
Key_Novelty: First pilot evidence of single IV ketamine safety + rapid antidepressant signal in MCI-D
Primary_Limitation: Open-label, n=13, short follow-up; preliminary efficacy only.
Open_Problems: RCT efficacy and cognitive-safety; optimal dosing/regimen; responder identification; whether depression improvement slows cognitive decline.
Journal: The American Journal of Geriatric Psychiatry (2026), in press/journal pre-proof (Elsevier)

Method_Architecture: Narrative literature review and mechanistic synthesis (synaptic mitochondria, mPTP, fission/fusion, A-beta/tau, phytochemical neuroprotection)
Best_Metric: narrative review (conceptual integration; no single quantitative metric)
Dataset: narrative review of published mechanistic literature (no own cohort)
Sample_N_Approx: Not applicable (narrative review; no pooled meta-analysis)
Key_Novelty: Integrated synaptic-specific mitochondrial-repair framework linking MCI/AD to phytochemical neuroprotection
Primary_Limitation: Narrative, non-systematic; animal-model-heavy; no quantitative synthesis.
Open_Problems: Human synaptic-mitochondrial biomarkers; clinical translation of phytochemical protection; whether mitochondrial rescue slows MCI-to-AD.

Modality: Extracellular-vesicle proteomics/size (SVD rat model EV signalling) [CONFERENC
Method_Architecture: EV isolation (size-exclusion chromatography) from plasma/endothelial media; proteomics; nanoparticle tracking; applied to oligodendrocytes (conference abstract)
Best_Metric: EV levels/size differences and protein-cargo divergence: Atp11bKO vs wildtype
Best_AUC: not reported (conference abstract; no classifier discrimination)
Dataset: Atp11bKO rat model (own) + plasma/endothelial-cell EVs (Edinburgh/Glasgow/Dundee)
Sample_N_Approx: Not reported in source (conference abstract; n=6/group in EV size figure)
Key_Novelty: Proposes altered endothelial-EV signalling as mechanistic link in SVD white-matter vulnerability
Primary_Limitation: Conference-abstract stage, underpowered; model-based; human translation unproven.
Open_Problems: Validate EV cargo as SVD biomarker; causal endothelial-EV-oligodendrocyte communication; human cohort confirmation; therapeutic targeting.
Journal: Cerebral Circulation - Cognition and Behavior 9 (2025) 100407 (VCI congress abstract; Elsevier)

Method_Architecture: Targeted 1H NMR metabolomics (CPMG etc.) on plasma/serum; metabolite/ratio quantification; correlation with MMSE cognitive severity
Best_Metric: Metabolite/ratio group differences (PQR, EQR, glutamine) and MMSE correlation
Best_AUC: not reported in source (association study; metabolite ROC not summarised as AUC)
Dataset: Banaras Hindu University / KGMU Lucknow blood samples (MCI, T2DM, NC)
Key_Novelty: Human blood NMR signature (low glutamine, high proline/PQR) tracks cognitive severity in MCI vs T2DM
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional, moderate N; circulatory-only measures; brain origin inferred.
Open_Problems: Confirm brain vs systemic origin; validate MCI-specific metabolic signature as biomarker; mitochondrial-targeted interventions informed by glutamine/proline.
Journal: Brain Organoid and Systems Neuroscience Journal 2 (2024) 64-74 (Elsevier)

Modality: Rhesus macaque MCI model review (cognitive aging, MRI, amyloid/tau)
Method_Architecture: Narrative review/synthesis of rhesus cognitive-aging (DR, DNMS, WCST-like), structural MRI volumetrics, Abeta/pTau histopathology and ovariectomy + hormone-replacement experiments
Best_Metric: Narrative synthesis; per-study DR/DNMS deficits and MRI volume differences
Best_AUC: not reported in source (review chapter; no classifier)
Dataset: Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta) aging literature; ONPRC/OHSU studies (no new cohort)
Key_Novelty: Rhesus macaque review: cognitive aging without MCI/AD neuropathology; models protection, not disease
Primary_Limitation: Narrative review without new data; small, sex-unbalanced macaque cohorts; no direct MCI analogue in nonhuman primates.
Open_Problems: Whether macaques model MCI-to-AD conversion; identify rhesus protective genetic/epigenetic/hormonal mechanisms; prophylactic-intervention testing.
Journal: Animal Models of Neurological Conditions, Chapter 8, pp. 231-246 (Elsevier, 2026)

Modality: Enriched-environment SAMP8 mice: hippocampal APP/Abeta, plasticity
Method_Architecture: SAMP8 MCI-phase mouse model; 60-day EE housing; MWM; TUNEL/Nissl; Golgi; TEM stereology (Nv/Sv); Abeta/APP/SYN immunohistochemistry in CA1; ANOVA
Best_Metric: MWM escape latency, target-quadrant time, spine density, synaptic Nv/Sv, APP/Abeta OD group differences (P<0.01)
Best_AUC: not reported in source (animal study; no classifier)
Dataset: In-house SAMP8/SAMR1 mouse colony (Changzhi Medical College)
Sample_N_Approx: 45 mice (30 male SAMP8: 15 EE + 15 SE; 15 male SAMR1 SE)
Key_Novelty: EE delays MCI-to-AD in SAMP8 mice by lowering hippocampal APP/Abeta and apoptosis
Primary_Limitation: Preclinical only; partial rescue versus SAMR1; mitochondrial mechanism inferred.
Open_Problems: Translate EE-equivalent stimulation to human MCI; EE dose-response; combination with pharmacotherapy.

Modality: In vivo 1H/31P-MRS brain metabolomics meta-analysis (NAA, mI, Cho)
Method_Architecture: Random-effects meta-analysis (RevMan 5.3) with Hedges' g; region-stratified subgroup analyses; leave-one-out heterogeneity control; MMSE-effect-size correlations
Best_Metric: Hedges' g effect sizes for metabolite ratios/concentrations (NAA, mI, Cho, Cr, GSH, 31P compounds)
Best_AUC: not reported in source (meta-analysis; no classifier)
Dataset: Pooled literature corpus of in vivo 1H/31P-MRS MCI and AD studies (PubMed/EMBASE/Cochrane)
Sample_N_Approx: 79 1H-MRS studies (MCI: 1238 pts/1473 HC; AD: 1248/1682) + 31P: 9 studies (123 AD + 119 HC)
Key_Novelty: Dual 1H/31P-MRS meta-analysis: NAA down, mI up, GSH down progress from MCI to AD; hippocampus most altered
Primary_Limitation: Heterogeneous MRS literature; small GSH/31P evidence base; variable data quality.
Open_Problems: Validate NAA/mI as monitoring biomarkers; test whether GSH reduction precedes NAA loss; resolve Cr-referencing methodology.

Modality: Vitamin E/tocotrienol nutraceutical review; MCI cognition outcomes
Method_Architecture: Narrative review with structured literature search (PubMed, CINAHL, Google Scholar) and standardised data extraction; descriptive synthesis
Best_Metric: Narrative synthesis; direction and proportion of studies showing neuroprotective effect (11/22)
Best_AUC: not reported in source (narrative review; no classifier)
Dataset: Literature corpus of vitamin E-tocopherol-tocotrienol MCI studies (PubMed, CINAHL, Google Scholar)
Key_Novelty: Review of 22 vitamin-E studies in MCI: 11 favour neuroprotection but evidence remains equivocal
Primary_Limitation: Narrative design; heterogeneous measures prevent pooled estimates; mixed results.
Open_Problems: RCTs with larger samples; isolate alpha-tocopherol effects; dose-response and toxicity monitoring.

Modality: GRK5 GPCR-kinase deficiency mechanistic review (mouse model, aMCI)
Method_Architecture: Narrative review of GRK5 biochemistry, GRK5KO behavioural/histological phenotyping (RAWM, EPM, balanced beam, axonopathy), and GAP double-transgenic studies
Best_Metric: Narrative synthesis; RAWM short-term-memory deficit and axonopathy scores in GRK5KO mice
Best_AUC: not reported in source (review; no classifier)
Dataset: GRK5KO / CRND8 / GAP (GRK5KO x Tg2576) mouse models; human AD autopsy brain tissue
Sample_N_Approx: Not reported in source (narrative review of mouse-model and autopsy studies)
Key_Novelty: GRK5 deficiency causes amnestic MCI via M2/M4 desensitisation; GRK5KO mice model MCI-AD
Primary_Limitation: Mouse-model mechanistic evidence without human epidemiological confirmation.
Open_Problems: Validate GRK5 deficiency as human MCI biomarker; develop GRK5-targeted prophylaxis; test cholinergic-PNS/metabolism link.

Method_Architecture: Mini review with Scopus literature search and critical appraisal of 9 primary human probiotic clinical studies
Best_Metric: Narrative synthesis of cognitive-outcome findings across 9 clinical studies (no pooled estimate)
Best_AUC: not reported in source (mini review; no classifier)
Dataset: Scopus/clinical literature corpus of probiotic intervention studies (healthy elderly, MCI, AD)
Key_Novelty: Mini-review of 9 probiotic studies: preliminary cognition gains in MCI, not yet convincing
Primary_Limitation: Small, confounded evidence base; no pooled estimates; limited gut/biomarker endpoints.
Open_Problems: Larger multi-site RCTs of probiotics alone; concurrent cognition + inflammatory/gut biomarkers; strain-specific efficacy.

Modality: Brain oxidative-stress/redox proteomics review in aMCI (PC, HNE, 3-NT)
Method_Architecture: Narrative review of post-mortem redox proteomics of MCI hippocampus/IPL, Abeta42-lipid-peroxidation biochemistry, and clinical antioxidant trials
Best_Metric: Redox-proteomics oxidative-stress indices (PC, HNE, 3-NT) in MCI vs control brain
Best_AUC: not reported in source (review; no classifier)
Dataset: Post-mortem MCI and control brain tissue (University of Kentucky and confirmatory studies)
Sample_N_Approx: Not reported in source (narrative review of redox-proteomics studies)
Key_Novelty: Redox proteomics show oxidative protein/lipid damage is an early event in aMCI brain preceding AD
Primary_Limitation: Review article; disappointing antioxidant-trial record; correlational proteomics evidence.
Open_Problems: Validate oxidised proteins/blood-lymphocyte oxidative markers as MCI biomarkers; multi-pronged early-intervention trials.

Modality: Open-label frailty intervention trial (Kampo Ninjin'yoeito) in MCI/mild AD
Method_Architecture: Open-label single-arm 24-week trial; NYT (TJ-108, 6-9 g/day); NPI anorexia (primary), J-CHS frailty, fatigue VAS, CONUT, CDR/CDR-SB, MoCA-J; Wilcoxon signed-rank/paired t-test
Best_Metric: NPI anorexia subcategory score change (primary), J-CHS frailty score, fatigue VAS
Best_AUC: not reported in source (open-label trial; no classifier)
Dataset: Own open-label trial (FRAMINGO; jRCTs071190011; 3 Japanese sites)
Sample_N_Approx: 14 patients (9 MCI, 5 mild AD; 11 frail, 3 prefrail)
Key_Novelty: Open-label Kampo Ninjin'yoeito trial improves frailty, anorexia and fatigue in MCI/mild AD
Primary_Limitation: Open-label, uncontrolled; small sample; no multiple-testing correction.
Open_Problems: Randomized placebo-controlled confirmation; mechanism (NPY/ghrelin orexigenic pathways); frailty-to-cognition progression.
Journal: Journal of Alzheimer's Disease Reports 7: 107-117, 2023 (IOS Press)

Modality: 16S rRNA gut-microbiota profiling; sex-specific MCI risk models
Method_Architecture: 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing; alpha/beta-diversity (NMDS/PERMANOVA); ALDEx2 differential abundance; SEM latent-variable modelling + logistic regression with 10-fold CV/SMOTE; ROC-AUC
Best_Metric: AUC (ROC) of sex-specific SEM-logistic MCI risk models
Dataset: Own Japanese clinic cohort (Ochanomizu Health and Longevity Clinic, Ashikari Clinic; Symbiosis Solutions stool-testing service)
Sample_N_Approx: 69 (29 MCI: 11 M/18 F; 40 controls: 17 M/23 F)
Key_Novelty: Sex-stratified gut-microbiota SEM MCI risk models: AUC 0.75 male, 0.87 female
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional; small sample; internal-only validation; age imbalance.
Open_Problems: External validation and clinical deployment of stool-based MCI screening; mechanistic gut-brain-axis studies; longitudinal prediction.

Modality: CSF HPA-axis hormones (CRH/ACTH/cortisol) systematic review in MCI/AD
Method_Architecture: PRISMA systematic review; structured search of MEDLINE/EMBASE/Web of Science; Newcastle-Ottawa quality assessment; narrative synthesis
Best_Metric: CSF cortisol group-difference findings (elevated in AD; ApoE-epsilon-4 homozygote higher)
Best_AUC: not reported in source (systematic review; no classifier)
Dataset: Literature corpus of CSF HPA-axis hormone studies (MEDLINE, EMBASE, Web of Science)
Key_Novelty: CSF cortisol is elevated in AD, higher in ApoE-epsilon-4 homozygotes; MCI findings inconclusive
Primary_Limitation: Heterogeneous diagnostic criteria; small ACTH/MCI evidence base; narrative synthesis.
Open_Problems: Standardise criteria and control cognitive assessment; ApoE-stratified biomarker panels; longitudinal CSF-cortisol conversion studies.

Modality: Gut microbiome shotgun metagenomics; MCI-to-AD conversion prediction
Method_Architecture: Longitudinal AlzBiom cohort (49 MCI, 3.7 yr follow-up); shotgun metagenomics (MetaPhlAn/HUMAnN); logistic regression models (24 genera, 25 GO, 33 KO, clinical); ROC analysis; ensemble learning
Best_Metric: AUROC of ensemble (genera+GO+KO+clinical) model
Dataset: AlzBiom study (University of Tuebingen Memory Clinic, Germany)
Key_Novelty: Gut-microbiome genera+GO/KO+clinical ensemble predicts MCI-to-AD conversion (AUROC 0.96-0.97)
Primary_Limitation: Pilot sample (N=49); no CSF biomarkers; follow-up only at 1 and 4 years.
Open_Problems: External replication in larger cohorts; mechanisms linking pro-inflammatory taxa to AD; stool-based prognostic screening and microbiome-targeted interventions.

Modality: Cancer history x MCI/AD epidemiology (longitudinal AIBL cohort)
Method_Architecture: AIBL longitudinal analysis (7.2-yr mean follow-up); logistic regression (OR) and linear regression; RR stratum-specific by sex/APOE-epsilon-4; annualised delta CDR-SOB; adjustment for sex, APOE, smoking, alcohol, education
Best_Metric: Adjusted odds/risk ratio for MCI-to-AD progression (cancer+ vs cancer-)
Dataset: AIBL (Australian Imaging Biomarkers and Lifestyle study)
Key_Novelty: Cancer history lowers adjusted AD odds (37%) and halves MCI-to-AD progression risk in AIBL cohort
Primary_Limitation: Self-reported cancer history; cancer type/therapy unrecorded; Caucasian-only cohort.
Open_Problems: Cancer-type/therapy-specific analyses; amyloid-stratified MCI characterisation; mechanism studies (p53, PD-L1, TGF-beta, ROS, P-gp); validation in diverse populations.

Modality: Choline alphoscerate RCT protocol (MRI + neuropsychological endpoints)
Method_Architecture: Phase IV monocentric double-blind RCT protocol; 60 MCI+vascular-damage patients 1:1 choline alphoscerate 1200 mg/day vs placebo, 12 months; T1-MRI volumes (hippocampus, entorhinal, neocortex, ventricles) + MMSE primary; neuropsychological battery; safety monitoring; EudraCT 2020-000576-38
Best_Metric: not reported (protocol; planned MMSE/MRI group comparisons)
Best_AUC: not reported in source (protocol; no classifier)
Dataset: Planned monocentric RCT (EudraCT 2020-000576-38; University of Camerino / A. Cardarelli Hospital, Naples)
Key_Novelty: Choline alphoscerate RCT protocol targeting brain atrophy and cognition in vascular-damage MCI
Primary_Limitation: Protocol only (no results); monocentric; vascular-damage MCI subgroup only.
Open_Problems: Trial results pending; larger multicentre confirmatory trials; longer follow-up for conversion endpoints.

Modality: Plasma galectin-3 biomarker + miRNA regulation (T2DM MCI)
Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional T2DM cohort (329, 7:3 train/validation); ELISA galectin-3; Spearman correlation; multivariable linear/logistic regression; nomogram (Gal-3+age+education) with ROC-AUC, calibration, DCA; bioinformatics + qRT-PCR + luciferase for miR-128-3p/LGALS3
Best_Metric: AUC (ROC) of Gal-3+age+education nomogram
Dataset: Own hospital cohort (Affiliated Zhongda Hospital, Southeast University; T2DM inpatients)
Key_Novelty: Gal-3 nomogram predicts T2DM MCI (AUC 0.813/0.775); miR-128-3p regulates LGALS3
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective single-centre; internal split-only validation; no neuroimaging/CSF.
Open_Problems: External multicentre validation; prospective cohorts; functional miR-128-3p/Gal-3 studies; integration with other biomarkers.

Method_Architecture: Narrative review and mechanistic synthesis of preclinical (cellular/animal) and clinical evidence: OXPHOS, oxidative stress, fission/fusion dynamics, morphology, mitophagy, mtDNA damage, alpha-synuclein-mitochondria interactions; brain-region/cognitive-domain mapping; mitochondrial-targeted therapy survey
Best_Metric: not reported (narrative review)
Dataset: not reported in source (narrative review of PD mitochondrial literature)
Key_Novelty: Review of mitochondrial dysfunction mechanisms driving PD cognitive decline across SCD, MCI and PDD
Primary_Limitation: Narrative (non-systematic) review; largely preclinical mechanistic evidence.
Open_Problems: Human biomarker studies linking mitochondrial dysfunction to PD cognitive trajectory; predictive animal models; clinical trials of mitochondrial-targeted therapies with cognitive endpoints.

Method_Architecture: Aged MCI rat model (22-mo SD, bilateral CCA stenosis) + ORIF under 4 anaesthetics (local/sevoflurane/propofol/desflurane); hippocampal AAV-shRNA RUVBL2 knockdown; NOR and Barnes maze; ATP/western blot; immunofluorescence, Congo red, FRAP in primary hippocampal neurons; 9.4T BOLD-fMRI (ALFF) and DTI (FA)
Best_Metric: NOR discrimination ratio, Barnes-maze performance, ATP group differences
Best_AUC: not reported in source (preclinical mechanistic; no classifier)
Dataset: Own rat cohort (22-month-old male SD rats, bilateral CCA-stenosis MCI model; Tianjin)
Sample_N_Approx: Not reported as single total (per-assay n=3-9 aged MCI rats; in-vitro n=3-10 neuron experiments)
Key_Novelty: RUVBL2 knockdown speeds hnRNPA2/B1 stress-granule disassembly, blunting PND in aged MCI rats
Primary_Limitation: Male rats only; no proteomics for RUVBL2 interactors; animal-model translation.
Open_Problems: Proteomics of RUVBL2 interactors; sex-stratified studies; human PND translation; anaesthetic choice to minimise stress-granule stabilisation.

Method_Architecture: ADNI cohort (54 CN/345 MCI/96 AD) with 1-year follow-up; plasma GST-alpha measurement; group comparisons; Spearman correlation with MMSE change; ROC-AUC (95% CI) for baseline and change-based MCI/AD prediction; sex-stratified analysis
Best_Metric: AUC (ROC) of plasma GST-alpha for MCI/AD
Best_AUC: 0.76 (1-yr change, MCI); 0.75 (1-yr change, AD); baseline 0.63 MCI / 0.74 AD
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
Key_Novelty: Plasma GST-alpha and its 1-yr change predict MCI (AUC 0.76) and AD (0.75) in ADNI
Primary_Limitation: ADNI-only, short follow-up; small correlation (r=0.09); no converter subgroup analysis.
Open_Problems: MCI-to-AD converter validation; multifactor models combining GST-alpha with other biomarkers; independent cohorts; brain expression studies.

Method_Architecture: ADNI retrospective analysis (70 CN/119 MCI/61 AD); alpha-Syn-SAA + alpha-Syn-PMCA aggregation classification (Syn0/Syn1); CSF Abeta42/T-tau/P-tau (Luminex); Pearson correlations; multivariable Cox (APOE4, age, sex); Kaplan-Meier AD-free survival; longitudinal hippocampal volume (FreeSurfer); ROC cutoffs (Youden)
Best_Metric: Hazard ratio for MCI-to-AD conversion (Cox)
Best_AUC: not reported in source (survival analysis; no AUC reported)
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
Sample_N_Approx: 250 (70 CN, 119 MCI, 61 AD); 82 MCI followed for conversion
Key_Novelty: CSF alpha-syn aggregation splits prognosis: Syn1 MCI-to-AD HR 2.89; Syn0-AD faster decline/atrophy
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective ADNI subset; small conversion cohort (n=82); no external replication.
Open_Problems: Prospective validation; larger conversion cohorts; alpha-syn-tau mechanism studies; combination with ATN biomarkers.
Journal: The Journal of Prevention of Alzheimer's Disease 12: 100040, 2025 (Elsevier/SERDI)

Method_Architecture: Narrative review and mechanistic/therapeutic synthesis: TMAO origins/excretion; clinical associations with MCI; mechanisms (oxidative stress, BBB, synaptic plasticity, inflammation, mitochondrial disturbance, protein aggregation, CVD/metabolic pathways); TMAO-targeted therapies (diet, probiotics, drugs, FMT, lifestyle, TCM)
Best_Metric: not reported (narrative review)
Dataset: not reported in source (narrative review of TMAO-MCI literature)
Key_Novelty: Gut TMAO review: MCI risk factor (oxidative stress, BBB, plasticity) and treatment target
Primary_Limitation: Narrative (non-systematic) review; mostly preclinical evidence; causality unresolved.
Open_Problems: TMAO-targeted MCI clinical trials; TMAO-other-biomarker predictive models; causal status of TMAO in MCI.

Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional T2DM cohort (140; MoCA-classified 65 NCF/75 MCI); laboratory panel (FPG, HbA1c, FINS, lipids, AST/ALT); multivariate logistic regression; nomogram in R; C-index/ROC, calibration, DCA; 5-fold cross-validation
Best_Metric: C-index (nomogram discrimination)
Dataset: Own hospital cohort (Affiliated Hospital of Xuzhou Medical University; T2DM inpatients)
Key_Novelty: BVR-A + HOMA-IR nomogram (C-index 0.863) predicts MCI in T2DM; BVR-A strongest single marker
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional, no healthy controls; internal validation only; small sample.
Open_Problems: External multicentre validation; prospective cohorts; BVR-A-activating peptide therapies; BVR-A-insulin-resistance mechanism studies.

Modality: In vitro monocyte-derived microglia (MDMi) cytokine profiling (2D/3D)
Method_Architecture: PBMC-derived MDMi 2D/3D differentiation (14/35 days); LPS stimulation; minocycline/IC14 treatment; qRT-PCR (7 mRNAs); LEGENDplex 12-cytokine assay; LDH; PCA; hierarchical clustering; responder ranking (>=20% reduction)
Best_Metric: Multidimensional separation of donor cytokine profiles (PCA/clustering) + responder counts
Dataset: Own patient-derived cell cohorts: QIMR Berghofer PISA study (6 HC, 3 MCI, 3 AD donors, Brisbane, Australia)
Sample_N_Approx: 12 (6 HC, 3 MCI, 3 AD) + 3 young healthy donors for dose optimisation
Key_Novelty: Patient-specific 3D microglia pipeline stratifies MCI/AD and predicts drug responders pre-clinically
Primary_Limitation: Tiny cohorts (n=3 per patient group); LPS-only stimulus; microglia mono-culture; no AD-specificity validation.
Open_Problems: Larger genetically diverse cohorts (>=20/group); AD-relevant stimuli (tau, Abeta); astrocyte/neuron co-culture; non-AD neurodegenerative validation; confirm in vitro-clinical drug-response correlations.

Method_Architecture: ADNI retrospective cohort; SUVR with composite reference; brain amyloid smoothing scores (BASS); brain atrophy indices (BAI, SPM12); multiplicative shape feature (BASS x BAI); ROC with Youden's J; percent-change longitudinal analysis; Spearman correlations; FDR correction
Best_Metric: AUC (ROC) for MCI-to-AD conversion prediction
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, ADNI-2 and GO subsets)
Key_Novelty: Composite shape feature (amyloid BASS x atrophy BAI) predicts MCI-to-AD with AUC 0.891-0.898
Primary_Limitation: Single ADNI cohort; single amyloid tracer (AV-45); no tau/fluid biomarkers; observational design.
Open_Problems: Validation in diverse populations; incorporation of tau PET and fluid biomarkers (p-tau217); additional amyloid tracers; correction of atrophy-driven BASS artefact to reveal true amyloid dynamics; clinical trial stratification use.

Modality: Cholinergic precursor pharmacology (choline alphoscerate); no imaging modality
Method_Architecture: Narrative review: structured PubMed search (18 Jul 2024) with 'choline alphoscerate' + pharmacology/MCI/sleep/apathy terms; synthesis of choline metabolism (acetylcholine, phospholipids, betaine), clinical trial evidence, biomarker studies; expert-opinion dosing recommendations
Best_Metric: Cognitive improvement and conversion-rate differences (ADAS-cog change, MCI-to-AD conversion %)
Dataset: Literature review (PubMed and ad hoc searches; clinical studies of choline alphoscerate in MCI/dementia)
Sample_N_Approx: Not reported in source (narrative review; cited trials range ~100 patients each)
Key_Novelty: Positions choline alphoscerate as preventive therapy for MCI-to-AD and for sleep/non-cognitive symptoms
Primary_Limitation: Narrative review with sponsor-funded medical writing; heterogeneous small/older trials; preventive and sleep evidence emerging.
Open_Problems: Larger well-controlled RCTs in MCI with long follow-up; confirmatory MCI-to-AD preventive trials; mechanistic studies (Abeta injury, microglia activation, sleep architecture); head-to-head vs other nootropics.
Journal: Frontiers in Aging Neuroscience 17: 1613566, 2025 (Frontiers Media SA)

Modality: Florbetapir amyloid PET (AV45 SUVR) + cognitive assessments
Method_Architecture: ADNI (1/2/3/4/GO) amnestic MCI cohort; florbetapir PET Abeta+ cut-off >1.11; inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) with propensity scores; Kaplan-Meier; time-varying Cox (APOE e4 time-dependent); linear mixed-effects models (CDR-SB/MMSE/ADAS-cog13); LOESS regression; mediation via annual AV45 SUVR change; multiple imputation
Best_Metric: Hazard ratio (time-varying Cox) for MCI-to-AD progression; annual cognitive change (LME)
Best_AUC: Not reported (HR-based survival analysis, no AUC reported)
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative 1/2/3/4/GO)
Sample_N_Approx: 558 amnestic MCI (168 ChEI users, 390 non-users; 63 ChEI-initiation subgroup)
Key_Novelty: Amyloid-stratified ADNI shows ChEI use accelerates MCI-to-AD progression (HR 1.77) independent of Abeta
Primary_Limitation: Observational indication bias; no mortality/competing-risk data; ADNI-only DEI-limited sample; no randomisation.
Open_Problems: Long-term RCTs in larger diverse populations; systematic mortality/competing-risk data; prospective adherence/dosage documentation; replication of amyloid-stratified ChEI findings; biomarkers to identify MCI patients who might still benefit.
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia 21: e70193, 2025 (Wiley on behalf of Alzheimer's Association)

Modality: Dietary choline intake (nutritional exposure; no imaging)
Method_Architecture: UK Biobank prospective cohort; Oxford WebQ 24-h dietary recalls (>=2, mean of all surveys); McCance and Widdowson/USDA choline values; ICD-9/10 coded incident dementia/AD/MCI; computerized touchscreen cognitive tests; quartile-based Cox and logistic regression; restricted cubic splines; multiple imputation; Heckman selection models
Best_Metric: Hazard ratio / odds ratio with 95% CI (dementia, AD, MCI incidence; cognitive performance)
Dataset: United Kingdom Biobank (England, Scotland, Wales)
Key_Novelty: First longitudinal choline-MCI study; U-shaped dose-response with dementia/AD; 332.89-353.93 mg/d protective range
Primary_Limitation: Observational; self-reported diet without circulating choline; MCI under-ascertained from hospital records; UK Biobank homogeneity.
Open_Problems: Precision-nutrition genotyping of choline-metabolism variants; circulating choline biomarkers and brain-uptake quantification; more diverse cohorts; better MCI case ascertainment; mechanism of U-shaped curve (TMA/TMAO conversion).
Journal: The American Journal of Clinical Nutrition 121(1): 5-13, 2025 (Elsevier/ASN)

Modality: Plasma p-tau181 blood biomarker (electrochemical impedance biosensor)
Method_Architecture: Label-free EIS biosensor: ITO micro-electrode with electrodeposited rGO/beta-cyclodextrin nanocomposite; anti-p-tau181 antibody immobilisation + BSA blocking; electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (1 Hz-100 kHz) charge-transfer resistance (dR); Langmuir isotherm KD; ROC analysis; one-way ANOVA with Tukey post-hoc
Best_Metric: AUC (ROC) for AD-vs-healthy and MCI-vs-healthy discrimination
Best_AUC: 0.94 (AD vs healthy; sensitivity 95%, specificity 85%); 0.75 (MCI vs healthy)
Dataset: Own clinical cohort (Inha University Hospital, Incheon, South Korea)
Key_Novelty: First label-free EIS biosensor for clinical plasma p-tau181 (LOD 0.92 fg/mL; KD 0.533 pM); AD AUC 0.94
Primary_Limitation: Small single-centre sample; moderate MCI discrimination (AUC 0.75); no cross-platform validation against established immunoassays.
Open_Problems: Larger multicentre validation cohorts; comparison with SIMOA/established p-tau181 assays; multi-marker panels (Abeta, p-tau217, GFAP); longitudinal studies of prognostic value for MCI-to-AD conversion; standardisation of dilution and cut-offs.

Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional T2DM cohort; MoCA-based MCI classification (MCI = MoCA<26); serum RBP assay after 8h fasting; fasting glucose, HbA1c, C-peptide, lipid panel; neuropsychological batteries (CDT, VFT, DST, TMT-A/B); ANCOVA (age covariate); Spearman/partial correlations; backward stepwise binary logistic regression; ROC curve
Best_Metric: AUC (ROC) for serum RBP predicting diabetic MCI
Dataset: Own hospital cohort (Second Hospital of Shandong University, Jinan, China; T2DM inpatients)
Key_Novelty: First report linking serum RBP to diabetic MCI; low RBP independent risk factor (OR 0.936)
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional; small sample; no vitamin A measurement; modest diagnostic AUC 0.630.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal studies for causality; direct measurement of vitamin A, RBP and retinol-signalling molecules; mechanistic studies of RBP in glucose metabolism and cognition; external validation of the diagnostic cut-off.

Modality: 1H NMR metabolomics of plasma, urine and saliva
Method_Architecture: 1H NMR (CPMG, 298K, 1024 scans) metabolomics of plasma/urine/saliva; TOCSY/HSQC metabolite identification; Pareto-scaled spectral binning (0.02 ppm); PCA; PLS-DA with cross-validation/permutation; Mann-Whitney U with FDR (Q=1%); KEGG pathway enrichment; MetaboAnalyst metabolite-gene-disease networks cross-referenced with GWAS Catalog
Best_Metric: PLS-DA model fit (R2/Q2) and FDR-significant metabolite differences
Best_AUC: Not reported (no ROC classification AUC reported)
Dataset: Own cohort (UERJ clinics, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil; ethnically mixed, comorbidity-free)
Key_Novelty: First comorbidity-free ethnically mixed Brazilian multi-biofluid metabolomics; 6 GWAS genes common across biofluids
Primary_Limitation: No absolute metabolite quantification; small MCI/saliva samples; cross-sectional; modest urine/saliva PLS-DA predictive power.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal cohorts with quantitative assays; absolute metabolite quantification; multiomics-AI integration; validation of valine/alanine stage signatures as progression biomarkers; dietary/medication covariate control.

Method_Architecture: EMIF-AD MBD cross-cohort (11 European cohorts); 883 metabolites by 3 MS methods, 540 kept (kNN imputation, log10); 3630 proteins by SOMAscan (ComBat batch correction); multiclass NC/MCI/AD models per omic with 4 ML algorithms; paired 12-clinical-covariate + 3630-protein + 540-metabolite MCI conversion models; 3/4-algorithm agreement feature selection; EDAR cohort validation; in-vitro microglia oleamide release assay
Best_Metric: AUC for MCI conversion model (paired omics + clinical covariates)
Best_AUC: 0.872 (14-feature MCI conversion model); multiclass validation mean balanced accuracy 0.726 (metabolites) / 0.720 (proteins)
Dataset: EMIF-AD Multimodal Biomarker Discovery Study (11 European cohorts; EDAR cohort for validation)
Sample_N_Approx: 800 (230 NC, 386 MCI, 184 AD); 194 MCI with paired omics and follow-up for conversion models
Key_Novelty: First paired plasma proteomics-metabolomics MCI-conversion study; oleamide released by disease-associated microglia
Primary_Limitation: Moderate conversion cohort (194 MCI); no single protein selected by all algorithms; models include clinical covariates (amyloid, MMSE).
Open_Problems: Larger multi-omics conversion cohorts; functional validation of oleamide/SNCA/CFP axes in human tissue; prospective validation of the 14-feature conversion signature; replication in diverse populations; standardised panels for clinical translation.

Modality: Longitudinal serum lipid profiles (TC, HDL-C, LDL-C, non-HDL-C, triglycerides)
Method_Architecture: Retrospective DodoNA Project case-control; DSM-IV diagnoses; propensity matching (MatchIt); nonparametric group-based trajectory models (traj plugin, tobit link, 3-group solutions); variability independent of the mean (VIM) quintiles; multilevel mixed-effects longitudinal models; covariate-adjusted logistic regression with AIC backward selection and cluster-robust SEs; AD/lipid PRS (EUR ancestry) and APOE-genotype models; AUROC comparison (roccomp)
Best_Metric: Odds ratio (risk model) with AUROC improvement from lipid groups
Best_AUC: Not reported as single model AUC (AUROC comparisons reported graphically; lipid groups significantly improved model AUROC, Bonferroni-corrected)
Dataset: DodoNA Project EHR (NorthShore/Endeavor Health, Skokie-Evanston IL; community practice)
Sample_N_Approx: 698 AD cohort (215 cases/483 controls); 551 MCI cohort (116/435)
Key_Novelty: Lipid trajectories + VIM over decade pre-onset improve AD/MCI risk prediction beyond APOE/PRS; low TC VIM raises AD risk
Primary_Limitation: Retrospective; stable-MCI only (>=5 years); irregular lipid measurements; contrasts with high-variability VIM findings in prior literature.
Open_Problems: Prospective validation of lipid-trajectory/VIM risk models; harmonised VIM methodology across cohorts; non-Caucasian populations; modelling MCI converters separately; direct comparison with survival-based incident-dementia designs.
Journal: Journal of Lipid Research 66(1): 100714, 2025 (ASBMB/Elsevier, open access)

Method_Architecture: Prospective outpatient cohort; serum ApoJ ELISA (Mabtech); tertile stratification; Kaplan-Meier; Cox proportional hazards adjusted for age/MMSE/GDS/IADL; Schoenfeld residuals
Best_Metric: Hazard ratio (adjusted HR 2.01 for lowest vs highest ApoJ tertile, >=2 years follow-up)
Dataset: Two Italian memory clinics (Casa Sollievo della Sofferenza, San Giovanni Rotondo; S. Anna University Hospital, Ferrara)
Key_Novelty: Low serum ApoJ tertile predicts doubled post-2-year MCI-to-dementia conversion risk
Primary_Limitation: No healthy controls, single ApoJ timepoint, and no cytokine measurements to test the inflammation-mediated mechanism.
Open_Problems: sApoJ/nApoJ subtype effects; serial ApoJ tracking; complementing CSF/PET biomarkers; assay harmonisation.

Modality: HTT CAG-repeat intermediate alleles + APOE genotyping (genetics)
Method_Architecture: 12-year follow-up SCD cohort; HTT CAG-repeat genotyping; IA+ vs IA- stratification; APOE e4 and age-at-onset subgroup analysis; relative-risk estimation
Best_Metric: Relative risk (IA+ vs IA-: ~2x in APOE e4 carriers; 1.84x in age-at-onset >60 group)
Dataset: University of Florence SCD cohort (Italy)
Key_Novelty: HTT intermediate alleles interact with APOE/age to raise SCD-to-MCI progression risk
Primary_Limitation: Conference-abstract evidence with a small IA+ subgroup (n=10) and no full interaction modelling reported.
Open_Problems: Larger IA+ cohorts; full gene-environment interaction models; replication in independent SCD cohorts.
Journal: Journal of the Neurological Sciences (meeting abstract, 2021; abstract 119020)

Method_Architecture: Memory clinic cohort; plasma p-tau181 Simoa assay; CSF AT(N) classification; ROC with Youden cut-off; sensitivity/specificity
Best_Metric: AUC 0.910 (plasma p-tau181 discriminating AP+ vs AP-)
Dataset: Careggi Hospital Centre for Alzheimer's Disease and Adult Cognitive Disorders, Florence, Italy
Sample_N_Approx: 79 patients (33 SCD, 32 MCI, 14 AD-d); 72 with CSF
Key_Novelty: Plasma p-tau181 AUC 0.910 detects AT(N)-defined AD pathology in SCD/MCI
Primary_Limitation: Small sample with no healthy controls; cross-sectional; cut-off not validated externally.
Open_Problems: External validation of the 2.69 pg/mL cut-off; longitudinal p-tau181 trajectories; assay harmonisation.
Journal: Journal of the Neurological Sciences 453: 120805, 2023 (Elsevier, open access)

Modality: Florbetapir PET amyloid + structural MRI hippocampal volume + cognitive testing
Method_Architecture: ADNI cohorts; florbetapir PET SUVR; hippocampal volumetry; Cog_Vol composite parameter; quartile stratification; Kaplan-Meier conversion analysis; external validation (Shanghai-derived model)
Best_Metric: Conversion rate stratification (94.1% for Cog_Vol<101; 0% for >=340 in elevated-amyloid MCI)
Best_AUC: Not reported as a single AUC (risk classification by conversion rates)
Dataset: ADNI1 + ADNI GO/2 (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative); original model from Shanghai MCI cohort
Sample_N_Approx: 843 MCI subjects (220 with elevated PET beta-amyloid)
Key_Novelty: Cog_Vol parameter stratifies MCI-to-AD risk from 94.1% to ~0%, ADNI-validated
Primary_Limitation: Group-level rather than individual risk prediction; no tau/p-tau217 biomarkers; intermediate-risk band not individually classifiable.
Open_Problems: Individual-level prediction; tau incorporation; intermediate-band resolution; prospective validation.
Journal: Journal of the Neurological Sciences 467: 123319, 2024 (Elsevier, open access)

Modality: Standard clinical data with CSF t-tau/Abeta ratio categorisation
Method_Architecture: Multi-step ML pipeline; standard clinical features; CSF t-tau/Abeta ratio strata; 3-year conversion prediction; SHAP interpretability; accuracy reporting
Best_Metric: Accuracy 88% (AD-like CSF stratum); 86% (CSF-negative); 84% (overall)
Best_AUC: Not reported (accuracy reported instead of AUC)
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
Key_Novelty: ML on standard clinical data reaches 84-88% 3-year conversion accuracy; CSF adds value
Primary_Limitation: Conference-abstract evidence with no model specification, external validation or formal CSF-increment statistics.
Open_Problems: Full model specification; external validation; formal CSF-increment significance testing.
Journal: Journal of the Neurological Sciences (meeting abstract, 2025; abstract 123929)

Method_Architecture: Dementia outpatient clinic cohort; PSQI questionnaire; Spearman correlations; linear regression of CSF t-tau on sleep components; cognitive assessment
Best_Metric: Regression F-statistic for daytime dysfunction predicting CSF t-tau (F=57.162, p=0.004)
Dataset: Dementia Outpatient Clinic, Centro Hospitalar e Universitario de Coimbra, Portugal
Key_Novelty: PSQI daytime dysfunction independently predicts CSF t-tau in MCI/AD
Primary_Limitation: No control group, no objective sleep measurement (OSA not excluded), and no multiple-comparison correction.
Open_Problems: Objective sleep measures (actigraphy/PSG); OSA exclusion; longitudinal sleep-CSF studies.

Method_Architecture: HFD+CMS MCI mouse model (C57BL/6J); barley polysaccharide intervention; 16S rRNA sequencing; SCFA quantification; metabolomics; behavioural NODI tests; one-way ANOVA with Tukey post-hoc
Best_Metric: Not applicable (behavioural NODI restoration, p<0.05; no classifier metric)
Dataset: Own animal study (C57BL/6J mice, Tsingtao Brewery/Ocean University of China)
Key_Novelty: Barley polysaccharides mitigate MCI in HFD+CMS mice via liver-gut-brain axis multi-pathway
Primary_Limitation: Preclinical mouse model with small n; microbiota/SCFA mechanisms correlational, not causally established.
Open_Problems: Causal microbiota manipulation (FMT); human translation; dose-response optimisation.

Modality: Blood metal elements + plasma Abeta/tau and oxidative-stress biomarkers
Method_Architecture: Shanghai community cohort; ICP-MS blood metal quantification; MoCA cognitive screening; WQS regression; qgcomp; mediation analysis with SOD oxidative-stress markers
Best_Metric: qgcomp beta for MoCA (beta -0.394, 95% CI -0.744 to -0.044, p=0.027); WQS index associations
Dataset: Shanghai community health centres elderly cohort, China (2021)
Key_Novelty: Mixed blood metal exposure linked to MCI markers with SOD-mediated oxidative stress
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional design; MoCA-based MCI without clinical diagnosis; single-city sample limits generalisability.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal metal-exposure trajectories; clinical diagnosis; multi-city replication; mediation with additional markers.
Journal: Ecotoxicology and Environmental Safety 302: 118617, 2025 (Elsevier, open access)

Modality: Blood biomarkers (Abeta, tau, NfL, APP metabolism; plasma/serum/platelet)
Method_Architecture: Systematic review + random-effects ratio-of-means meta-analysis; diagnostic accuracy synthesis; PubMed/Embase/Cochrane to May 2021
Best_Metric: Ratio-of-means effect sizes and diagnostic AUC ranges (P-tau217 AUC 0.97-0.98)
Dataset: 150 published studies (PubMed/Embase/Cochrane, inception to May 2021)
Key_Novelty: 150-study meta-analysis: blood tau/NfL up; P-tau217 AUC 0.97 across control-aMCI-AD
Primary_Limitation: High assay/study heterogeneity and publication bias for Abeta40/Abeta42-40; single biomarkers insufficiently specific alone.
Open_Problems: Assay standardisation; combination biomarker panels; prospective validation of P-tau217 cut-offs.

Modality: Plasma exosomal lncRNA/mRNA expression (RNA-seq and qRT-PCR)
Method_Architecture: Guangzhou community cohort; exosome isolation; RNA-seq discovery; qRT-PCR validation; logistic regression risk models; ROC analysis; external validation in AddNeuroMed (GSE63060) with target genes
Best_Metric: AUC 0.700 (combined exosomal lncRNA panel)
Best_AUC: 0.700 (95% CI 0.641-0.760; sensitivity 72.0%, specificity 60.7%); external target-gene AUC 0.695
Dataset: Guangzhou community cohort (China) + AddNeuroMed consortium (GSE63060)
Key_Novelty: Plasma exosomal lncRNA panel (LINC001380, ENST00000484033, ENST00000531087) for MCI diagnosis
Primary_Limitation: Moderate AUC (0.70); external validation used target genes (ATP2A2/PSEN1) not the lncRNAs; Chinese-population-only lncRNA evidence.
Open_Problems: External validation on the lncRNA panel itself; multi-ethnic cohorts; mechanistic studies of exosomal lncRNAs.

Modality: Serum and CSF bacterial LPS and COX-1/2 (inflammation biomarkers) - indirect ELISA
Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional biomarker study; indirect ELISA for LPS, COX-1, COX-2 in serum (1000x) and CSF (25x) dilution; ROC curve analysis with AUC for HC/AD/MCI pair discrimination; Spearman correlations; multilinear regression with backward elimination; G*Power a priori power analysis
Best_Metric: ROC AUC for serum LPS discriminating HC vs AD and MCI vs AD (values shown graphically)
Best_AUC: Not reported numerically in text (AUC in ROC figures; serum LPS described as very good biomarker)
Dataset: Own cohort - AHEPA University General Hospital and GAADRD, Thessaloniki, Greece
Sample_N_Approx: Serum 57 (18 AD, 26 MCI, 13 HC); CSF 124 (54 AD, 47 MCI, 23 HC)
Key_Novelty: First paired serum+CSF LPS/COX profile at MCI stage; LPS correlates with Abeta/tau/MMSE
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional, no conversion follow-up; semi-quantitative ELISA; exact ROC AUC/cut-offs not reported numerically.
Open_Problems: Quantitative assays with exact cut-offs; longitudinal follow-up for conversion; larger independent cohorts; LPS-binding protein and cytokine panels.

Modality: Salivary GFAP plus Abeta42, p-tau, cytokines, COX-2, caspase-8 (non-invasive fluid biomarkers)
Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional; saliva ELISA + Dot Blot + Western Blot (densitometry, normalised to protein); ROC with Youden J index; Mann-Whitney U; Spearman correlations; multilinear regression
Best_Metric: Youden J index (0.95 ELISA, 1.0 Dot Blot for MCI vs controls; sensitivity 95-100%, specificity 100%)
Best_AUC: Not reported numerically (ROC curves in figures; J-index cut-offs in text)
Dataset: Own cohort - AHEPA University General Hospital and GAADRD, Thessaloniki, Greece
Key_Novelty: First paired ELISA/Dot Blot/WB salivary GFAP MCI/AD diagnostic with neuroinflammatory panel
Primary_Limitation: Small single-centre cohorts (n=20/group), cross-sectional, salivary GFAP direction opposite to plasma GFAP literature.
Open_Problems: Larger and independent cohorts; longitudinal follow-up; plasma-GFAP comparison in same subjects; other-dementia controls.

Modality: Acupuncture and moxibustion interventions (non-pharmacological therapy outcomes, MMSE/MoCA)
Method_Architecture: PRISMA systematic review (PROSPERO CRD42023452322); 8 databases incl. CNKI/WANFANG/VIP/SinoMed; Cochrane RoB; Bayesian network meta-analysis in R 4.2.3; MD with 95% CI; SUCRA ranking; node-splitting inconsistency; funnel plots
Best_Metric: Mean difference in MMSE/MoCA with 95% CI (ACP+CT+EARA MD 4.54 MMSE; ACP+CT MD 4.08 MoCA)
Best_AUC: Not reported (no ROC/AUC; intervention effect sizes reported)
Dataset: 46 RCTs from PubMed, Embase, Cochrane, Web of Science, CNKI, WANFANG, VIP, SinoMed
Key_Novelty: First Bayesian NMA ranking 21 acupuncture/moxibustion regimens for MCI
Primary_Limitation: Regimen heterogeneity and publication-bias signal; Chinese-dominant evidence; no dementia-conversion endpoints.
Open_Problems: Standardised acupuncture protocols; multi-centre direct comparisons of top-ranked regimens; conversion endpoints; pre-registration.
Journal: Archives of Gerontology and Geriatrics 120: 105328, 2024 (Elsevier, open access)

Modality: Longitudinal sMRI cerebral atrophy rate (GBMT) combined with plasma microglial proteins (AXL, CD40, TNF-R2)
Method_Architecture: ADNI; group-based multi-trajectory modeling (GBMT) on longitudinal T1 sMRI (1-5 years); baseline plasma microglial proteins; generalized linear models for class-protein associations; linear mixed-effects models for protein x class interactions on longitudinal cognition
Best_Metric: Not reported as classifier (latent-class model and LME interaction statistics; no ROC/AUC)
Best_AUC: Not reported (no ROC/AUC analysis; trajectory and LME interaction statistics)
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
Sample_N_Approx: 630 MCI subjects (260 with baseline plasma protein data)
Key_Novelty: First linkage of GBMT atrophy-rate subtypes with plasma microglial proteins (AXL/CD40/TNF-R2)
Primary_Limitation: ADNI-only with no external replication; plasma proteins available for 260/630 subjects only; no conversion endpoint.
Open_Problems: External validation; serial plasma proteins; CSF amyloid/tau strata; conversion-to-AD outcomes.

Method_Architecture: Prospective cohort; baseline blood HCy; MCI per Petersen criteria subtyped aMCI/naMCI; neuropsychological battery; Cox proportional hazards for time-to-dementia; HCy tertiles; subtype x HCy analysis; reference-group analysis with 16 umol/L cut-off
Best_Metric: Hazard ratio (highest HCy tertile HR 2.25, 95% CI 1.05-4.86)
Best_AUC: Not reported (no ROC/AUC analysis; hazard ratios reported)
Dataset: Two Italian memory clinics - S. Anna University Hospital, Ferrara and Casa Sollievo della Sofferenza, San Giovanni Rotondo
Key_Novelty: Subtype-stratified (naMCI-specific) homocysteine prediction of MCI-to-dementia progression
Primary_Limitation: Observational with 151 dropouts; single baseline HCy; no B-vitamin correction in all models.
Open_Problems: Multi-centre prospective cohorts with serial HCy and B-vitamin measures; larger naMCI converter numbers; B-vitamin RCT.

Modality: Resting-state fMRI functional connectivity with CSF AT(N) biomarkers and anosognosia
Method_Architecture: ADNI; resting-state fMRI; local intrinsic correlation for local coupling; independent component analysis for between-network connectivity; AT(N) CSF profiling; voxel-wise linear regression for anosognosia in prodromal AD; FDR cluster correction p<0.05
Best_Metric: Not reported as classifier (cluster statistics T/p-FDR reported; no ROC/AUC)
Best_AUC: Not reported (no ROC/AUC analysis; FC cluster statistics reported)
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
Sample_N_Approx: 121 for FC analysis; 73 for anosognosia analysis
Key_Novelty: First AT(N)-profile-based FC characterisation of the AD continuum with an ACC anosognosia correlate
Primary_Limitation: ADNI-only, cross-sectional, moderate samples; CSF-based AT(N); no conversion endpoints.
Open_Problems: External validation; longitudinal FC; PET-based AT(N); standardised anosognosia instruments.

Modality: Serum and CSF NGAL/lipocalin-2 plus CSF Abeta/tau (neuroinflammatory biomarkers) - ELISA
Method_Architecture: Prospective multi-centre cohort (8 memory clinics); baseline serum/CSF NGAL and CSF Abeta1-42, t-tau, p-tau by ELISA; 2-year follow-up; multivariate logistic regression (age/sex adjusted); Hosmer-Lemeshow fit; correlations
Best_Metric: Odds ratio for 2-year MCI-to-AD conversion (CSF NGAL OR 2.27, 95% CI 1.15-4.46)
Best_AUC: Not reported (no ROC/AUC analysis; adjusted odds ratios reported)
Dataset: Eight academic memory clinics in the Netherlands (Amsterdam, Maastricht, Groningen, Utrecht, Nijmegen, Rotterdam)
Sample_N_Approx: 268 participants (82 SCD, 98 MCI, 88 AD dementia); 2-year follow-up
Key_Novelty: First longitudinal evidence that low baseline CSF NGAL predicts MCI-to-AD conversion (OR 2.27)
Primary_Limitation: No ROC/incremental-value analysis beyond core biomarkers; 2-year horizon; modest converter numbers; serum NGAL null.
Open_Problems: ROC-based incremental analysis; longer follow-up; serial NGAL; external validation.

Modality: CSF neurofilament light plus Abeta42, P-tau, T-tau (neurodegeneration biomarkers) - MSD immunoassay
Method_Architecture: Longitudinal cohort (24-month) with 6-10 year re-evaluation; CSF NfL by Meso Scale Discovery; core CSF panel; stable vs converter aMCI comparison; logistic discrimination model comparison (core vs NfL-substituted)
Best_Metric: Not reported as single classifier metric (group separation p=0.004 stable vs converter aMCI)
Best_AUC: Not reported (no ROC/AUC analysis; group comparisons and model separation reported)
Dataset: University Hospital of Trondheim / NTNU, Norway cohort
Sample_N_Approx: 135 (52 controls, 55 aMCI, 28 probable AD); re-evaluated after 6-10 years
Key_Novelty: NfL predicts aMCI conversion but adds no improvement over core Abeta42/P-tau/T-tau model
Primary_Limitation: Modest sample, 24-month window, no external validation; NfL provides no improvement over core biomarkers.
Open_Problems: Larger multi-centre cohorts; longer follow-up; ROC/net-reclassification analyses; combined NfL+AT models.

Modality: CSF peptides VGF, NPTX2, GAP-43, CHI3L1, SPP1, YWHAZ plus Abeta/tau (mass spectrometry proteomics)
Method_Architecture: ADNI CSF; mass-spectrometry peptides; AT markers (CSF Abeta1-42, t-tau, p-tau); multiple ML algorithms (RLL, RRF, SGB, BEN); balanced accuracy for disease-state; 36-month EMCI/LMCI conversion prediction; independent ADNI subcohort VGF replication
Best_Metric: Balanced accuracy (AT+VGF 85.4% CUI-vs-AD; EMCI conversion accuracy 76.5%, LMCI 81.1%)
Best_AUC: Not reported (balanced accuracy and classification accuracy reported)
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative) plus independent ADNI subcohort
Sample_N_Approx: EMCI 187 (168 stable/19 converters) + LMCI 119 (63 stable/56 converters); full sample for state classification
Key_Novelty: Low CSF VGF proposed as ATN N-marker predicting MCI-to-AD conversion, even in AT-negative MCI
Primary_Limitation: ADNI-only (replication within ADNI, not independent); different VGF fragments across cohorts; small AT-negative converter strata.
Open_Problems: Non-ADNI external validation; standardised VGF assay; head-to-head with tau-PET/MRI N markers.

Modality: Arterial spin labeling MRI cerebral blood flow with cognitive reserve proxy (VIQ) and language/memory measures
Method_Architecture: ADNI; ASL-MRI CBF in 4 a priori regions; estimated VIQ as CR proxy; neuropsychological memory/language measures; multiple linear regressions with two- and three-way CBF x VIQ x cognitive-status interactions
Best_Metric: Not reported as classifier (regression interaction estimates and p-values; no ROC/AUC)
Best_AUC: Not reported (no ROC/AUC analysis; regression interaction statistics)
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
Key_Novelty: First demonstration that cognitive reserve (VIQ) strengthens CBF-language association in MCI
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional, small MCI group (n=46), VIQ proxy for reserve, ADNI-only; moderation on fluency only.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal CBF/cognition; larger MCI sample; additional CR proxies; external validation.

Modality: Gamma tACS neuromodulation with resting-state fMRI connectivity, plasma AD biomarkers and episodic memory
Method_Architecture: Open-label pilot; 8 x 60-min 40-Hz gamma tACS targeting hippocampus/IPL/pars triangularis; RSFC and E/I balance readouts; modeled electric-field dose-response; plasma AD biomarkers
Best_Metric: Not applicable as classifier (episodic memory improvement and connectivity changes; no classification metric)
Dataset: Own UCSF Memory and Aging Center pilot cohort (aMCI)
Key_Novelty: First gamma tACS pilot in aMCI linking electric-field dose to episodic memory gain
Primary_Limitation: Open-label, no sham control, small n=13; no biomarker change; hypothesis-generating.
Open_Problems: Sham-controlled trials; durability of effects; biomarker-stratified patient selection; combined stimulation with cognitive training.

Modality: Memory-clinic cohort (SCI/MCI) with CSF biomarkers (Abeta42, p-tau), MRI MTA/WMH visual ratings and neuropsychology
Method_Architecture: Comparison of inclusive (CSF Abeta42+), less-inclusive (MTA) and data-driven (WMH) subgrouping approaches in naturalistic multicenter MemClin cohort
Best_Metric: Not reported as classifier (qualitative and statistical comparison of subgroup capture)
Dataset: MemClin-cohort (Karolinska Institute multicenter memory clinic, Sweden)
Key_Novelty: Direct comparison of three subgrouping approaches in one naturalistic SCI/MCI cohort
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional; no longitudinal subgroup validation; single-cohort; approach results depend on biomarker availability.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal subgroup validation; external replication; standardized biomarker cutoffs; trial-enrichment application.

Modality: Structural MRI with plasma biomarkers (NfL, p-tau181, Abeta42/40), demographics/APOE4 and cognitive composites
Method_Architecture: Two-stage ridge linear regression + random forest regression; four model variants (basic/plasma/MRI/combined); cross-validation; C-index and Kaplan-Meier for progression
Best_Metric: Cross-validated correlation of predicted vs actual decline rates (memory 0.50) and C-index for progression
Best_AUC: Not reported (C-index used: 0.76 CU combined, 0.79 MCI combined)
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
Sample_N_Approx: 625 (Cohort 1: 162 CN, 90 SMC, 244 EMCI, 129 LMCI); Cohort 2 n=393
Key_Novelty: Plasma+MRI+APOE4 decline prediction with memory-domain C-index gains in CU and MCI
Primary_Limitation: ADNI-only, internal cross-validation; best performance limited to memory domain; plasma value weaker outside memory.
Open_Problems: External validation; additional plasma biomarkers; longer follow-up; clinical risk-stratification translation.

Modality: 16S rRNA gut microbiome profiling with cognitive assessment (MCI status)
Method_Architecture: Double-blind placebo-controlled RCT of Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG (3 months); 16S rRNA sequencing; ALDEx2/ANCOM-BC differential abundance; Bracken species classification; ZIBR longitudinal models
Best_Metric: Not applicable as classifier (differential abundance statistics and cognitive scores)
Dataset: Own cohort: 169 community-dwelling middle-aged/older adults (RCT NCT03080818)
Sample_N_Approx: 169 (randomized to LGG or placebo; subgroups by cognitive status)
Key_Novelty: RCT showing LGG lowers MCI-associated Prevotella abundance correlated with improved cognition
Primary_Limitation: Moderate sample; 16S resolution; 3-month duration; correlational microbiome-cognition links.
Open_Problems: Larger multi-site RCTs; longer follow-up; shotgun metagenomics; concurrent biomarker endpoints.

Modality: Tensor-based morphometry of temporal lobe atrophy with plasma Abeta42/40/ratio biomarkers
Method_Architecture: ADNI longitudinal MRI; tensor-based morphometry; temporal lobe ROI summaries; plasma Abeta42/40/ratio; linear mixed models with FDR correction at baseline/24/48 months
Best_Metric: Not applicable as classifier (regression beta coefficients and p-values for plasma Abeta - TBM associations)
Dataset: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
Key_Novelty: Longitudinal TBM test of plasma Abeta - temporal lobe atrophy association in early ADNI
Primary_Limitation: Very small sample (n=29); mostly null; scattered 48-month associations only; no CSF/PET amyloid reference.
Open_Problems: Larger samples; longer follow-up; CSF/PET amyloid cross-validation; harmonized TBM pipelines.

Modality: Plasma vitamin D and inflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha) with DTI white matter ADC and cognition
Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional biomarker study; plasma vitamin D and cytokine ELISA; DTI with ADC for white matter; cognitive assessment; group comparisons
Best_Metric: Not applicable as classifier (group-level biomarker and ADC comparisons)
Dataset: Own cohort of elderly subjects, North-Eastern India (Banaras Hindu University)
Key_Novelty: Combined plasma vitamin D + inflammatory cytokines + DTI white matter profile in Indian elderly MCI
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional; incomplete group-size detail; regional ADC focus; confounding by seasonality/comorbidities.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal follow-up; larger samples; whole-brain tractography; standardized vitamin D assays.

Modality: Complement proteins C5b-9/C3b/Factor B in serum astrocyte-derived exosomes with cognitive assessment in T1DM
Method_Architecture: Cross-sectional study; ELISA of complement proteins in serum ADEs; cognitive evaluation; logistic regression (OR); ROC analysis of combined markers
Best_Metric: AUC of combined complement proteins (C5b-9 + C3b + Factor B)
Dataset: Own cohort: T1DM patients and healthy controls (Weihai Municipal Hospital, China)
Key_Novelty: Serum astrocyte-exosome complement C5b-9 as MCI marker in T1DM (AUC 0.76)
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional, small MCI subgroup, single-centre; no non-diabetic MCI comparator; exosome assay variability.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal MCI-progression prediction; multi-centre replication; additional complement markers; mechanistic validation.

Modality: Plasma CDR1as and alpha-synuclein with neuropsychological memory assessment in T2DM
Method_Architecture: Multivariable regression and restricted cubic spline analyses; mediation analysis of alpha-Syn on CDR1as-MCI/memory associations
Best_Metric: Odds ratio for CDR1as-MCI association (OR 0.45) and mediation proportion
Dataset: Own cohort: 579 T2DM subjects (Zhongda Hospital, Southeast University, China)
Key_Novelty: First quantification of alpha-Syn-mediated CDR1as protection against MCI/memory decline in T2DM
