Journal: Alzheimer's Research & Therapy 14: 93, 2022 (BMC/Springer Nature, open access)

Modality: Blood gene expression of inflammatory pathway genes (qPCR arrays)
Method_Architecture: Boruta feature selection; random forest pairwise classifiers; SMOTE balancing; STRING networks; KEGG pathway enrichment
Best_Metric: Classification accuracy 59.55% (CN-vs-MCI) / 56.65% (MCI-vs-AD) on ADNI, significantly above chance
Dataset: National Neuroscience Institute Singapore (discovery, 254) + ADNI (external validation, 744)
Key_Novelty: Inflammatory blood-gene DEGs + PI3K-Akt/IL-17/JAK-STAT/TNF/Ras pathways as MCI-AD drug targets
Primary_Limitation: Modest accuracies (~56-60%); heterogeneous transcriptomes; no amyloid/tau corroboration; small discovery cohort.
Open_Problems: Larger multi-cohort validation; brain-blood expression concordance; IL-17/TNF pathway intervention trials; amyloid/tau confirmation.
Journal: Frontiers in Digital Health 4: 875895, 2022 (Frontiers Media, open access)

Modality: Blood RNA-seq immune-cell composition; TCR/BCR repertoire diversity; WDR37 expression
Method_Architecture: CIBERSORT/MCP-counter deconvolution; TRUST4 repertoire detection (inverse Simpson); edgeR DEG; qRT-PCR; Cox PH prognosis model with 5-fold CV + independent validation
Best_Metric: C-index 0.694 (discovery) / 0.643 (validation); log-rank P=2.57e-3 risk-group classification
Dataset: National Center for Geriatrics and Gerontology (NCGG) Biobank, Japan
Sample_N_Approx: 856 (317 AD, 432 MCI, 107 CN); 145 followed MCI (52 converters)
Key_Novelty: Immune repertoire (IGK+TRA) + WDR37 blood model classifies MCI-to-AD risk; validated C-index 0.643
Primary_Limitation: Small MCI converter/non-converter samples; modest C-index; WDR37 only suggestive in RNA-seq (FDR 0.11).
Open_Problems: Larger samples; integration with genetic variation, miRNA, plasma p-tau/NfL, ATN pathology; prospective multi-centre validation.

Modality: Blood SNP genotypes of the neurotrophin signalling pathway; pathway-PRS
Method_Architecture: Cox PH single-locus + BFDP; LD clumping; PRSice-2 PRS; time-dependent ROC; LMM
Best_Metric: AUC 0.720 (3-yr MCI-to-AD, PRS) vs 0.682 without (ADNI, p=0.003); NACC 0.609 vs 0.586
Dataset: ADNI (all phases, discovery) + NACC (replication)
Key_Novelty: Six novel neurotrophin-pathway SNPs + PRS improve 3-year MCI-to-AD prediction (AUC 0.720)
Primary_Limitation: NACC lacks CSF/imaging longitudinal phenotypes; 4 of 6 SNPs have no brain eQTL evidence.
Open_Problems: Functional validation of identified SNPs; replication of longitudinal biomarker associations; multi-ancestry replication.
Journal: Journal of Alzheimer's Disease 91(3): 977-987, 2023 (IOS Press, open access)

Method_Architecture: LASSO + stepwise logistic regression; nomogram; calibration; decision curve analysis
Best_Metric: AUC 0.81 (held-out validation; training 0.74; abstract states 0.75)
Dataset: Community cohort of 60 communities, western China (West China Hospital of Sichuan University)
Key_Novelty: First EGEG gastrointestinal-myoelectrical nomogram for MCI risk screening (validation AUC 0.81)
Primary_Limitation: Single-region community sample; cross-sectional screening design; internal abstract/results AUC discrepancy (0.75 vs 0.81).
Open_Problems: Prospective multi-centre validation; EGEG parameter standardisation across devices; longitudinal MCI-incidence design.

Modality: Clinical case: CSF AD biomarkers + amyloid PET + neuropsychological assessment
Method_Architecture: Single-case longitudinal descriptive study (CSF/amyloid-PET biomarkers; serial neuropsychology)
Best_Metric: not reported
Dataset: HealthPartners Neuroscience Center/Research Institute single patient cohort (Saint Paul, MN, USA)
Key_Novelty: Documented A+/T+/N+ prodromal AD 'long-term non-progressor' with stable phenotype >10 years
Primary_Limitation: Single-case evidence; no serial biomarker follow-up; alternative pathologies not excluded without autopsy.
Open_Problems: Define non-progressor criteria; larger case series with serial biomarkers; autopsy confirmation.
Journal: Journal of Alzheimer's Disease Reports 7(1): 37-40, 2023 (IOS Press, open access)

Modality: Plasmatic MMP1/2/9/10 and TIMP1/2 (ELISA) with clinical cognitive assessment
Method_Architecture: Randomised double-blind sham-controlled rTMS RCT; Quade rank ANCOVA; Mann-Whitney U; Pearson correlations
Best_Metric: MMP1/9/10 reduced and TIMP1/2 increased at 6 mo vs sham (p<=0.05); RBANS Line Orientation Quade p=0.002 (adj 0.038)
Dataset: University of Campania Luigi Vanvitelli neurology clinic cohort (Naples, Italy; single centre)
Key_Novelty: First RCT: DLPFC rTMS durably lowers plasma MMPs, raises TIMPs, improves visuospatial function
Primary_Limitation: Small pilot (n=20); no healthy controls, CSF measures or neuroimaging; visuospatial-only cognitive effect.
Open_Problems: Larger multi-centre trial with imaging correlation; CSF MMP/TIMP panels; dementia-outcome follow-up.
Journal: International Journal of Molecular Sciences 24(4): 3231, 2023 (MDPI, open access)

Modality: Structural MRI (ASHS-T1 MTL subregions) + plasma p-tau181/NfL
Method_Architecture: ASHS-T1 segmentation; stepwise linear mixed effects (lme4); logistic-regression ROC on fast/slow progressors
Best_Metric: AUC 0.89-0.93 (fast vs slow progressors, all-MCI, combined MRI+plasma); CN 0.65-0.73
Dataset: ADNI-GO + ADNI-2
Key_Novelty: Baseline MTL MRI + plasma p-tau181/NfL jointly predict fast progressors (AUC 0.93 MCI)
Primary_Limitation: ADNI-only (no external validation); only p-tau181/NfL plasma analytes; most-predictive MTL region varied across models.
Open_Problems: External validation; event-based MTL summary measures; additional plasma markers (p-tau217, GFAP); conversion endpoints.
Journal: Alzheimer's Research & Therapy 15: 79, 2023 (BMC/Springer Nature, open access)

Modality: Structural MRI: hippocampal parenchymal fraction + VBM grey matter volume
Method_Architecture: KAIBA/ART HPF; CAT12 VBM; linear regression; DAPBI voxel-wise correlation with GRF correction
Best_Metric: HPF-MoCA beta 0.23 per 0.01 HPF (p<0.001); HPF group diff F(2,363)=114.38, p<0.001
Dataset: ADNI (quality T1-MRI subset)
Key_Novelty: First HPF-cortical GM coupling map across CN/MCI/AD; HPF-MoCA link confirmed in MCI and AD
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional design; no longitudinal HPF change; limited covariates; single MRI pipeline.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal HPF trajectories; HPF in mixed pathology; genetic covariate adjustment.
Journal: Journal of Alzheimer's Disease 93(3): 791-801, 2023 (IOS Press, open access)

Modality: Plasma biomarkers (A-beta42/40, T-tau, P-tau181, NfL; Simoa) + cognition + APOE
Method_Architecture: Decision trees (full/best/refined tiers); z-score normalisation; ROC/AUC; external ADNI validation
Best_Metric: AUC 0.94 overall / 0.97 MCI for A-beta-PET positivity; ADNI validation 0.96/0.95
Dataset: Sixth People's Hospital Shanghai (training) + ADNI (external validation)
Sample_N_Approx: 609 (238 CN + 118 SCD + 135 MCI + 89 AD + 29 non-AD); ADNI 284
Key_Novelty: Largest Chinese PET cohort: plasma+cognition tree predicts A-beta positivity (MCI AUC 0.97)
Primary_Limitation: Single-centre derivation; plasma-platform transferability unproven; weaker performance in SCD/comorbidity subgroups.
Open_Problems: Multi-centre prospective cohorts; cross-assay cut-point standardisation; comorbidity confound handling.

Modality: Peripheral blood gene expression (microarray/qPCR): mitochondria-related genes
Method_Architecture: limma DEG; LASSO + SVM-RFE; MitoCarta3.0 intersection; logistic nomogram; CIBERSORT
Best_Metric: AUC 0.723 (NDUFA1+NDUFS5+age LOAD model); NDUFA1 0.687 / NDUFS5 0.682 (validation)
Dataset: GEO GSE63060/GSE63061/GSE140829 + Ruijin Hospital qRT-PCR clinical samples
Sample_N_Approx: 1189 (675 train: 353 CN + 322 LOAD; 514 validation: 101 CN + 113 LOAD + 300 MCI); 27 qRT-PCR (9 CN + 10 MCI + 8 LOAD)
Key_Novelty: Mitochondrial complex-I genes NDUFA1/NDUFS5 + age diagnose LOAD (AUC 0.723) and MCI
Primary_Limitation: Modest AUCs; small single-centre qRT-PCR validation; no longitudinal conversion endpoint; mechanism unproven.
Open_Problems: Functional studies of complex-I subunits; multi-centre qPCR validation; prospective nomogram testing.
Journal: Journal of Alzheimer's Disease 99(4): S299-S315, 2024 (IOS Press, open access)

Modality: Plasma and CSF nonenzymatic protein damage markers (SIM-GC/MS)
Method_Architecture: Isotope-dilution SIM-GC/MS quantification; multivariate regression; longitudinal progression association
Best_Metric: not reported
Dataset: Hospital Universitari Santa Maria / IRBLleida cohort (Lleida, Spain)
Sample_N_Approx: 289 (103 AD + 92 MCI + 94 controls; 89 MCI followed, 47 progressed)
Key_Novelty: Paired plasma+CSF: fluid protein-damage markers do not predict AD diagnosis or MCI-to-AD progression
Primary_Limitation: Fluid-assay sensitivity; single centre; no tissue confirmation; negative-result scope.
Open_Problems: Tissue-vs-fluid oxidative damage quantification; more sensitive assays; multi-centre cohorts.

Modality: CSF NPTX2 (PRM-MS) with CSF A-beta42/40, p-tau181, t-tau
Method_Architecture: PRM-MS NPTX2 composite; Lumipulse CSF assays; Cox proportional hazards; AIC comparison; linear mixed effects
Best_Metric: HR 0.76 per SD lower NPTX2 for MCI symptom onset (p=0.023); additive over AD biomarkers (chi-square=11.5, p<0.01)
Dataset: BIOCARD Study (NIH/JHU longitudinal cohort)
Key_Novelty: CSF NPTX2 independently predicts normal-to-MCI onset (HR 0.76), additive to amyloid/tau
Primary_Limitation: Homogeneous White, highly educated cohort with AD family enrichment; no external validation.
Open_Problems: Diverse cohorts; plasma NPTX2 assay; joint trajectory modelling with MRI/tau-PET; mechanistic studies.

Method_Architecture: ChAMP EWAS pipeline; DMP/DMR; logistic regression; pyrosequencing validation; ROC; GO/KEGG enrichment
Best_Metric: AUC 0.988 (cg18771300, MCI vs CHC; spec 100%, sens 95%); two-CpG combination AUC 0.990
Dataset: Lishui Second People's Hospital cohort (Zhejiang, China)
Key_Novelty: First EWAS of blood leukocyte methylome in Chinese MCI/AD; RHOJ CpGs predict MCI (AUC 0.988)
Primary_Limitation: Small sample (n=60); unmatched age/sex between groups; no independent replication cohort; cross-sectional.
Open_Problems: Independent-cohort validation; functional experiments for RHOJ/PARK2 methylation; longitudinal testing of whether DMPs track MCI-to-AD progression; multi-ancestry replication.
Journal: Frontiers in Genetics 14: 1175864, 2023 (Frontiers Media SA, open access)

Modality: Serum and CSF inflammatory cytokines and inflammasome markers
Method_Architecture: Multiplex immunoassays (Simoa, MSD, Protein Simple, ELISA); group comparisons; Spearman correlations
Best_Metric: CSF OPN/YKL-40 elevated in MCI; serum IL-1beta 345.2 vs 90.74 fg/mL vs HC (p<0.0001); NLRP3 serum correlations r>=0.50
Dataset: National Bioservice (Russia) MCI/NIC + BioreclamationIVT (US) healthy serum controls
Key_Novelty: Shows CNS inflammation (CSF OPN/YKL-40) and peripheral NLRP3-IL-1beta activation are specific to MCI
Primary_Limitation: No healthy CSF controls; CSF inflammasome analytes below detection; cross-sectional design with heterogeneous MCI.
Open_Problems: Longitudinal sampling; sensitive CSF inflammasome assays; healthy CSF controls; larger cohorts to reduce MCI heterogeneity.
Journal: International Journal of Molecular Sciences 24(13): 10523, 2023 (MDPI, open access)

Modality: Structural MRI (FreeSurfer cortical thickness + subcortical volumes)
Method_Architecture: OPLS severity index (ropls); 10-fold CV; age detrending; minimal-atrophy removal; Kaplan-Meier/Cox; DeLong
Best_Metric: AUC 0.72 aMCI-trained vs 0.57 dementia-trained (P=0.037); sens 72.3%, spec 60.9%
Dataset: Swedish BioFINDER-1 study cohort (single center, Skane University Hospital)
Sample_N_Approx: 504 (220 CN Abeta-negative + 139 SCD + 106 aMCI + 39 AD dementia)
Key_Novelty: aMCI-trained OPLS model beats dementia-trained for SCD progression prediction (AUC 0.72)
Primary_Limitation: Single-center data; small AD-dementia training set (n=39); no external validation; MRI-only without pathology confirmation.
Open_Problems: External multicentric replication; hippocampal-subfield/transentorhinal segmentation; combination with amyloid/tau biomarkers.
Journal: Alzheimer's Research & Therapy 16: 153, 2024 (BioMed Central, open access)

Method_Architecture: LC-MRM with isotope-labelled synthetic standards; binomial LASSO; multinomial logistic regression; ROC
Best_Metric: AUC 0.90 (AD vs NDC, male; 77% sens/89% spec); cognitive impairment vs NDC AUC 0.83 male / 0.71 female
Dataset: MCBI research cohort, Japan (participants per ADNI criteria)
Key_Novelty: 8-protein LC-MS/MS plasma panel for early MCI/AD detection (AUC 0.90/0.80)
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional; no external validation; statin/medication effects uncontrolled; low-abundance AD proteins not detected.
Open_Problems: External multi-center validation; longitudinal design; combination with established AD blood biomarkers; lifestyle/medication data.
Journal: International Journal of Molecular Sciences 24(17): 13064, 2023 (MDPI, open access)

Method_Architecture: Custom Simoa homebrew assays; multimarker ratio scoring; ROC; Kruskal-Wallis/Dunn; Spearman correlations
Best_Metric: AUC 0.9321 (MCI vs CN); AD-DLB 0.8531; PD-DLB 0.8831; AD-PD 0.8593
Dataset: National Hospital Organization Sendai Nishitaga Hospital cohort, Japan
Key_Novelty: FABP multimarker scores discriminate PD/DLB/AD/MCI (AUC 0.93 MCI vs CN); FABP3 tracks cognition
Primary_Limitation: Age mismatch (CN younger); cross-sectional; single-center; no external validation; some false negatives.
Open_Problems: External multi-institution validation with age-matched controls; longitudinal sampling; clarify FABP5/FABP7 roles; reduce false negatives.
Journal: International Journal of Molecular Sciences 24(17): 13267, 2023 (MDPI, open access)

Modality: Plasma neurofilament light chain (Simoa) + ATN biomarkers
Method_Architecture: Simoa SR-X; ATN classification; ROC/Youden cutoffs; Kaplan-Meier; Cox regression; repeated-measures ANOVA
Best_Metric: AUC 0.954 (NfL change rate, MCI-to-AD; sens 100%, spec 91.3%); ATN detection AUC 0.82
Dataset: Careggi University Hospital cohort, Florence, Italy (2018-2022)
Sample_N_Approx: 140 (45 SCD + 73 MCI + 22 AD dementia; 48 with 2-year repeat NfL)
Key_Novelty: First SCD/MCI plasma NfL cutoffs for ATN status; NfL change rate excludes MCI-to-AD (AUC 0.954)
Primary_Limitation: Single center; no external validation; short follow-up (2.72 y); low sensitivity and fair PPV for progression.
Open_Problems: Multi-center external validation; longer follow-up; combination with blood p-tau/Abeta42; standardised assay protocols.
Journal: European Journal of Neurology 31(3): e16089, 2024 (Wiley, open access)

Modality: Neutrophil/innate-immune mechanisms; blood markers (NLR, NGAL, MPO)
Method_Architecture: Narrative review of basic immunology, animal-model and clinical biomarker evidence
Best_Metric: not reported
Dataset: Not applicable (narrative review of published literature)
Key_Novelty: Review linking neutrophil/NET activation and NLR to MCI-to-dementia progression and prognosis
Primary_Limitation: Narrative review without systematic protocol or original data; heterogeneous evidence and unclear causality.
Open_Problems: Prospective validation of standardized neutrophil marker panels; mechanistic studies; neutrophil-modulating intervention trials.
Journal: International Journal of Molecular Sciences 24(19): 14795, 2023 (MDPI, open access)

Modality: Whole-genome sequencing gene burdens informed by FDG/AV45-PET
Method_Architecture: Gene-burden aggregation; gene-imaging correlation selection; logistic regression; PLINK PRS; 10-fold CV; SHAP
Best_Metric: AUROC 0.750 (adORS.with.APOE, CN vs AD); MCI-CP 0.637 (adORS.with.APOE) vs PRS 0.643
Dataset: ADNI + ADSP-FUS1-ADNI-WGS-2 (whole-genome sequencing; FDG-PET and AV45-PET)
Sample_N_Approx: 1545 (550 AD + 364 CN + 273 MCI converters + 517 MCI non-converters)
Key_Novelty: Imaging-informed oligogenic score (adORS) beats PRS for AD and MCI-conversion prediction
Primary_Limitation: ADNI-only cross-sectional analysis; modest AUCs; no external validation; limited non-European ancestry.
Open_Problems: External multi-ethnic replication; prospective testing; integration of CSF/blood biomarkers; functional validation of ATF6/ING5/SIK3/CD46.
Journal: Frontiers in Aging Neuroscience 15: 1281748, 2023 (Frontiers Media SA, open access)

Method_Architecture: Passive-motion apparatus JNDT; forced-choice psychophysics; ANCOVA; Pearson correlations
Best_Metric: LPS ANCOVA F=10.00 p<0.001 (PD/MCI vs control); UPSIT-TC control vs MCI p=0.006; UPSIT-MoCA r=0.44 p=0.04
Dataset: Chang Gung Memorial Hospital (Linkou) PD clinic + Northern Taiwan community cohort
Key_Novelty: First report of impaired limb position sense in MCI; perceptual deficits track severity
Primary_Limitation: Age and sex imbalance between groups; cross-sectional; single-joint testing; small sample.
Open_Problems: Age-matched cohorts; multi-joint testing; longitudinal follow-up; whether perceptual deficits predict MCI-to-dementia conversion.

Method_Architecture: Untargeted LC-ESI-QTOF-MS/MS; HMDB identification; logistic regression (stepwise); Cox hazard; Hanley-McNeil
Best_Metric: AUC 0.88 (MCI-to-AD progression model with CE(11D3:1)+unknown lipid+covariates); Cox HR 2.70 TG(O-52:2) rate
Dataset: Hospital Universitari Santa Maria de Lleida cohort, Spain (2014-2016)
Sample_N_Approx: 209 (91 AD + 92 MCI + 26 controls); 92 MCI followed median 58 months, 48 progressed
Key_Novelty: CSF neutral lipids (CE, ether-TG) predict MCI-to-AD progression (AUC 0.88) and rate
Primary_Limitation: No external validation; two progression lipids unidentified; no medication/diet data; single-center.
Open_Problems: Tissue-level mechanistic studies; medication/diet data; multi-center replication; identification of unknown lipid species.

Modality: Blood lncRNA transcriptomics (PBMC RNA, RT2 lncRNA PCR array)
Method_Architecture: RT2 lncRNA PCR array (84 lncRNAs) + RT-qPCR validation; RNAInter interactome; g:Profiler pathway enrichment; Cytoscape/cytoHubba MCC hub ranking
Best_Metric: Differential expression (fold-change, t-test p-values); no AUC/accuracy reported
Dataset: Local Naples cohort (Policlinic Federico II, University of Campania "Luigi Vanvitelli")
Key_Novelty: First lncRNA blood profile in MCI; SNHG16/H19 hubs, NEAT1 down
Primary_Limitation: n=20 single-centre, no validation cohort, no functional validation, cross-sectional.
Open_Problems: Prospective validation in larger cohorts; functional knockdown/overexpression studies; longitudinal lncRNA tracking over MCI-to-AD conversion; CSF/imaging correlation.

Method_Architecture: UHPLC-MS/MS faecal metabolomics; PCA/PLS-DA/OPLS-DA (VIP>1, P<0.05); machine-learning ROC models; MetaboAnalyst KEGG pathway; Spearman correlation with serum biomarkers
Best_Metric: AUC 0.7402 (MCI progression prediction, 6 metabolites); diagnosis model AUC 0.7007 (7 metabolites)
Dataset: Shanghai Pudong New Area People's Hospital community cohort (residents aged >=65)
Sample_N_Approx: 174 (cohort 1: 30 NC + 22 MCI + 35 AD; cohort 2: 87 MCI due to AD: 32 progressive + 55 unprogressive)
Key_Novelty: Gut-flora faecal metabolites diagnose MCI (AUC 0.70) and predict progression (0.74)
Primary_Limitation: Single-centre, baseline-only stool sampling, no external validation cohort.
Open_Problems: External validation; repeated stool sampling; animal intervention experiments to confirm protective/risk roles of Perillyl alcohol and other metabolites.
Journal: Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology 14: 1351523, 2024 (Frontiers Media, open access)

Modality: CSF Abeta42/PET SUVR prediction targets; multimodal clinical+MRI features
Method_Architecture: Ridge logistic regression / ridge regression classifiers on non-invasive baseline measures (demographics, APOE4, neuropsychology, MRI) plus CSF/PET models; 10-fold CV with independent-participant conversion validation
Best_Metric: AUC 0.78 (CSF-based 4-year Abeta-positivity conversion); MCI-to-dementia conversion AUC 0.89 on independent participants
Dataset: ADNI (all phases, CSF + florbetapir PET + FreeSurfer MRI + neuropsychology)
Sample_N_Approx: 162 test (52 converters/110 stable CSF) + 231 (PET) + 253/385 regression + 638 independent conversion-validation participants
Key_Novelty: ML on non-invasive measures predicts future Abeta-positivity (CSF AUC 0.78)
Primary_Limitation: Small converter groups; no independent external database validation; CSF/PET cohorts not directly comparable.
Open_Problems: External non-ADNI validation; harmonised CSF/PET modelling; longer follow-up; plasma-based non-invasive prediction.
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia 2024 (Moradi et al.; ADNI-based ML study)

Method_Architecture: Planned systematic review/meta-analysis (PRISMA-P 2015, PROSPERO CRD42023481200): random-effects REML with Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman CIs; QUIPS (KQ1) and PROBAST (KQ2) risk-of-bias; GRADE
Best_Metric: not reported
Dataset: Protocol (no data collected); planned PubMed/Embase longitudinal cohorts
Key_Novelty: First registered protocol for blood GFAP prognosis synthesis in pre-dementia adults
Primary_Limitation: Protocol only - no results yet; planned synthesis of heterogeneous cohort designs.
Open_Problems: Await completion: blood GFAP HRs for CU->MCI/AD and MCI->AD; model C-statistics; GRADE-rated body of evidence.
Journal: BMJ Open 2024 (Nihashi et al., protocol; DOI in source extract)

Method_Architecture: ELISA serum biomarkers; ANOVA group comparisons; Spearman correlations; ROC analysis for MCI detection
Best_Metric: AUC 0.732 (NfL + BNT combined for MCI); NfL alone 0.646; Abeta40 0.707
Dataset: Hebei Province community cohort (Yuhua District Shijiazhuang + Renze District Xingtai), China
Key_Novelty: ELISA serum NfL + BNT improves MCI detection (AUC 0.732); cytokines add no value
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional, small probable-AD group, single region, no neuroimaging, ELISA sensitivity limits.
Open_Problems: External multi-centre validation; longitudinal MCI-to-AD follow-up; ultrasensitive assay comparison; imaging correlation.
Journal: Frontiers in Aging Neuroscience 16, 2024 (Jing et al.; serum NfL/cytokine panel)

Modality: Serum isoleucine metabolomics; CSF tau comparison
Method_Architecture: Serum metabolomics (isoleucine); ANCOVA group comparisons; ROC/MedCalc AUC; Cox proportional hazards for MCI-to-AD conversion; linear mixed models
Best_Metric: MCI-to-AD conversion HR 1.367 (95% CI 1.012-1.845, cutoff <=78.3 uM); Ile+P-tau AD diagnosis AUC 0.808
Dataset: ADNI (serum isoleucine + CSF biomarkers; 48-month follow-up)
Sample_N_Approx: 700 (CN 224 + sMCI 129 + pMCI 179 + AD 181; 180 MCI converted to AD)
Key_Novelty: Serum isoleucine boosts CSF P-tau (AUC 0.808) and predicts MCI-to-AD (HR 1.367)
Primary_Limitation: Single-database ADNI; isoleucine alone weak diagnostic AUC (0.584 AD); no external validation.
Open_Problems: External replication; mechanistic role of branched-chain amino acids; combination with other metabolomic markers.
Journal: Annals of Geriatric Medicine and Research 2024 (Jing et al.; ADNI serum isoleucine)

Modality: Soluble TREM2 in CSF, serum and plasma
Method_Architecture: Systematic review/meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD42024514593): random-effects SMD pooling; I2 heterogeneity; NOS quality appraisal; biofluid subgroup analysis
Best_Metric: CSF sTREM2 AD-vs-control SMD 0.28 [0.15-0.41]; MCI-vs-control SMD 0.30 [0.13-0.47]; plasma AD SMD 0.42
Dataset: Meta-analysis of 36 observational studies (PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane)
Key_Novelty: Registered meta-analysis resolves CSF vs plasma sTREM2 across AD/MCI (36 studies)
Primary_Limitation: Assay heterogeneity and cross-sectional pooling; sTREM2 lacks AD-vs-MCI stage discrimination.
Open_Problems: Harmonised assays; longitudinal sTREM2-progression studies; combination with amyloid/tau; meta-regression on age/APOE/assay.
Journal: Frontiers in Aging Neuroscience 16: 1407980, 2024 (Frontiers Media, open access)

Modality: Tau-PET (visual read and regional composite SUVR)
Method_Architecture: [SUPPLEMENT-ONLY corpus file] Tau-PET quantification comparison (visual read, regional composite SUVR) for MCI-to-dementia prediction; AUC-based performance in discovery and validation cohorts; main text confirmed from published record (JAMA Neurology 2024)
Best_Metric: Tau-PET AD-dementia prediction AUC 0.84 discovery / 0.79 validation; visual read lower (~0.69-0.72)
Dataset: Prospective MCI cohort (discovery n=331) + validation (n=117, ADNI)
Key_Novelty: Head-to-head tau-PET quantification methods for MCI-to-dementia prognosis (AUC 0.84/0.79)
Primary_Limitation: Supplement-only corpus file; main text confirmed from published record; small validation cohort.
Open_Problems: Incremental value of tau-PET over plasma/CSF p-tau; harmonised quantification across sites; trial enrichment use.
Journal: JAMA Neurology (published online June 10, 2024) - supplemental online content

Method_Architecture: Semi-supervised mixture-of-experts (MOE) algorithm with SVM hyperplane subtype mapping; longitudinal conversion-rate analysis (M06-M24); APOE and CSF comparisons
Best_Metric: Acc 85.3 +/- 3.1% (three-expert MOE subtype classification); rw 0.32 +/- 0.03; BPC 0.68 +/- 0.09
Dataset: ADNI-1 (baseline: 396 MCI + 228 CN + 192 AD)
Key_Novelty: Semi-supervised MOE defines three MCI atrophy subtypes (MIN/MID/DIF) with distinct conversion
Primary_Limitation: ADNI-only derivation without external validation; ~50% missing CSF data; subtype boundaries not independently replicated.
Open_Problems: External validation; CSF harmonisation; incorporation of fluid biomarkers; longer follow-up beyond 24 months.
Journal: Frontiers in Aging Neuroscience 16: 1328301, 2024 (Frontiers Media, open access)

Modality: Plasma-derived small extracellular vesicle proteins (Western blot/ELISA)
Method_Architecture: Chemical-precipitation PsEV isolation; TEM + NTA characterisation; CD63/CD81/TSG101/L1CAM validation; Western blot and ELISA for synaptic/inflammatory/AD-pathology proteins; correlation with neuropsychology
Best_Metric: Group differences in PsEV protein expression (synaptophysin down p=0.047; PsEV count p<0.0001); no classification accuracy
Dataset: Single-centre cohort (India): 35 AD, 25 MCI, 30 age-matched controls
Key_Novelty: Plasma sEVs carry synaptic (synaptophysin down) + neuroinflammatory (GFAP/TNF/IL-1 up) signature
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional single-centre case-control (n=90); chemical-precipitation isolation; no external validation.
Open_Problems: Prospective longitudinal sampling; multi-centre cohorts; orthogonal EV isolation cross-validation; multiplex quantitative assays; CSF comparison.

Modality: Gut microbiota composition (16S/metagenomic, probiotic trials) in MCI - review
Method_Architecture: Narrative review/synthesis of microbiota-composition and probiotic-trial studies; no quantitative model
Best_Metric: not reported
Dataset: Published gut-microbiota literature in MCI (16S/metagenomic and probiotic studies); no primary cohort
Key_Novelty: First MCI-focused narrative consolidating gut-microbiota dysbiosis evidence and probiotic prospects
Primary_Limitation: Narrative non-systematic review; heterogeneous small studies; no definitive MCI microbiota signature yet.
Open_Problems: Reproducible MCI-specific microbial signature unestablished; causality unclear; standardised 16S/metagenomic profiling and larger randomised probiotic trials with long follow-up needed.

Modality: Plasma pTau181 with clinical/cognitive assessments (prognosis in Ab+ MCI)
Method_Architecture: Bayesian logistic-lasso regression (baseline pTau181 + clinical/cognitive tests) for 18-month decline and 36-month MCI-to-AD progression
Best_Metric: AUROC 0.79 (pTau181+clinical, 36-month progression, VC-2) vs 0.718 clinical alone; 18-month decline AUROC 0.742/0.753 in VC-1/VC-2
Dataset: MissionAD1/2 elenbecestat placebo training (n=135) + lecanemab-trial placebo VC-1 (n=115) + ADNI-2/GO VC-2 (n=177)
Key_Novelty: Plasma pTau181 adds independent 18/36-month decline-prediction value in Ab+ MCI trial cohorts
Primary_Limitation: Trial-placebo and ADNI cohorts; single-assay pTau181; modest absolute AUC gains over clinical assessments.
Open_Problems: Whether other plasma markers further improve decline prediction; assay-platform standardisation; validation in real-world memory-clinic populations and longer follow-up.
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia: Diagnosis, Assessment & Disease Monitoring 16: e12621, 2024 (Wiley)

Modality: Planned CSF, FDG-PET, MRI, EEG and APOE biomarkers (conversion-model protocol)
Method_Architecture: Statistical analysis plan: Cox regression with stepwise selection, internal bootstrap validation and nomogram (analyses not yet run)
Best_Metric: not reported (planned: discrimination and calibration of Cox model)
Dataset: INTERCEPTOR project: planned 500 MCI, Italian multicentre longitudinal cohort (NCT03834402); protocol - no data analysed
Key_Novelty: Pre-specified SAP for Italian multicentre MCI-to-AD conversion model (EEG+CSF+imaging)
Primary_Limitation: Protocol only - no results; planned analyses not yet performed.
Open_Problems: Which single biomarker or biomarker set best predicts 3-year MCI-to-AD conversion; completion of INTERCEPTOR follow-up and planned analyses; external validation in independent MCI cohorts.
Journal: Diagnostic and Prognostic Research 8: 11, 2024 (BMC/Springer, open access)

Modality: Diffusion MRI cortical microstructure (AngleR, MD, FA) with CSF AT status
Method_Architecture: ATN-group comparison plus ROC/PPV/NPV analysis of cortical-diffusion metrics for MCI-to-dementia progression
Best_Metric: AUC 0.8 (whole-brain AngleR differentiating stable vs converting CSF A-T- MCI); NPV gain +21.25%
Dataset: Real-world memory clinic cohort (Milan, Fondazione IRCCS Ca' Granda Ospedale Maggiore Policlinico), n=90 with CSF and MRI
Key_Novelty: Cortical diffusion microstructure (AngleR) rescues NPV in CSF-negative real-world MCI (AUC 0.8)
Primary_Limitation: Single-centre n=90 with mixed AD/non-AD outcomes; no external validation; specialist diffusion acquisition.
Open_Problems: Value in A-T+ groups and across scanner platforms; harmonisation of diffusion microstructural metrics; external validation in independent memory-clinic cohorts with longer standardised follow-up.
Journal: Annals of Clinical and Translational Neurology 11(8): 1964-1976, 2024 (Wiley)

Modality: Longitudinal MDS-UPDRS part III motor scores and incident MCI (PPMI PD cohort)
Method_Architecture: Latent class trajectory model (LCTM) + nonlinear mixed-effects; propensity-score matching; Cox proportional hazards with Kaplan-Meier
Best_Metric: HR 1.559 (95% CI 1.147-2.119) for incident MCI, severe-progressive vs mild-remitting class after PSM (p=0.004)
Dataset: PPMI (Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative): 415 de novo, drug-naive PD patients, 5-year follow-up
Key_Novelty: Motor-trajectory classes (severe-progressive vs mild) predict incident MCI in de novo PD
Primary_Limitation: Single PPMI cohort without external validation; observational design; MCI ascertainment across sites.
Open_Problems: Causal pathway from motor progression to MCI; value of adding non-motor/biological markers; external validation in independent PD cohorts with longer follow-up.

Modality: Plasma small-RNA sequencing (microRNAome) with neuropsychological tests (ADNI)
Method_Architecture: scikit-learn ML classifiers (six families) on DESeq2-normalised miRNA counts; 70/30 split + RepeatedStratifiedKFold 5x3
Best_Metric: AUC 0.79 (LMCI-to-AD, miR-532-3p/miR-1306-3p + ADAS-cog13); 3-miRNA LMCI-to-AD AUC 0.75 vs CSF 0.60-0.62
Dataset: ADNI plasma: 803 after QC (165 CN, 272 EMCI, 217 LMCI, 149 AD); conversion subset 420 MCI (166 converters)
Key_Novelty: First ADNI plasma microRNAome: miRNA+ADAS-cog13 signature predicts LMCI-to-AD conversion
Primary_Limitation: Single ADNI cohort (no external validation); sequencing-based assay not yet clinically standardised; moderate conversion AUCs.
Open_Problems: External validation (BioFINDER and other biobanks); transfer to qPCR-based assays; prospective evaluation of the miRNA-plus-cognitive screening pathway.

Method_Architecture: multistate Markov models; predefined serum cutoffs; IPW attrition sensitivity analyses
Best_Metric: HR 2.34 (95% CI 1.77-3.11) NfL and 2.11 p-tau217 for MCI-to-AD dementia
Dataset: SNAC-K (Swedish National study on Aging and Care; Kungsholmen)
Sample_N_Approx: 2148 dementia-free participants (381 MCI at baseline; mean 9.6-year follow-up)
Key_Novelty: Blood biomarkers stratify MCI-to-dementia risk at population scale but not MCI onset
Primary_Limitation: Clinical-only dementia ascertainment; single baseline serum measurement; cohort-internal cutoffs.
Open_Problems: Repeated biomarker measures; biological confirmation subsamples; cutoff harmonisation; individual-level models with clinical data.

Modality: Optum EHR demographics; ICD-10 codes and NLP-derived symptom variables
Method_Architecture: resampling-based regularisation variable selection; Bayesian logistic LASSO with spike-and-slab priors; 10-fold CV with 30% holdout
Best_Metric: AUC 86.1% cross-validated (85.8% held-out); sensitivity 76.8%; specificity 79.7%
Dataset: Optum Clinical EHR database (US; 2007-2022)
Key_Novelty: EHR comorbidity model triages MCI risk at AUC 0.86 across 285k patients
Primary_Limitation: ICD-10-based ascertainment; possible undiagnosed MCI in controls; single-database scope.
Open_Problems: External health-system validation; threshold economics; blood-biomarker integration; calibration for documentation heterogeneity.
Journal: Alzheimer's & Dementia: Diagnosis Assessment & Disease Monitoring 17:e70209 2025 (Wiley open access)

Method_Architecture: parsimonious Cox proportional hazards; Brier-scored 1/3/5-year probabilities; online risk interface
Best_Metric: C-index 0.75 (95% CI 0.69-0.79) pTau217 model for MCI progression; GFAP model 0.69 any-cause
Dataset: Amsterdam Dementia Cohort with external validation in MEMENTO and AIBL
Sample_N_Approx: 567 patients (314 SCD + 253 MCI; 119 progressors); pTau217 subset 197 MCI
Key_Novelty: Externally validated individualized plasma-biomarker dementia risk calculator for SCD and MCI
Primary_Limitation: Short median 2.4-year follow-up; subset-only pTau217; AIBL population-cohort recalibration gap.
Open_Problems: Full-cohort pTau217; prospective real-world studies; multi-platform assay harmonisation; SCD-specific models.

Method_Architecture: Kruskal-Wallis/Mann-Whitney group comparisons; Spearman rank correlations; ROC/AUROC with 95% CI; single-batch ECLIA/ELISA assays; 3-year clinical progression-based classification.
Best_Metric: AUROC 0.743 (95% CI 0.636-0.851) neurogranin+YKL-40 combined for MCI-AD vs sMCI; neurogranin alone 0.721
Dataset: Skaraborg Central Hospital community cohort (Falköping, Sweden), single centre
Sample_N_Approx: 107 community-dwelling MCI subjects (47 men/60 women): 40 MCI-AD (26 pure + 14 mixed) + 25 MCI-VaD (18 SVD + 7 cVaD) + 42 sMCI.
Key_Novelty: Community-dwelling MCI evidence that CSF neurogranin separates MCI-AD from VaD and sMCI
Primary_Limitation: Moderate diagnostic accuracy below core biomarkers, single-timepoint CSF, and older MCI-AD/MCI-VaD groups vs sMCI.
Open_Problems: Open: conflicting YKL-40 behaviour in VaD; blood surrogates. Applications: characterising consequences of synaptic dysfunction and neuroinflammation, future treatment monitoring. Methodologies: single-batch assaying, community recruitment, blinded biochemistry. Achievable: adjunct rather than standalone staging markers.

Modality: Neuroimaging (18F-florbetapir PET; 3T T1 GMV VBM; DTI FA/MD; neuropsych battery)
Method_Architecture: Voxel-based morphometry (SPM12, FWE); atlas-based DTI FA/MD (PANDA, JHU); florbetapir SUVr quantification; ANCOVA with FDR; bootstrapped mediation analysis.
Best_Metric: Left-HIP GMV mediation of left-CH MD effect on AVLT-delay: indirect effect -0.333 (95% CI -0.590 to -0.115); SUVr-left-HIP GMV r=-0.677
Dataset: Beijing Aging Brain Rejuvenation Initiative (BABRI) cohort
Sample_N_Approx: 69 native Chinese participants: 37 MCI (19 Aβneg + 18 Aβpos) + 32 normal controls.
Key_Novelty: Aβ-negative MCI shows AD-like deficits; amyloid adds left-hippocampal damage atop shared WM injury
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional design, no tau/APOE biomarkers and incomplete NC PET coverage limit interpretation of Aβneg heterogeneity.
Open_Problems: Open: pathophysiology of subthreshold amyloid; Aβneg heterogeneity. Applications: risk stratification in Aβneg MCI, follow-up targeting. Methodologies: three-group common control, mediation modelling, multimodal PET/sMRI/DTI. Achievable: biomarker-integrated screening for high-risk amyloid-negative MCI.

Method_Architecture: Immunoprecipitation mass spectrometry (IP-MS/LC-MRM); ROC/AUC analyses; linear mixed-effects and rate-of-change models; Spearman correlation with cognitive trajectories.
Best_Metric: AUC 0.90 (95% CI 0.78-1.00) serum β-synuclein for MCI(Aβ+) 5-year converters vs stable (76.9% sens/100% spec)
Dataset: ADNI (ADNI 1 and ADNI GO) serum and clinical follow-up database
Sample_N_Approx: 463 ADNI participants (135 CU + 166 MCI + 162 AD); 235 with at least one follow-up serum; CSF AD biomarkers for 194; β-synuclein-vs-NRGN comparison subset 148.
Key_Novelty: First longitudinal serum β-synuclein data; predicts MCI-to-dementia conversion, outperforms NRGN
Primary_Limitation: Clinically defined groups with incomplete Aβ status and short, late-timed serum follow-up (mean 2.3 years).
Open_Problems: Open: exact timing of the β-synuclein rise; confounder effects. Applications: trial stratification, treatment monitoring (anti-amyloid lowering of synaptic markers). Methodologies: IP-MS with isotope standards, rate-of-change modelling, temporal staging. Achievable: blood synaptic-degeneration readout complementary to pTau/NfL.
Journal: Alzheimer's Research & Therapy 18:45 2026 (BMC/Springer Nature, open access)

Modality: Molecular/Fluid (CSF and peripheral-blood YKL-40/CHI3L1 pooled across studies)
Method_Architecture: Random-effects SMD meta-analysis; Newcastle-Ottawa Scale assessment; subgroup and meta-regression analyses; Egger's publication-bias test; leave-one-out sensitivity analysis.
Best_Metric: CSF YKL-40 SMD 1.37 (95% CI 1.09-1.65) AD vs healthy controls across 24 studies
Dataset: 30 observational studies (PubMed/Medline/Web of Science/Cochrane) totalling 5,815 participants
Sample_N_Approx: 30 observational studies with 5,815 participants (2,102 AD + 1,504 MCI + 118 pre-AD + 2,091 HCs); 24 CSF studies, 8 peripheral-blood studies.
Key_Novelty: First meta-analysis quantifying YKL-40 across the full AD continuum with parallel CSF-blood pooling
Primary_Limitation: High residual heterogeneity (I2 >75%), limited pre-AD/blood studies and publication bias in the largest comparison.
Open_Problems: Open: heterogeneity sources; ultra-early discrimination. Applications: adjunctive progression monitoring, plasma-based screening support. Methodologies: PROSPERO-registered random-effects meta-analysis with blood-matrix stratification. Achievable: multi-analyte inflammatory panels for staging.

Method_Architecture: Broad-spectrum targeted LC-MS/MS (MRM); bootstrap-resampled Spearman correlation networks; Chao1/ACE/Shannon diversity indices; logistic and ordinal regression against MCI and AD8.
Best_Metric: Acc 1-hydroxypyrene OR 4.27 (95% CI 2.14-8.51) for MCI; AD8 ordinal OR 3.58 (p<0.00001)
Dataset: Changzhi (Shanxi, China) community cohort with paired urine exposome-metabolome profiling
Sample_N_Approx: 60 participants: 30 MCI (AD8 6-8) + 30 age/sex-matched controls (AD8 0-2), Changzhi, Shanxi Province, China.
Key_Novelty: First urine exposome-metabolome network study in MCI; hyperconnectivity with PAH/PFAS hubs
Primary_Limitation: Cross-sectional design, n=30/group power (~65-70%) and AD8-based case identification limit causal and clinical inference.
Open_Problems: Open: causality and compound-specific pharmacokinetics (NEtFOSAA paradox). Applications: exposure-risk biomarkers, regional public-health targeting. Methodologies: bootstrap-stabilised E×M networks, biodiversity indices over chemical communities. Achievable: exposome-informed MCI risk frameworks.
